jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer II, GenAI Evaluation Framework
jobs.description: **About the AI Accelerator** The AI Accelerator drives AI innovation across Cox Automotive. The team builds proof\-of\-concept agents, ships reusable AI components, sets evaluation and governance standards, and partners with product teams to bring AI into production. **About the Role** Cox Automotive is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer II to own and build the GenAI Evaluation Framework (GEF), the shared capability that measures whether AI agents running in production meet quality standards. This is a builder\-owner role. You own GEF as an internal product, which means you set the roadmap, decide what ships and what gets retired, and sequence which teams onboard. You also write the evaluators, pipelines, and reference implementations yourself. The framework already exists and has been proved in one production implementation with the Virtual Contact Assistant. The current work is turning that implementation into a product other teams adopt on its merits, since adoption across business units is voluntary. You will have the direct support of the Director of Machine Learning and AI on prioritization and executive alignment, and full latitude on the technical and product decisions inside GEF. **What You Will Own** * **GEF product roadmap.** Shared accountability with AI leaders of what ships next, what to generalize from the first production implementation, and what to deprecate. You help to maintain the roadmap and the reasoning behind it. * **Enablement queue.** You sequence which product teams onboard, when, and against what success criteria, and you negotiate that sequence with the teams involved. * **Framework build.** You implement and maintain LLM\-as\-judge, rule\-based, and statistical evaluators, and calibrate them against human\-labeled baselines. * **Evaluation pipelines.** You build and operate the pipelines that score agent traffic on a schedule and publish results to dashboards and the Cox Agent Registry. * **Golden datasets.** You work with product teams and subject matter experts to assemble, version, and maintain the datasets evaluation depends on. * **Onboarding and adoption.** You integrate GEF into adopting teams' agents, debug failures, and write the documentation and reference implementations that let the next team self\-serve. * **Quality reporting.** You publish framework adoption, agent quality health, and cost\-per\-quality metrics each month, and supply the audit trails and evaluation evidence governance reviews require. * **Agent instrumentation.** You help add tracing and logging to agent workflows and integrate evaluation checks into CI and deployment pipelines. **What Success Looks Like in Year One** * Three to four product teams onboarded to GEF, with golden datasets curated and evaluators calibrated against human baselines. * A published GEF roadmap that adopting teams and leadership both plan against. * Framework capability a new team can adopt from documentation and reference implementations without direct support. * Quality health published per registered agent in the Cox Agent Registry, on a monthly cadence, without manual assembly. * Pipelines that run reliably, with monitoring and runbooks that let someone else operate them. **Who You Will Work With** Inside the AI Accelerator: the engineers building GEF, the team embedded with the Virtual Contact Assistant pilot, and the broader CADS data science group. Across Cox Automotive: engineering and product teams at VinSolutions, Autotrader, Manheim, Dealertrack, and other business units as they onboard, plus Platform Engineering, Architecture, Enterprise AI, Security, and FinOps. **Required Qualifications** * Two or more years of professional machine learning engineering experience with a Bachelor's Degree, OR up to two years combined with a Master's Degree in a quantitative field. * Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. No OPT, CPT, STEM/OPT or visa sponsorship now or in future. * Must currently live within a commutable distance to Atlanta to be considered. * Experience owning the direction of a technical product, internal tool, library, or platform used by other teams. Formal product ownership is welcome, and so is having been the de facto owner of something other engineers depended on. * Ability to maintain a roadmap, set priorities among competing requests, and explain the tradeoffs to both engineers and product stakeholders. * Strong Python, with working habits around testing, version control, code review, and continuous integration. * Hands\-on experience building with large language models, including prompting, API integration, retrieval, or agent frameworks. * Working knowledge of measurement concepts such as sampling, inter\-rater agreement, precision and recall, or comparative testing. * Experience with cloud services, ideally AWS, and with building data pipelines. * Strong written communication, including documentation, roadmap updates, and reporting to senior stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Formal product ownership or technical product management experience for developer tools, infrastructure, or ML platforms. * Experience with evaluation tooling such as DeepEval, AWS Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations, Langfuse, or RAGAS. * Experience in a federated organization where adoption is voluntary and the product must win on merit. * Experience with observability and tracing tools such as OpenTelemetry or Datadog. * Exposure to model risk, AI governance, or work in a regulated environment. * Prior work at the intersection of data science teams and product or platform engineering. USD 92,300\.00 \- 153,900\.00 per year **Compensation:** Compensation includes a base salary in the range of $92,300\.00 \- $153,900\.00\. comparable), mobile, API (GraphQL/REST via Postman), and regression—integrated into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines. * Architect reusable, scalable, and maintainable automation components and frameworks, management, including compliant synthetic test data for PII\-sensitive scenarios. **Quality Engineering Excellence** * Champion quality as a shared engineering responsibility—embedding testability standards into how software is designed and built. * Partner with engineering architecture to align testing with architectural standards and DevSecOps practices. * Define and make visible quality metrics—escaped\-defect rate, automated coverage, test flakiness, and cycle\-time impact—through reporting and dashboards. * Drive measurable reduction of the regression bottleneck. **Release \& Delivery Quality** * Provide quality signals and gate recommendations into the release process. * Ensure regression and critical\-path coverage give teams the confidence to release faster. * Oversee functional, regression, performance, security, and UAT testing across web, mobile, API, and data layers. **Leadership within the Team** * Co\-lead a small group of quality engineers, manual testers, and off shore test engineers. * Uplift and direct the distributed employee/offshore testing team—raising automation skills and standards, and converting manual capacity toward automation. * Mentor engineers and testers, demonstrating the leadership behaviors that support growth into a formal QE leadership role. * Establish onboarding, standards, and ways of working that scale across distribut Agile/Scrum environment. * Experience with cloud environments (Azure preferred; AWS/GCP comparable). * Exposure to AI\-driven engineering or testing tools and methodologies. * Proven leadership or mentoring of distributed/offshore teams required. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: Description: We are seeking a hands\-on Forward\-Deployed Product Engineer to help maintain, support, and extend a portfolio of production software products. This is a coding role first — but it is a coding role for someone who wants to sit close to the business, talk directly to the people using the software, and own outcomes rather than tickets. You will work across the full software development lifecycle: scoping problems with stakeholders, designing the approach, writing the code, testing it, shipping it, and supporting it in production. Our stack centers on Angular and TypeScript on the front end, with Node.js, Firebase, Firestore, and Google Cloud Platform behind it, plus PostgreSQL where relational data is the right fit. Claude Code and other AI\-assisted development tools are part of our daily workflow. The ideal candidate is a practical software generalist with strong Angular fundamentals, genuine communication skills, and curiosity about why a feature is being requested in the first place. You will not only write code — you will help improve how our products are maintained, supported, tested, documented, and enhanced over time. **IS THIS ROLE FOR YOU?** ========================= You will work across several products and industries in a given quarter, and you will talk to the people who use what you build. If you want to go three years deep on a single product with a product manager between you and the customer, this is not that role. If you like variety, ownership, and direct contact with the business, it is a very good one. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** ========================================= **Engineering and Delivery** ---------------------------- * Own features end\-to\-end across multiple projects — from scoping conversations through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch support. * Maintain and evolve Angular front ends, including component and service architecture, RxJS, routing, state management, dependency updates, UI improvements, and cross\-browser compatibility. * Build and modify backend logic and services using Node.js and TypeScript, including Firebase Cloud Functions, scheduled jobs, and third\-party integrations. * Work confidently in inherited codebases you did not write, including applications of different vintages, conventions, and framework versions. * Perform safe refactoring, code cleanup, and modernization without creating unnecessary disruption for users. * Develop and maintain unit tests, integration tests, and release validation practices appropriate to the risk of each change. * Use Claude Code and other AI\-assisted development tools as a daily part of the workflow — reviewing, steering, and validating generated output rather than shipping it unexamined. **Platform, Data, and Cloud** ----------------------------- * Build and maintain Firebase and Google Cloud Platform backends, including Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, Hosting, and related services. * Design data models across both NoSQL (Firestore) and relational (PostgreSQL) stores, and exercise judgment about when each is the right tool. * Write and tune SQL queries, manage schema changes, and support reporting and data extract needs. * Implement and maintain Firestore security rules, authentication flows, and role\-based permissions. * Manage cloud resources with attention to uptime, security, performance, and cost efficiency. * Maintain version control discipline, deployment readiness, and CI/CD workflows. **Business Partnership and Product Ownership** ---------------------------------------------- * Sit in directly with business stakeholders and end users to translate vague or evolving problems into concrete technical requirements — then build the solution. * Ask why a feature is being requested, and push back constructively when there is a simpler, cheaper, or more durable approach. * Translate business needs into clear technical tasks, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans. * Contribute to estimation, sprint planning, prioritization, and roadmap conversations rather than waiting for fully specified tickets. * Develop working familiarity with the business context of each product — the industry, the workflow, and what it costs the customer when the software is wrong. * Communicate status, risk, and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical audiences in writing and in person. **Support, Release, and Documentation** --------------------------------------- * Serve as the technical owner for escalated support issues, determining whether an issue is user error, configuration, defect, data problem, or a feature request. * Investigate production issues, identify root causes, implement fixes, and put safeguards in place to prevent recurrence. * Own or support the release process, including deployment coordination, testing, release notes, and post\-launch follow\-up. * Maintain current technical documentation covering application architecture, integrations, code changes, troubleshooting steps, and release history. * Perform special projects and other duties as assigned. Requirements: * 3\+ years of relevant software development, SaaS engineering, application support, or product engineering experience preferred. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred, but equivalent hands\-on experience is fully acceptable. * Strong Angular fundamentals — components, services, RxJS, routing, and state management — deep enough to transfer across projects with different conventions and framework versions. * Solid TypeScript and JavaScript skills; comfortable working in a typed codebase and committed to keeping it that way. * Working Node.js experience for backend services, Cloud Functions, scripting, and integrations. * Hands\-on experience with Firebase and Google Cloud Platform, including Firestore, Authentication, Cloud Functions, and Hosting. * SQL fluency, ideally with PostgreSQL, including query writing, joins, and basic performance awareness. * Experience with Git, CI/CD concepts, deployment workflows, testing practices, bug tracking, and production troubleshooting. * Comfortable using AI\-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor while maintaining human review and quality control. * Genuinely strong written and verbal communication — able to explain a technical tradeoff to a non\-technical stakeholder and write a status update that does not generate follow\-up questions. * Comfort with ambiguity and frequent context\-switching across clients in different industries. * Self\-directed working style with light supervision — able to unblock yourself, and willing to escalate early when you cannot. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to support needs, and maintain professionalism under pressure. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ============================ * Prior consulting, agency, forward\-deployed engineering, or other client\-facing delivery experience. * Experience supporting an established SaaS product, legacy application, government software, legal or court software, or a regulated workflow platform. * Experience with public sector, records, filing, case management, document management, or workflow software. * Experience supporting or modernizing older Angular versions and migrating them forward. * Experience with APIs, authentication, permissions models, reporting tools, and system integrations. * Experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions or Cloud Build. * Experience with Jira, Zoho, Notion, Trello, GitHub Issues, or similar project and ticket tracking systems. * A track record of improving testing, documentation, deployment reliability, or developer productivity on a team. **CORE COMPETENCIES** ===================== End\-to\-End Ownership Angular Craftsmanship Cloud and Data Judgment Stakeholder Communication Business Curiosity Problem Solving Product Judgment AI\-Assisted Development Documentation Accountability Customer Service Mindset Continuous Improvement

jobs.title: IAM Engineer, Identity Governance (IGA & PAM)
jobs.description: * Job ID: 11236BR * Location: US (Remote) * Work Setup: Remote * Job Category: Information Technology * Posting Date: September 11, 2026 **Identity Governance \& Access Management / PAM** * Serve as the technical point of contact for all IGA implementation and development efforts. * Assist in the design and development of IGA connectors and integrations with enterprise applications — SaaS, on\-premise, and cloud. * Build and configure certification campaigns in Saviynt (user access reviews, entitlement certifications, role certifications), including workflows and decision routing. * Build and customize workflows, rules, roles, and policies in IGA to support provisioning, deprovisioning, and access reviews. * Build reviewer hierarchies and delegation rules so the correct approvers are assigned automatically. * Configure auto\-remediation so revocations flow into connected systems (AD, SaaS apps) without manual execution. * Extend governance into Privileged Access Management (PAM) — onboarding privileged accounts, vaults, and elevated entitlements into the same certification, workflow, and review model as standard access. * Implement and operate PAM controls including credential vaulting, session management, just\-in\-time (JIT) elevation, and privileged session monitoring. * Partners with security teams to reduce standing privilege and enforce least\-privilege access across critical systems. * Maintain the data quality behind certifications — identity correlation, role definitions, and application onboarding into Saviynt **Non\-Human \& Agentic Identity Governance** * Govern the full lifecycle of non\-human identities (NHIs) — service accounts, machine identities, secrets, and API credentials — including discovery, ownership assignment, risk\-tiering, and periodic recertification. * Extend the identity governance plane to AI agents — registering agents, scoping least\-privilege access via Saviynt, integrating with secrets management (e.g., Azure Key Vault), and enforcing runtime guardrails and approval gates. * Help eliminate shadow agents and orphaned NHIs through continuous discovery, dormancy detection, and drift alerts. **Automation \& AI\-Driven Engineering** * Champion an automation\-first approach — identifying manual identity and access processes that can be eliminated, self\-serviced, or fully automated. * Design and maintain automation using REST APIs, JSON, SQL, and scripting languages (PowerShell, Python, JavaScript). * Leverage AI\-powered tools and agents (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to accelerate connector development, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational insights. * Apply AI to enhance governance activities such as access reviews, anomaly detection, and reporting — including Saviynt’s native AI/rapid\-onboarding capabilities. **Compliance, Audit \& Operations** * Support audit readiness and access attestation for regulatory and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, SOC 1 / SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP). * Maintain the data quality behind certifications — identity correlation, role definitions, and application onboarding. * Own resolution of complex incidents and service requests through ITSM platforms (e.g., ServiceNow), ensuring SLA adherence, and mentor junior engineers on identity concepts and tooling. **Required Qualifications** * Strong understanding of IAM principles, including user lifecycle management, role\-based access control (RBAC), least privilege, and segregation of duties (SoD), and PAM. * 5\+ years of hands\-on IAM engineering experience, including deep, demonstrable expertise configuring and developing on Saviynt EIC (IGA). * Demonstrated experience with enterprise\-scale IAM implementations, ideally in organizations with hundreds of applications. * Proficient with REST APIs, JSON, SQL, and scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python, JavaScript). * Experience conducting or supporting access certification campaigns, audit activities, and compliance\-driven controls. * Familiarity with application infrastructure and architecture (Windows/Linux, cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, GCP). * Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, communication, and documentation skills. * Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast\-paced environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with PAM platforms, procedures, implementations, and best practices. (Privileged Access Management). * Experience governing non\-human and/or agentic (AI agent) identities and secrets management (e.g., Azure Key Vault). * Knowledge of Active Directory, Azure AD, and identity federation technologies (SAML, OAuth, OIDC). * Experience using AI tools and developing agents (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to improve operational efficiency. * Prior experience in regulated environments (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR). * IAM certifications (e.g., CIAM, CISSP, Saviynt Certified Professional) are a plus. * 5\+ years of hands\-on development experience with IGA, including configuration, workflows, and conn  recognized global standard for project\-based businesses, Deltek delivers software and information solutions to help organizations achieve their purpose. Our market leadership stems from the work of our diverse employees who are united by a passion for learning, growing and making a difference. At Deltek, we take immense pride in creating a balanced, values\-driven environment, where every employee feels included and empowered to do their best work. Our employees put our core values into action daily, creating a one\-of\-a\-kind culture that has been recognized globally. Thanks to our incredible team, Deltek has been named one of America’s Best Midsize Employers by Forbes, a Best Place to Work by Glassdoor, a Top Workplace by The Washington Post and a Best Place to Work in Asia by World HRD Congress. www.deltek.com At Deltek, security isn’t a gate at the end of the process — it’s in the foundation. Enterprise Security \& Technology Services (ESTS) brings together security, infrastructure, and technology operations under one organization, led by our CISO, with a mandate to make sure Deltek builds and operates with integrity at every layer. We’re a passionate team of technologists and security professionals who work across the entire company — embedded in how services are built, delivered, and supported. We run agile, we embrace intelligent automation to amplify what our people can do, and we hold ourselves to a high standard because the organizations that depend on Deltek’s platform are doing work that can’t afford mistakes. If you take your craft seriously, want visibility into how a complex, global technology organization really operates, and believe security should be a first principle — not an afterthought — this is a team that will feel like home. Certain roles may have additional privacy, security and compliance requirements to the extent they support Costpoint GCCM or similar product offerings. *Deltek, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.* Deltek, Inc., utilizes the E\-Verify program with every potential new hire. This makes it possible for us to make certain that every employee who works for Deltek is eligible to work in the United States. To learn more about E\-Verify you can call 1\-800\-255\-7688 or visit their website by clicking the logo below. E\-Verify® is a registered trademark of the United States Department of Homeland Security. Deltek is committed to the protection and promotion of your privacy. In connection with your application for employment with us at Deltek, it is necessary for us to collect, store and use information about you (“Personal Data”) to administer and evaluate your application. We are the “controller” of the Personal Data you provide us and will process any such Personal Data in accordance with applicable law and the statements contained in this Candidate Privacy Notice Additionally, we have not sold and do not sell Personal Data you provide to us through the job application process. **Important: Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Bad actors or scammers may try to impersonate Deltek and send fake job offers to people. jobs.description: We invite you to consider an opportunity with Denali to help achieve our goal of delivering meaningful therapeutics to patients. This role calls for a leader who sets the operational agenda, anticipates risks and opportunities, and brings them forward with a considered point of view. The successful candidate builds the management structures, operating cadences, and accountability mechanisms their team needs to execute reliably, and sustains operational standards through periods of change, attrition, or competing priorities. They exercise independent operational judgment, take ownership of outcomes, and lead through clarity of expectations, professional managerial standards, and accountability. They contribute an operational perspective to emerging strategies, including AI infrastructure. They manage a multidisciplinary team of employees, consultants, and contractors, with the function expected to scale alongside Denali’s South San Francisco, Salt Lake City, and Zurich operational footprint. **Key Responsibilities** **Leadership \& Architectural Partnership** ------------------------------------------- * Lead IT Infrastructure as a function, owning the operational agenda, operating rhythms, and standards by which the team executes * Build and maintain the management structures, operating cadences, escalation paths, and accountability mechanisms required for reliable delivery * Anticipate operational risks, capacity constraints, attrition, and capability gaps, and act in advance of service impact * Operate Platform Engineering decisions within architectural standards and governance forums set by Architecture, including the Architecture Review Board (ARB) for decisions of architectural significance; bring operational experience into architectural decisions and execute engineering work within architectural intent * Represent Platform Engineering \& Operations to peer functions at the appropriate working level; contribute operational perspective and recommendations to enterprise platform strategy, including AI infrastructure, FinOps, and modernization **Service Management \& Resilience** ------------------------------------ * Execute the unified Change Advisory Board (CAB) process integrating IT, SOX, and GxP change control, with leadership oversight on judgment calls of strategic or compliance significance; continuously mature change control as a strategic mechanism for risk\-managed delivery * Prepare and deliver Platforms\-area content, analysis, and follow\-through for the Quarterly Service Review (QSR) led by the Senior Director * Execute DR and BCP across platforms, including runbooks, failover testing, recovery validation, and RTO/RPO compliance; maintain DR/BCP as a continuously verified operational capability * Support the platform layer underpinning OT and manufacturing IT systems in partnership with the Manufacturing IT lead and Technical Operations * Partner with business and operational stakeholders during platform incidents or degradation events to evaluate operational impact, coordinate temporary workarounds, support continuity procedures, and prioritize restoration activities aligned to business risk and criticality **Platform Services \& Enterprise AI Infrastructure** ----------------------------------------------------- * Lead delivery and operation of Denali’s enterprise observability and integration platforms (e.g., Workato) as shared services, in partnership with Product as the primary business\-facing consumer * Evolve the team toward a platform engineering model with end\-to\-end lifecycle ownership, including Platform Engineer and Platform Reliability Engineer roles, governed by architectural standards * Lead the operational ramp of newly deployed enterprise platforms (e.g., SAP, MES, clinical data platforms) from project handoff into sustained operations * Lead operational delivery of the shared platform layer that supports enterprise AI, including runtime, controls, model access, monitoring, and operational governance * Deliver and operate validated infrastructure for AI workloads that touch regulated workflows, including security and integration architecture for safely connecting external AI partners * Implement and operate AI governance touchpoints in partnership with IT Risk, Quality, Legal, and Cybersecurity, including intake controls, access provisioning, audit trails, human\-in\-the\-loop enforcement for regulated outputs, detection of unauthorized AI usage, and AI/ML observability for output quality and drift * Apply AI within Platform Engineering \& Operations (AIOps, predictive incident detection, FinOps anomaly detection, automated remediation, AI\-assisted change risk scoring) **Security, Compliance \& Vulnerability Management** ---------------------------------------------------- * Operationalize vulnerability management and patching as sustained, measurable, SLA\-driven programs in partnership with Cybersecurity, including continuous discovery, prioritization, remediation,  form operations in alignment with SOX ITGCs and GxP requirements, ensuring audit\-ready evidence; partner with IT Risk on in\-scope systems including SAP support **Vendor \& People Leadership** ------------------------------- * Lead operational management of Managed Service Providers, including SLA enforcement, performance management, and day\-to\-day vendor relationships * Proactively manage the consultant and contractor workforce, anticipating capacity gaps and ensuring continuity of capability ahead of disruptions Lead, develop, and grow the team; set clear expectations, performance standards, and accountability; build team operating cadences, on\-call rotations, and capacity planning * **Required Qualifications** * 9\+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant time in platform engineering, infrastructure, IT service management, or IT operations * 3\+ years of direct team leadership experience, including building management structures, operating cadences, and accountability mechanisms required for reliable team delivery * Demonstrated experience setting and driving the operational agenda for a function and contributing operational perspective to enterprise or cross\-functional strategy decisions, with specific examples of identifying what needed attention and what was brought to the table * Demonstrated experience holding operational standards through attrition, competing priorities, or pressure to deprioritize, with specific examples * Demonstrated experience operationalizing vulnerability management, patching, or comparable sustained operational disciplines as measurable, SLA\-driven programs * Demonstrated experience operating Platform Engineering within an architectural governance framework, including productive engagement with Architecture functions * Direct experience operating in a regulated life sciences environment with working knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, and SOX ITGC requirements * Hands\-on experience operating ITIL\-aligned service management (incident, change, problem, service level) * Experience operating enterprise network, virtualization, multi\-cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), backup and restore, observability tooling, and enterprise AI infrastructure or comparable shared platform services Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to brief senior leaders concisely with considered recommendations * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a commercial\-stage biotech or pharmaceutical company jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **About Us** We're a leading global media agency shaping the future of content, advertising, and audience engagement. As part of dentsu's global Data \& Technology organization, we're building the AI behind dentsu's next\-generation platform — frontier AI and real production engineering applied to media, creative, strategy, audiences, and optimization. You'll get startup\-level ownership and speed with dentsu\-scale reach and data, working on high\-visibility products. **Role Overview** As an AI Engineer, you will design, build, and deploy artificial intelligence capabilities that drive business value and enhance our global products. You will work cross\-functionally with product managers, data scientists, engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable AI systems for content personalization, audience analytics, creative optimization, and more. **Key Responsibilities** * AI Solution Development: Architect, develop, and maintain AI systems for media products. * Collaboration: Partner with product, engineering, and data teams to translate business needs into technical solutions. * Deployment \& Scaling: Implement AI systems in production environments, ensuring reliability, scalability, and performance across global markets. * Continuous Improvement: Monitor, evaluate, and iterate on AI models using real\-world data and feedback. * Research \& Innovation: Stay current with AI/ML advancements; prototype and recommend new technologies to keep our products at the forefront of innovation. * Ethics \& Compliance: Champion responsible AI practices, ensuring fairness, transparency, and compliance with data privacy regulations. **Requirements** **Must Have** * Masters Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (PhD a plus). * Strong Python skills (3\+ years) with production systems, not just experimentation and prototyping * Demonstrated experience (1\+ years) with enterprise LLMs – their APIs, performance challenges, and how to mitigate those (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, etc.) * Demonstrated production experience (3\+ years) with API conventions and integration into pipelines, e.g. RESTful API, FastAPI, or similar. * Demonstrated experience (2\+ years) integrating multiple approaches for extracting highest\-quality output from LLMs, e.g. prompt engineering, multi\-agents, structured output validation, hybrid RAG, in\-context learning (ICL), or NLP\- or ontology\-powered layering. * Demonstrated production experience (4\+ years) measuring and improving AI systems or traditional ML systems. **Nice to Have** * Proficiency with traditional NLP and document processing pipelines (text extraction, chunking, embedding) * Strong foundation in data science fundamentals, including data analysis, statistical methods, and experience working with structured and unstructured data * Experience in LLM orchestration libraries (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel), chain\-of\-thought, and structured reasoning approaches. * Experience with tracing (e.g. Arize, jobs.title: AI Governance Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Dentsu is operationalizing AI at scale. Across every brand and practice, business teams are identifying AI\-powered tools, platforms, and vendors they want to deploy — and they need a fast, expert path through the governance process to do it safely. The AI Governance Concierge Service is dentsu's answer to that challenge — a dedicated, end\-to\-end service that gives any Americas business team a single expert point of contact for AI product adoption. The AI Governance Engineer is the process navigator, program manager, and technical implementer of the service. Working in close coordination with the AI Governance Service Lead, the Governance Engineer receives each submission package approved by the Lead, thoroughly understands its contents — the business case, the vendor research, the risk profile, and the policy alignment — and takes full ownership of driving it through the cross\-functional review process. The Engineer is expected to speak to the details of every submission they manage, serve as the knowledgeable point of contact for all reviewing functions, coordinate with the Analyst when additional research or documentation is needed, and own the end\-to\-end implementation once approval is granted. This role ensures nothing stalls, nothing is lost, and every engagement crosses the finish line. The AI Governance Concierge Service is not simply an approval function — it is a service built around bringing every engagement to a successful conclusion. That means approving solutions that meet dentsu's standards, identifying alternative products or approaches that address the business need within governance requirements, and providing solutions that facilitate approval where possible. When risks are identified that prevent approval, the service's role is to clearly document and communicate those risks and leave the decision to the business to weigh the risk and reward. Success is a business team that always has a clear path forward — not just a ruling. **What You Will Do** **Submission Intake \& Program Management** * Receive and thoroughly review each submission package approved by the Service Lead — developing a deep understanding of the business case, vendor research, risk profile, and policy rationale before the review process begins. * Project\-manage each submission through the full review lifecycle in AIRS and TPSA — tracking every open item, deadline, and reviewer action from submission to final determination. * Set and communicate the review schedule for each submission based on priorities identified and communicated by the Lead; maintain that schedule actively throughout the review and implementation phases. * Update the AI Concierge Program Tracker with accurate, real\-time progress during the review and implementation phases, ensuring the Service Lead always has a current view across all active engagements. * Work closely with the Analyst when reviewers require additional research, documentation, or clarification — coordinating the request clearly, reviewing what comes back for completeness, and routing it to the appropriate reviewing function without delay. * Report status, progress, and blockers to the Service Lead on a regular cadence, enabling the Lead to keep the business team accurately informed at all times. **Cross\-Functional Review \& Relationships** * Build and maintain trusted working relationships with counterparts in Legal, Information Security, Data Privacy, Emerging Technology, and Procurement — positioning the Concierge Service as an organized, reliable partner that makes their review process easier, not harder. * Shepherd each submission through the full cross\-functional review process — serving as the knowledgeable, primary point of contact for all reviewing functions, engaging each group with the context and detail they need to review confidently. * Partner with Global Enterprise Technology to shepherd each request through the review process, ensure Global Enterprise Technology's requirements are met at the engagement level, and coordinate the technical backend of implementation. * Translate technical and legal concerns from reviewers back to the Service Lead and Analyst in plain language — enabling accurate communication to the business team and ensuring the Analyst has what they need to produce any required follow\-up documentation. **Escalation \& Risk Management** * Identify blockers within the governance or review process and surface them to the Service Lead immediately with clear context and recommended resolution paths. * Own the follow\-through on blockers — actively working to resolve open items, maintaining momentum on stalled submissions, and not waiting for issues to resolve themselves. * Escalate risk\-flagged items to the Service Lead and relevant stakeholders; document disposition rationale for all escalated items. **Implementation \& Delivery** * Upon approval, own and coordinate the full implementation of each approved solution — working w n, and clear communication. * Clear, precise communicator — able to translate between technical, legal, and business audiences without losing accuracy in either direction. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a media, marketing, advertising, or professional services organization. * Familiarity with GenAI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO 42001\) or data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA). * Hands\-on experience with enterprise AI platforms (Claude Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, or similar) and their enterprise deployment requirements. * Background in vendor risk assessment, third\-party due diligence, or enterprise technology procurement. * Experience with Coupa, ServiceNow, OneTrust, or similar enterprise workflow and compliance platforms. * IAPP AIGP, CIPP, CISSP, PMP, or equivalent certification is a plus. **What Success Looks Like** In your first 90 days, you have taken ownership of the active submission queue, established working relationships with your counterparts in Legal, Privacy, Security, Emerging Technology, Procurement, and Global Enterprise Technology, and can speak confidently to the details of every submission in your queue. You have a clear, documented view of where every open engagement stands and what is needed to move each one forward. At six months, the average time\-to\-approval has measurably decreased. No submission goes dark — every open item has an owner, a deadline, and a next action. Reviewing functions know who you are and trust that you come prepared. You have completed at least one end\-to\-end implementation, and the Analyst rarely needs to be pulled back into a submission once it has entered your review queue. At one year, the Governance Engineer function is recognized across the review community as a reliable, organized partner. The implementation pipeline is clean, the CSDM is accurate, and the post\-launch review process is a standard part of every engagement. Your process improvements have meaningfully reduced the manual effort required to move a submission from intake to closure. The annual salary range for this position is $82,500 \- $130,000\. jobs.description: The purpose of this role is to develop best in class strategies and management of all Insights and Analysis activity on assigned clients, to manage and develop the team and serve as a point of escalation as needed.**Job Description:** Merkle's Commerce Analytics \& Intelligence practice helps the world's largest retailers, brands, and marketplaces turn data into decisions across the four Ps — product, price, promotion, and place — and against the competitive market. We are moving from an embedded, staff\-augmentation delivery model to a craft\-led consultancy: named specialists organized by discipline, US\-onshore leadership in front of a global delivery engine, and value measured by the decisions we enable rather than the hours we bill. The Director, Commerce Analytics is a US\-based onshore craft leader accountable for one of our largest enterprise accounts. You pair fluent business acumen with a strong technical foundation — AI and machine learning, Python, SQL, and cloud computation — and you use both to own the analytics craft end to end: consumer decision modeling, pricing and promotion, assortment and space, and competitive intelligence. You lead a blended onshore/offshore pod, sit at the client's table as a trusted advisor, and translate business need into a delivery plan the offshore engine executes. This is a build role: you are shaping how the practice operates as much as running the work. **What you will own** * **Client partnership.**Be the senior analytics voice the client relies on — present the standard rather than wait for the ask, bring proposals not order\-taking, and hold the relationship at the business\-decision altitude, not the report altitude. * **The craft.**Own the analytics discipline across the account: consumer decision modeling and the semantic/decisioning layer, pricing and promotion, assortment and localization, digital shelf and competitive intelligence — the me\-vs\-market view of the four Ps. * **A blended pod.**Lead a flat, project\-based team drawn from a single global Merkle pool — onshore practitioners in front, offshore engineering and data\-science engines behind. You have sat on the merchant or business side of these decisions, not just the reporting side. * **Consulting and client leadership.**You have led senior client relationships as a trusted advisor, set the analytical standard, and navigated a large, matrixed client organization — comfortable proposing the path rather than executing a spec. * **Onshore/offshore delivery leadership.**You have led blended teams across time zones and shores, translated business intent into a technical plan, and held delivery quality and dates without a heavy management layer beneath you. * **A build\-and\-shepherd temperament.**You set standards, raise risks early, escalate rather than absorb, and grow people by the work they lead — not by title. **What sets the strongest candidates apart** * Direct experience inside a big\-box or enterprise retailer's merchandising, category management, pricing, or online organization. * Experience standing up a decisioning or semantic\-layer product, business decision engines — taking it from concept to a governed, enterprise\-wide capability. * A track record of converting a delivery relationship into a strategic, consultative partnership — and growing it. **How this role fits** This Director sits within Merkle's DBT\-aligned Commerce Analytics practice, reporting into practice leadership, with account P\&L owned above the role. You will work closely with partners across product, engineering, design, policy, legal, and Trust and Safety to design and deliver effective ML solutions. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Machine Learning, Safety. Strong coding skills in Python and fluency in ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow. Experience building performant machine learning systems at scale and have driven the execution of projects from ideation to production. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). **What you'll do** ------------------ Our Digital Technology Services team is in the business of trust and reliability. We create, maintain and operate scalable technology and data solutions that deliver an exceptional experience for our internal \& external customers. We embrace Agile principles and values, favor DevOps practices, and view infrastructure as code, all while we create an SW infrastructure that scales and supports our growth and ambitious vision. This requires a smart, highly collaborative team who can identify, investigate, and implement new technologies to continue securely scaling our global business. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and scale intelligent, enterprise\-grade software solutions, with a strong focus on agentic Al systems and complex integrations across Application Engineering platforms. This role is a hands\-on engineering position requiring deep expertise in software design, distributed systems, APIs, and Al\-enabled architectures, rather than functional system configuration. The Senior Software Engineer will develop and operate custom\-built applications, Al agents, middleware services, and integration frameworks that connect core technology platforms with enterprise and external systems. A key aspect of this role is the application of agentic Al patterns, including orchestration, tool\-using agents, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and workflow automation, to improve system intelligence, resilience, and developer productivity. This role partners closely with Product Management, Enterprise Architecture, and technology stakeholders but remains fundamentally an engineering role, accountable for code quality, system reliability, scalability, and security. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director, Application Support and Operations. **Responsibility** * Conduct applied Al research to translate theoretical GenAl advancements into production\-ready software features * Lead Technical Feasibility Studies and rapid prototyping to provide the engineering foundation for "build vs. buy" architectural decisions * Engineer Production\-Grade NLP algorithms and information retrieval systems using SpaCy, NLTK, and Hugging Face to drive core product capabilities * Design, build, and maintain scalable RAG architectures that connect foundational Large Language Models (LLMs) to proprietary enterprise databases * Evaluate and apply appropriate embedding models, vector databases, and LLMs based on cost, latency, security, and performance requirements * Build enterprise\-grade conversational interfaces and analytical Al tools (QueryGPT) that interface directly with structured data systems via custom middleware * Design and Build autonomous multi\-agent frameworks (e.g., CrewAl, LangGraph) and scalable agentic platforms, focusing on distributed system architecture and secure execution environments * Develop Custom Extensions and API\-based integrations for LLM models, creating sophisticated Al assistants through backend systems programming * Execute Model Engineering through supervised fine\-tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) to optimize model weight distribution for scalability and reliability * Develop algorithmic prompt\-chaining logic and maintain a centralized, version\-controlled prompt library integrated into the CI/CD pipeline * Architect and Develop end\-to\-end evaluation pipelines for LLMs/SLMs, Engineering complex telemetry to capture performance, quantization efficiency, and fine\-tuning convergence metrics * Own the technical documentation, code maintainability, and reproducibility of the Al infrastructure, ensuring alignment with engineering excellence standards * Bridge time zones effectively; ensure crisp handoffs and decision velocity with US counterparts **Job Designation** ------------------- **Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation) Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions Experience with any copilot tools for coding such as Github copilot or Cursor * Experience with vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, and Chroma for embedding storage and retrieval * Experience with data preprocessing, augmentation, and visualization techniques * Experience contributing to GenAl projects from ideation through deployment, iteration, and evaluation of LLM performance * Experience working with containerization and orchestration technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS ECS * Experience with key AWS services including VPC, IAM, MWAA (Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow), and ECS * Experience with software development best practices including Git, testing, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform), automation, and MLOps for GenAl **Preferred** * Strong commitment to engineering excellence through automation, innovation, and documentation * One or more certifications such as Cloud, Solution Architect, Technical Architect, or GenAl\-related certifications * Proficiency in cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to think creatively * Strong collaboration skills in cross\-functional teams (Product, Design, ML, Data Engineering) * Ability to explain complex GenAl concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders **Wage Transparency** --------------------- Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations: California: $164,700\.00 \- $266,000\.00 base salary This role is also eligible for the following: * Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre\-established sales goals. Non\-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance. * Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Global benefits provide options for the following: * Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region * Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement * Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment * Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions * Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements * Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life\-changing events **Life at Docusign** -------------------- **Working here** Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. **Accommodation** Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com. If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Cost Visibility
jobs.description: **Location** The senior Full\-Stack Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams in EMEA.This role is based remotely as a full\-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal. **Who We Are** DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud\-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well\-architected and scalable state \- from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency. With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award\-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide. **The Opportunity** AI is the fastest\-growing line on our customers' cloud bills \- and the hardest one to see. Model APIs, managed inference, GPUs, and a growing fleet of agentic coding tools each report spend differently, and most teams still can't answer the basic questions: what are we spending, on which workloads, for which teams, and is it worth it. Our AI cost visibility product, part of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, exists to answer them. We're hiring a Senior Full\-Stack Engineer into our R\&D team to own this product end\-to\-end \- from the Go services that ingest and model AI spend, through the APIs that expose it, to the React interfaces where FinOps practitioners and platform engineers make decisions. This is a young product in a category being defined right now. You'll shape how it works, not just implement someone else's spec, and there is a short line from your work to what customers see. You'll work AI\-augmented from day one. We expect you to use AI across your whole workflow \- not as an occasional autocomplete \- and to have real opinions about where it earns its place and where it doesn't. **Responsibilities** * Owning features end\-to\-end. This is the core of the role. Take a problem from understanding the customer's pain, through design and implementation, to release, monitoring and iteration. You define what done looks like and you own the outcome \- reliability, user experience and measurable impact included. Propose the work you think should happen; you're not here to wait for a spec. * Knowing the product and the domain. Understand how AI spend actually works \- token and model pricing, inference and GPU economics, how usage rolls up to teams and initiatives \- and how FinOps practitioners reason about it. You should be able to explain why a feature matters to a customer as clearly as how it's built, and bring that judgement into every design decision. * Working AI\-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work \- exploring the codebase and unfamiliar vendor APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar. * Full\-stack delivery. Design, build and scale backend services in Go and product experiences in TypeScript and React. Turn large volumes of cost and usage data into interfaces that make the answer obvious \- clear, fast and trustworthy enough to base financial decisions on. * API\-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform. Raising the bar. As a senior engineer, set the standard for the team: thoughtful design reviews, guard\-rails that let customers succeed, and engineering practices that let us move fast without breaking trust. Mentor peers and share what you learn. **Qualifications** * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including multi\-tenant SaaS products, with a track record of owning features or products end\-to\-end in production * Strong Go for backend services \- APIs, data processing, and the operational realities of running them * Strong TypeScript and modern React, with a good eye for how data should be presented * Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the data model through to the interface * Experience building on public cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure), and working proficiency in SQL against an analytical store such as BigQuery * Product\-oriented thinking \- you care as much about why you're building something and whether it works for users as you do about how it's built * AI\-augmented working style \- you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them, and where they fell short * Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles, and the ability to set direction for others * Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast\-moving market \- you can figure out the right problem to solve, not just the right solution * Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal Self\-organized, goal\-oriented and self\-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious **Bonus Points** * Knowledge of FinOps and FinOps products would be a strong plus. * BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience. * Demonstrating a portfolio of what you've built in your career so far **Are you a Do'er?** Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference. We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally. What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values. Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page. We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button. Full\-time employee benefits include: * Unlimited Vacation * Flexible Working Options * Health Insurance * Parental Leave * Employee Stock Option Plan * Home Office Allowance * Professional Development Stipend * Peer Recognition Program **Many Do'ers, One Team DoiT** unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal\-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Systems
jobs.description: Job description Company and benefits Social Impact \& Sustainability Job ID 41663 **About Us** Dolby Cloud Solutions is a video streaming software company that helps enterprise and mid\-market organizations deliver exceptional audio and video experiences to their audiences. The Dolby OptiView SaaS platform serves a growing portfolio of customers across media, advertising, and real\-time communications — with a mission to make immersive video experiences accessible and scalable for everyone. **About This Role** Dolby Cloud Solutions is embedding AI into the core of how it operates — not as a side project, but as a fundamental shift in how work gets done across the business. The philosophy guiding this work is simple: AI prepares, humans decide. This is a Staff\-level engineering role at the center of that effort. You will own the technical architecture of the shared AI infrastructure that DCS teams build their business processes on — and you will build specific solutions on top of it. You will define the patterns, standards, and integration approaches that others follow, and serve as the technical authority when architectural decisions need to be made. Business problems are owned by business stakeholders. You will work closely with those stakeholders — helping shape requirements and acceptance criteria where needed, then owning the build end to end. You will also collaborate with OptiView Product Engineering on shared infrastructure and systems integration, and engage Product Engineering when platform features or APIs need to be developed to support the work. **What You'll Do** **Own the AI systems architecture** * Define the technical architecture of the shared data and integration layer — not just build it, but set the standards and patterns that others build on top of * Establish integration patterns, credential management standards, and data access models that scale across teams and systems * Ensure the infrastructure is secure, observable, and operable — not just functional at launch **Build and integrate across systems** * Architect and implement the foundational data and integration layer that enables AI agents and applications to operate reliably across business functions * Build and maintain integrations between business systems — CRM, billing, support, product usage, and more — so that data flows where it needs to go * Collaborate with Product Engineering on shared infrastructure, systems integration, and platform capabilities — you know when to build and when to align * Configure and manage MCP servers and API connections to internal systems, with proper credential management and security controls * Stand up shared hosting infrastructure for agents, automations, and applications, moving work off local workstations and into production environments * Build scheduled automations and event\-driven workflows that run reliably without manual intervention **Deliver business solutions** * Work with business stakeholders to understand problems, refine requirements, and define acceptance criteria — then own the build * Develop customer\-facing and internal applications from requirements and user stories — these may be web applications, headless services, agentic flows, or a combination * Build AI\-powered workflows for business teams including customer health monitoring, automated alerts, meeting intelligence, and revenue lifecycle automation * Iterate rapidly: deploy working software, collect feedback, and improve **Raise the technical floor across DCS** * Set the technical bar for how AI systems are built, integrated, and maintained across the organization — your decisions become the standard others follow * Maintain a shared repository of prompts, agents, skills, and workflows organized for reuse across teams * Help colleagues across Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Finance build and deploy their own AI solutions on the shared infrastructure **What You Bring** **Required** * 5\+ years building production software — applications, APIs, backend services, platform infrastructure, or data integrations — with a demonstrated track record of leveraging AI\-assisted development tools (Devin, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as a core part of engineering delivery * Proven experience making architectural decisions, set technical standards, and influenced how an engineering organization builds * Strong with Python or TypeScript/Node.js; comfortable picking up whatever the job requires * Experience building tool\-use integrations for AI systems; familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar protocols/frameworks is strongly preferred * Proven experience integrating with SaaS APIs (REST, webhooks, OAuth) — you have connected real business systems and understand the edge cases * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic frameworks — you have built production agents or AI\-powered workflows, not just prototypes * Comfortable working with business stakeholders — you can participate in requirements discussions, ask the right questions, push back constructively, and translate business intent into working software * Experienced collaborating with product and platform engineering teams — you know how to articulate what you need, align on approach, and get things built across team boundaries * Security\-conscious: you understand data classification, access controls, API credentials, compliance requirements, and risk management principles, and you incorporate them into the systems you build **Strong Plus** * Experience designing federated data layers, shared integration infrastructure, or multi\-system data pipelines * Familiarity with common SaaS business systems used in revenue, support, or customer success operations * Background in Customer Success, RevOps, or SaaS B2B — you understand the business domain you're building for * Experience incorporating data classification, compliance, security, and risk assessment considerations into the design and operation of AI\-powered systems and business automations

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Developer Experience, Web
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ Our mission is to provide a world\-class development experience that makes DoorDash's web engineers among the most productive in the industry. We achieve this by creating the tools that enable all teams at the company to ship features quickly and reliably. Because their success is our success, we are deeply invested in building a strong, collaborative web community that champions best practices and welcomes participation. **About the Role** ------------------ As a Software Engineer on the Developer Experience team, you will build the foundational pieces for all DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo Web applications. These include monorepos, build \& CI systems and agent\-first development tooling. You will work closely with engineers and other internal stakeholders to deliver large and impactful initiatives. Additionally, you will be a culture carrier for our Web engineers through mentorship, education, and engagement of your peers. You will report into the Engineering Manager of our Web Developer Experience team in our Developer Platform organization. You must be located in either San Francisco, CA, Sunnyvale, CA, Los Angeles, CA, Seattle, WA, or New York, NY. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will…** ----------------------------------------------------------- * **Shape the future of Web Development.** You will have a direct and meaningful impact on the daily workflows of every web engineer at the company, enhancing their productivity and overall developer experience. * **Build from the ground up.** You will architect and implement foundational libraries, cutting\-edge build systems, and innovative development tools that serve as the bedrock for all of our web applications. * **Solve complex, high\-impact challenges.** You will tackle some of the most significant technical hurdles in web engineering, and the solutions you deliver will be leveraged by hundreds of employees across numerous product teams. * **Act as a force multiplier.** Your work will directly empower product teams to build, test, and release new features to our customers faster and more reliably than ever before. * **Lead and mentor.** You will have the opportunity to guide and influence the web engineering community, sharing your expertise, promoting best practices, and fostering a culture of technical excellence and collaboration. * **Collaborate across the organization.** You will work in a highly cross\-functional environment, partnering with a diverse group of engineers, product managers, and leaders to drive critical initiatives forward. **We're excited about you because…** ------------------------------------ * You have deep expertise in the Node.js and TypeScript ecosystem. * You are comfortable shipping important changes in large, complex codebases and monorepos without full context. * You enjoy helping developers ship web applications quickly and securely, using user feedback and data to focus on high impact work. * You are passionate about using emerging AI tools and helping others adopt them to work more effectively. * You are an organized and excellent written and verbal communicator. * You have proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our merchant partners to consumers. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data
jobs.description: **About Doximity** Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity's AI\-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300\+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you. ***About the Role*** * ***Foremost a software engineer****.* You exemplify high code quality and guide others, and have at least **5 years** of industry experience as a data engineer or similar role. + You are experienced in creating automated testing, applying design patterns, and other engineering best practices. + You are an expert in Python and possess fluency in SQL and have developed maintainable data pipelines with each. * ***Hands\-on with architecting solutions.*** You have designed several data pipelines from start to finish. incident response, escalation, service restoration and sustainable on\-call operations across the organization. * Reduce operational toil and unnecessary manual intervention through software, automation, reusable patterns, and better engineering practices. **Leveling Intent** Principal represents domain\-level technical leadership and organizational impact. jobs.description: Eaton’s Electrical Critical Power Solutions Division is currently seeking a Lead Mechanical Engineer to join our team in Richmond, VA. Eaton’s Electrical Data Center Power Distribution division designs, manufactures, and services Static Transfer Switches (STS), Power Distribution Units (PDU), Remote Power Panels (RPP), and Dry\-Type transformers products to ensure power reliability in the most demanding applications. Our employees deliver mission\-critical solutions to our customers’ most challenging energy management requirements. The Lead Mechanical Engineer is responsible for supervising the mechanical design and development of product lines, contributing to project design, development, and prototype production. This role is essential in a cross\-functional team, making key design decisions for integration. The Lead Mechanical Engineer mentors junior staff, researches, evaluates, and documents design methods to meet standards and codes, and supports management throughout development. The expected annual salary range for this role is $97000 \- $143000 a year. Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. When we embrace the different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds that make each of us unique, we — as individuals and as a company — are stronger. **Qualifications:** ------------------- **Required (Basic) Qualifications:** • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering from an accredited institution with minimum five (5\) years of experience in mechanical design OR a Master’s degree in Engineering from an accredited institution with a minimum of three (3\) years work experience in mechanical design **Preferred Qualifications:** • Experience developing products from concept to manufacturing launch. • In depth knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) techniques. • Proficiency with 3D Mechanical CAD tools, including complex assemblies, sheet metal design, and creation of detailed manufacturing drawings. • Strong working knowledge of sheet metal fabrication, weldments, structural frames, and enclosure‑based designs used in electrical and industrial applications. • Experience using Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems for BOM management, configuration control, and engineering change processes (ECR/ECO). • Familiarity with ERP systems and understanding of how engineering data interfaces with manufacturing, sourcing, and cost control. • Experience with Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) methodology and participation in DFMEA, cost‑reduction, and manufacturability improvement initiatives. • Understanding of mechanical considerations tied to electrical compliance, including creepage and clearance support, grounding provisions, enclosure integrity, serviceability, seismic requirements, and safety‑related features. • Experience contributing to or leading New Product Introduction (NPI) projects, including prototype builds, design reviews, verification and validation, and release to production. • Demonstrated ability to mentor junior engineers and designers, provide technical direction, and support formal design reviews and standards adherence. **Skills:** ----------- **Position Criteria:** * Ability to understand the needs of the business and ability to make wise decisions to maintain customer satisfaction and Eaton quality and profitability * Mentor – can work with less experienced engineers and designer to provide meaningful feedback about design implications * Ability to work autonomously and shift to a team internal staff/peers and stakeholders, strong verbal and written documentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
