jobs.title: AI Marketing Engineer: Digital & Lifecycle
jobs.description: **Reports to:** Director of AI Driven Marketing \& Grid Services Revenue **Department:** Marketing **Location:** Hybrid in Littleton, CO **About Emporia Energy** Emporia is a leading technology company revolutionizing home energy by providing affordable, integrated solutions that empower homeowners to optimize energy usage to reduce costs and carbon footprint. Emporia’s Home Energy Management Platform is a powerful software system that connects their Vue Home Energy Monitor, Level 2 EV Charger, Smart Plugs, Home Battery, and third\-party thermostats and appliances. By automating energy use through real\-time monitoring and scheduling, the platform optimizes consumption, reduces costs, and simplifies home energy management—all within one intuitive app. With over 400,000 U.S. homes running Emporia’s energy management and EV charging hardware, we are now launching a national Third\-Party Owned (TPO) home battery Virtual Power Plant — placing industrial\-rated home batteries in residential homes to deliver power redundancy, utility cost savings, and grid peak demand services. By reducing energy waste and saving customers money, we’re helping create a healthier planet and a brighter future. For more information, visit emporiaenergy.com. **Mission, Vision and Values** Emporia was founded in 2018 with a clear purpose to revolutionize home energy, generate tangible customer savings, and accelerate the transition to a lower carbon future. We are striving to become the world's leading home energy management platform and build the largest virtual power plant. * **Customers First**: We deliver exceptional service with empathy and responsiveness, building lasting trust in every interaction. * **Own the Outcome**: We think like owners, taking responsibility for results and holding ourselves and each other accountable. * **Win Together**: We succeed together through honesty, humility and humanity. * **Grit Gets it Done**: We work hard, stay passionate, and persevere through challenges. * **Better Every Day**: We challenge the status quo, take smart risks and aim to improve 1% every day. **Role Overview** Emporia is hiring an AI Marketing Engineer: Digital \& Lifecycle to build and operate the systems behind customer lifecycle marketing. This role owns the digital, CRM, and lifecycle infrastructure that lets Emporia's marketing team segment customers, trigger communications from real behavior, test experiences, and use AI to increase the speed and scale of execution. They also own the day\-to\-day website: content, updates, and fielding requests as they come in. This is a results\-driven marketing role. You will define how your work is measured, build the tracking needed to measure it, and hold yourself accountable for whether what you ship actually improves customer behavior and business results. Marketing and Creative leadership own Emporia's campaign calendar and brand strategy. On a small team, everyone briefs and everyone touches creative, and this role is no exception. When you build the automation, you also own getting the right message in front of the right customer: writing the brief, partnering with the designer through to the finished asset, and loading it into the system you built. As an AI\-native marketer you will approach marketing as a system to be designed, not a series of tasks to be completed. You will look for ways AI and automation can own execution at scale, while deliberately reserving human involvement for the decisions, exceptions, and judgment where it creates real value. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **CRM, Lifecycle \& Measurement** * Own Emporia’s CRM and lifecycle platform, including customer data, segmentation, integrations, deliverability, and reporting. * Build automated journeys across onboarding, product adoption, cross\-sell, retention, and program enrollment. * Build AI\-native workflows for personalization, content, segmentation, analysis, and other lifecycle needs, designing for autonomous execution where appropriate rather than simply using AI to make manual work faster. * Build for reliability: monitor automated workflows, fix recurring problems at the system level, and maintain the documentation needed to keep critical systems running. * Build the tracking and reporting needed to measure funnel performance, campaign impact, and business outcomes. * Design and implement experiments with clear hypotheses and success metrics; use the results to decide what to scale, change, or stop. **Website Execution** * Own day\-to\-day execution of Emporia's website: page updates, content changes, and new landing pages tied to active campaigns and program launches. * Field and prioritize website requests from other teams. Keep a clear queue so nothing sits unaddressed. * Keep site content and messaging current as offers, programs, and pricing change. * Use AI development tools to build or update lightweight web pages and landing experiences without waiting on Engineering for routine chan nd automation work against the highest\-value company opportunities. * Partner with Creative, Product, Analytics, and other teams when the work crosses systems or functions. * Surface dependencies, risks, and limitations early rather than letting them become blockers. **Required Qualifications: What You'll Bring** * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, marketing automation, marketing operations, or a related role. * Experience owning or administering a marketing platform such as HubSpot, Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or a similar system. * Experience building lifecycle programs and experiments where you were accountable for measurable improvements in conversion, engagement, retention, revenue, or another defined business outcome. * Practical experience using AI tools in real workflows, beyond a consumer chat interface. * Experience designing AI workflows, including prompts, business rules, monitoring, and deciding where human review adds value versus unnecessary friction. * Comfort working with APIs, webhooks, data integrations, and the basic mechanics of how systems exchange information. * Comfortable making content updates and lightweight builds on a website or CMS platform, and fielding requests from other teams without letting them pile up. * Strong analytical instincts. You can define KPIs, instrument tracking, build useful reporting, interpret results, and turn what the data says into the next action. * A builder's mindset. You are curious, persistent and comfortable getting into the platform, diagnosing a problem, and fixing it. * Genuine consumer instinct / always putting the customer at the center of your strategy. You can look at a segment and have a real point of view on what will move them, beyond how to target them. * Comfortable writing creative briefs and partnering with a designer through to a finished asset. This role owns creative execution for what it builds, beyond the automation behind it. **What We Offer** **Compensation**: The expected base salary range is **$85,000 \- $110,000**, plus stock options. The offered salary will depend on numerous factors, including but not limited to work experience, skills, and internal equity considerations. The base salary does not include benefits or other incentives. **Benefits**: medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), employee stock option program, paid holidays plus unlimited PTO, discounts on Emporia products and partner offerings. **Career Growth**: Be part of a fast\-growing company at the forefront of home energy innovation. Emporia Energy is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, sex, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, results of genetic testing, service in the military, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. We will make reasonable accommodations for any qualified applicant with a disability, provided that the individual is otherwise qualified to safely perform the essential functions of the job with or without accommodation and that the accommodation would not impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business. Please let us know if you believe you require reasonable accommodation, or if you would like assistance to complete an application or to participate in an interview at the company. New employees will be required to successfully complete a background check. Any communication to applicants relating to the Emporia Energy hiring process will only come from email addresses with the domains emporiaenergy.com or no\-reply@us.greenhouse\-mail.io. If in the course of the application or hiring process with Emporia Energy you are contacted through another domain, are requested to provide banking or other sensitive information, or you note any other suspicious activity, please contact cybersecurity@emporiaenergy.com.

jobs.description: This role is based in Palo Alto, California, and follows a hybrid work model. If you’re excited about helping build a large\-scale SaaS platform at an early\-stage company and the qualifications below align with your background, we’d love to connect! **About Us** ------------ Endor Labs is building the Application Security platform for the software development revolution. Modern software is complex and dependency\-rich, making it increasingly difficult to pinpoint the risks that truly matter. Endor Labs solves this challenge by building a call graph of your entire software estate—enabling teams to clearly identify, prioritize, and fix critical risks faster. Trusted by companies that are one or one hundred years old, Endor Labs secures code whether it was written by humans or AI, and whether it's 40\-year old C\+\+ code or cutting edge Bazel Monorepos. Endor Labs was founded by serial entrepreneurs Varun Badhwar and Dimitri Stiliadis, and is backed by leading VC firms such as Dell Technology Capital, Lightspeed, and Sierra Ventures. Sound interesting? Let’s talk if you want to be part of the next big leap in security innovation! **How You'll Make an Impact** ----------------------------- * **Join Our Cutting\-Edge Backend Team:** Dive into the heart of innovation by working on a state\-of\-the\-art distributed system with a sophisticated monorepo architecture. * **Own Core Product Functionality:** Own the core functionality at the heart of Endor’s AppSec platform. Design and deliver features that secure source code end to end, from IDE to deployment, fueling the next generation of AI\-driven software development. * **AI Code security \-** Be at the forefront of securing customer code with bleeding edge AI code security solutions. * **Elevate Core Services**: Drive the development and optimization of vital core services like our API Gateway and API servers, ensuring robust and scalable infrastructure. * **Maintain diverse scan environments** \- Enhance our dynamic cloud scan platform by supporting the ever\-growing build and tool chain requirements. * **Innovate with Autonomy**: Embrace the freedom to design and build top\-tier tools that will be leveraged across all teams at Endor, making a significant impact on our operations. * **Champion Observability**: Apply best practices in observability to ensure our products and platforms achieve exceptional reliability and availability for our users. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **Engineering Expertise**: Bachelor’s in engineering and 8\+ years of experience. * **Golang Mastery**: Showcase proven experience in Golang programming, with a deep focus review, and report generation. * Develop and test Python scripts or tools for data analysis, cleanup, and automation. * Help prototype and evaluate AI\-assisted tools (e.g., large language models, AI agents) for practical lab applications. * Assist with connecting instrument data to lab systems (e.g., LIMS) and reducing manual Excel/CSV handling. * Document workflows, assumptions, and usage instructions for tools you help build. * Collaborate with lab staff to gather requirements and improve tools based on feedback. **What We Seek:** * Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field. * Coding ability in Python (or similar) for data analysis or automation. * Familiarity with structured data (Excel, CSV, databases). * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and eagerness to learn lab workflows. * Ability to work onsite in Billerica, MA for the full Spring term. * Exposure to AI tools, large language models, or AI agent frameworks. * Interest in or coursework related to laboratory operations, analytical chemistry, or QA. * Experience with APIs, data pipelines, or workflow automation. * Strong communication skills and ability to work with non\-technical users. **Desired Major(s) \& Graduation Year:** * Bachelor's or Master's in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field * Graduate in Spring 2027 or Spring 2028 **Eligibility:** * Must be a currently enrolled student * Available to work 40 hours a week, M\-F (8a\-5p) beginning in January through June * Must be familiar with the university’s requirements to participate in a co\-op program * Entegris is not currently hiring candidates for co\-ops/internships who will need, now or at any time in the future, Entegris sponsorship Fueled by our proprietary data assets and our AI traffic engine, EverQuote is transforming the way providers attract and engage consumers to grow market share. Joining our team puts you at the forefront of this transformation. You will collaborate with a group of builders to solve complex problems and reshape a massive industry. If you want to drive real\-world impact and do the best work of your career, you've found your home. We move fast, follow the data, and hold ourselves to high standards. If that's how you work too, this is the role for you. **About the role:** EverQuote is searching for a Senior Engineer II, Full Stack to join our B2B Agency Feature Team, one of the highest\-impact teams driving the future of our Agency business. complex front\-end code problems, as well as help others unblock themselves. * Use data (e.g., A/B testing, performance monitoring) to support and validate your UI/UX concepts. * Integrate AI tools into the development lifecycle (e.g., for testing, code assistance, or feature implementation). * Contribute every day to the user experience in a fast\-paced work environment. **What you bring to the backend systems in production environments. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. * Expert experience with modern front\-end frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, Angular) and jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Front is the customer operations platform built for B2B complexity, keeping every team, tool, and customer conversation in sync so companies can scale without losing connection. Others handle simple interactions. Front handles the coordination and context behind complex B2B customer relationships. Over 9,000 companies, including Uber Freight, Navan, and Stripe, rely on Front because it's the only one that can run the operational layer that makes customer\-facing work actually succeed. Backed by Sequoia Capital and Salesforce Ventures, Front has raised $204M from leading venture capital firms and independent investors including top executives at Atlassian, Okta, Qualtrics, Zoom, and PagerDuty. Front has received numerous Great Place to Work accolades, including **Top Places to Work by USA Today 2025**, **Y Combinator's list of Top Companies in 2023**, **\#4 on Fortune’s Best Workplaces in the Bay Area** ,**Inc. Magazine's 2022 Best Workplaces list**, and **Forbes Best Startup Employers 2022 List**. Front is looking for a Senior Solutions Engineer to join our world\-class Solutions \& Forward Deployed Engineering organization. You’ll be a trusted technical advisor to our most strategic prospects and customers, helping them transform customer service through AI, automation, integrations, and modern workflows. You’ll partner closely with Account Executives throughout complex enterprise sales cycles, owning the technical strategy from discovery through solution design, demonstration, proof of concept, and technical validation. You’ll develop deep expertise in Front’s platform, AI capabilities, APIs, and integrations to design creative solutions that connect Front with customers’ technology ecosystems. As Front evolves its AI\-powered customer service capabilities, you’ll help customers identify where AI can deliver meaningful business value. You’ll lead hands\-on proofs of concept that demonstrate real\-world impact and help technical and business stakeholders evaluate AI capabilities, performance, and limitations. This is a highly cross\-functional, customer\-facing role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving difficult problems, and can move seamlessly between technical depth, business value, and executive\-level communication. **What will you be doing?** --------------------------- * Partner with Account Executives on strategic opportunities, owning the technical strategy required to navigate and close complex enterprise deals. * Lead technical discovery to understand customer objectives, architecture, workflows, integrations, security requirements, and technical constraints. * Translate complex requirements into thoughtful solutions using Front’s AI capabilities, APIs, integrations, automation, and broader platform. * Design and deliver tailored product demonstrations that connect Front’s capabilities to customer use cases and measurable business outcomes. * Position Front’s AI\-powered customer service capabilities with technical and executive audiences, clearly communicating value, considerations, and limitations. * Architect and lead hands\-on AI proofs of concept and technical evaluations, defining success criteria and validating performance, feasibility, and business impact. * Serve as the technical lead for pilots and evaluations, managing technical dependencies, troubleshooting challenges, and ensuring successful outcomes. * Develop deep expertise in Front’s APIs and extensibility platform to design creative integrations with customers’ existing systems and applications. * Build credibility with Engineering, IT, Security, Operations, and Architecture teams while effectively communicating technical concepts and business value to C\-level executives. * Partner with Product and Engineering to bring customer insights into product discussions and influence Front’s roadmap. * Identify reusable technical patterns, demonstrations, and best practices that improve the effectiveness of the broader Solutions and Sales organizations. * Act as a senior technical voice in the field, raising the technical bar and mentoring other team members when appropriate. **What skills \& experience do you need?** ------------------------------------------ * **7\+ years of experience** in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a similar customer\-facing technical role, ideally within enterprise SaaS. * Proven success partnering with sales teams to navigate and win complex enterprise opportunities. * Strong experience designing and demonstrating solutions involving **AI, automation, and complex business workflows**, translating technology into clear customer and business value. * Hands\-on experience implementing or integrating **AI\-powered products**, including leading customer proofs of concept and evaluating AI quality, performance, and impact. * Strong understanding of modern AI concepts and the ability to clearly explain their capabilities, tradeoffs, and limitations to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong technical foundation in **APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows, integrations, and modern SaaS architectures**. * Experience working with REST APIs and independently prototyping or troubleshooting integrations. Familiarity with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages is a strong plus. * Strong software design and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous customer requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience engaging senior technical stakeholders and C\-level executives. * Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical capabilities to outcomes such as customer experience, operational efficiency, productivity, and ROI. * Experience with customer service, support, contact center, CRM, communications, or workflow automation platforms is highly preferred. * A curious, hands\-on mindset and enthusiasm for experimenting with AI and solving challenging customer problems. **Front operates on a hybrid model — we come together in the office each Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday to collaborate and stay connected.** **What we offer** * Competitive salary * Equity (we are post\-series D \& backed by some of the best VCs in the US) * Private health insurance, including plan options at no cost to employees * Paid parental leave * Flexible time off policy * Flexibility to work from home Monday and Friday, unless posted as a fully remote role * Mental health support with Workplace Options * Family planning support with Maven * $100 per month Lifestyle Stipend to spend on fitness, health and wellness, and other activities * Wellness Days \- Fronteers get an additional day off on months with no holidays * Winter Break \- Our offices are closed from Christmas to New Year's Day! *Front provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability. By applying, you acknowledge and agree that you have read and understand the* *California Recruiting Privacy Notice* *\&* *EU Privacy Notice* Compensation Range: $160K \- $230K

jobs.title: Assistant Professor, Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Description:** The School of Engineering and Computing at Fairfield University invites applications for a tenure\-track faculty position at the assistant professor rank in the Michael Zabinski Department of Mechanical Engineering. The start date for this position is September 1st, 2027, pending budget approval. Candidates in all areas of Mechanical Engineering or closely related fields are encouraged to apply. Position Description: This position requires an ability to perform teaching, scholarship, and service responsibilities. The successful candidate will be required to: (1\) develop and teach undergraduate and graduate courses (lecture and laboratory) in mechanical engineering. (2\) supervise Master theses, undergraduate research, capstone projects, and senior design projects; (3\) pursue scholarly activities (including externally\-funded research and peer\-reviewed publications); (4\) engage in academic advising and mentoring; and (5\) assist in program assessment, execution of the department’s continuous improvement plan, and documentation in support of ABET accreditation. The position is an academic (9\-month), tenure\-track appointment, and the salaries are competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience. The School of Engineering and Computing is organized into the Michael Zabinski Department of Mechanical Engineering, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, and the Department of Electrical, Mechatronics, and Biomedical Engineering. The Mechanical Engineering program is ABET accredited and offers Bachelor of Science and Master of Science degrees. In addition, students have an option to obtain a Concentration in either Automation, Robotics, and Manufacturing or Aerospace Engineering. The department is equipped with state\-of\-the\-art laboratories such as Material Characterization Lab, Automation, Robotics and Manufacturing (A.R.M.) Lab, Mechanical Engineering Lab, and the High\-Speed Fluids Research Lab. It also houses the Brinkman Manufacturing Laboratory and the Innovation Annex in support of teaching and research and boasts the highest undergraduate enrollment within the School of Engineering. Required Qualifications: * A Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering or closely related discipline. * Effective verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to effectively teach both undergraduate and graduate courses, including hands\-on labs. * Demonstrated potential to engage in funded research in a relevant field, along with a demonstrable publication record. Preferred Qualifications: Candidates with expertise in experimental and applied areas of Mechanical Engineering are encouraged to apply. Computational expertise is considered a favorable additional qualification when complemented by hands\-on, applied research and teaching experience. Areas of interest may include, but are not limited to, solid mechanics/structures, thermal\-fluid sciences, energy, aerospace, and other emerging areas of Mechanical Engineering. Screening of applications will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. Full consideration will be given to candidates who apply by November 1st, 2026\. The preferred starting date is September 1st, 2027\. Please combine and upload the following materials in **a single PDF document**. A complete application will consist of: (1\) a cover letter addressing the qualifications (one\-page), (2\) a statement of teaching interests and research plan (two pages), (3\) a curriculum vitae, and (4\) the names and contact information of three professional references (references will not be contacted without prior knowledge and approval of candidates). Applicants are encouraged to submit a project portfolio (three to five pages with annotated photographs or a link to a website repository) that illustrates hands\-on, project\-based contributions. Only complete electronic applications will be considered. Inquiries about the position should be addressed to the Chair of the Search Committee, Dr. David Shekhtman (engineeringsearch@fairfield.edu). For more information on Fairfield University, please visit www.fairfield.edu. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change and new ones may be assigned at any time, with or without notice. *All offers of employment are contingent upon a satisfactory background check.* Fairfield University provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators. #### **The Role** You'll join the Unified Experience team — the group responsible for building seamless collector journeys across Fanatics Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, Topps, and future experiences. This is the Android seat on that team, and it's a systems role as much as a feature role. You'll own the shared Android foundation that multiple apps and multiple feature teams depend on: common identity and session handling, shared Compose components and modules, consistent navigation and deep linking between surfaces, and the migration paths that get us from where each app is today to where the unified experience needs it to be. When you get it right, four teams ship faster and collectors stop noticing the seams. The Android stack is modern by design: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose throughout, Coroutines and Flow for concurrency and state, a unidirectional architecture with a strict state contract, GraphQL against our backend, and a modular multi\-module Gradle codebase with automated build and release pipelines. No legacy View\-system app hiding under the surface — you'll be working in a codebase you can be proud of. AI tooling is part of how we work. We expect engineers to use it on the job, give it good context, and verify the output — not just accept it. #### **What You'll Do** * Design and ship shared Android foundations — reusable modules, Compose components, and internal libraries — that multiple collector\-facing apps depend on, and treat the engineers consuming them as first\-class customers. * Own unified identity, session, and entitlement flows across surfaces, so a collector signs in once and moves between Live, Instant Rips, Marketplace, and Collections without friction. * Lead migrations and consolidations against live users: persistence and data model changes, deprecating divergent implementations, and phased rollouts that don't break anyone mid\-flow. * Own features end to end — API contracts, state and effect handling, Compose UI, testing, and release. * Build deep linking, navigation, and cross\-surface handoffs that make separate products behave like one. * Write genuine test coverage: unit tests with fake dependencies, Flow and coroutine test patterns, Compose UI tests where they earn their keep — not coverage theater. * Instrument what you ship and watch it in production: event tracking, feature flags, staged Play Store rollouts, crash and ANR triage, and monitoring you actually check after launch. * Own Android performance where users feel it: startup time, jank in scrolling and animation\-heavy surfaces, memory under sustained real\-time load. * Review pull requests with judgment: surface real defects, prioritize what matters, coach on what to let go. * Contribute to architectural decisions: modularization strategy, state management, effect handling, failure handling. * Mentor engineers earlier in their career and raise the quality bar across the team. #### **What We're Looking For** * 5\+ years building consumer\-facing Android applications at scale. * Kotlin — coroutines, structured concurrency, Flow, and a working understanding of where each belongs. * Jetpack Compose — state hoisting, recomposition and stability, performance\-aware composition, Compose Navigation. * Unidirectional state management at scale — MVI or a comparable strict, testable architecture (Molecule, Orbit, Mavericks, or a well\-reasoned in\-house pattern) that you can explain and defend. * Multi\-module Gradle architecture — clean module boundaries, convention plugins, version catalogs, build times you've actively fought for. * Shared architecture across multiple apps — you've built reusable modules, SDKs, or internal libraries consumed by more than one app or more than one team, and you understand the API\-stability and versioning discipline that requires. * Dependency injection — Hilt, Dagger, Koin, or equivalent, used deliberately rather than by habit. * GraphQL on Android — Apollo Kotlin, schema\-driven development, codegen, subscriptions. * CI/CD — Bitrise, GitHub Actions, Fastlane, or equivalent automated build/test/release pipelines feeding the Play Console. * Testing discipline — JUnit, Turbine, Robolectric, Compose testing, and instrumentation tests, with real assertions. * Static analysis — ktlint, detekt, or equivalent quality gates. * Hands\-on with AI\-assisted development tooling — Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar — with a track record of using it for real work, not demos. * Structured commit/PR discipline tied to a project tracker (Linear, Jira, or equivalent). * Comfortable working across team boundaries — this role depends on influence with engineers you don't manage. #### **Bonus Points** * Experience with livestreaming, real\-time auctions, or high\-throughput WebSocket/subscription workloads. * Baseline Profiles, Macrobenchmark, or other systematic Android performance work. * Exposure to marketplace or e\-commerce Android applications. * Payments, billing, or Play Billing experience. * Developer tooling or internal platform work that measurably saved other engineers time. * Passion for sports cards, collectibles, or live commerce. *Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Unified Experience
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. **About the Role** Support Fanatics Collect's Unified Experience initiative, building seamless collector journeys across Fanatics Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, Topps, and future experiences. Today a collector can win a card in a live show, rip a pack, buy on the marketplace, and store it all in a vault — but those moments still feel like separate products. Your job is to make them feel like one. That means building the shared surfaces, APIs, and front\-end systems that connect experiences that were each built independently, and doing it without slowing any of them down. This is a hands\-on senior role. You'll own meaningful slices of the unified experience end to end — schema to API to UI — and you'll do it alongside a Staff Backend Engineer, mobile engineers, product, and design. **Why Join Us** Fanatics Collect is growing fast, and the unification work is the highest\-leverage engineering investment we have: every new app, drop, and live format gets easier once the shared foundation exists. You'll work across mobile, web, and internal tools, with real autonomy and a short path from idea to production. Your teammates are passionate about the space and most of them are collectors themselves. **Product Context and Scale** Our surfaces reach millions of collectors across iOS, Android, and web, with live, high\-traffic moments (breaks, drops, auctions closing) that make performance and reliability non\-negotiable. You'll be working in a landscape of multiple existing products with real users and real data, so migration, backward compatibility, and careful rollout are part of the craft. **First 90 Days** * Ship a meaningful, user\-facing piece of the unified experience end to end. * Build a working map of how Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, and Topps actually fit together today — data models, identity, entitlements, and the seams between them. * Establish working relationships with the backend, mobile, product, and design partners you'll depend on. * Identify one piece of duplicated or divergent logic across surfaces and make the case for consolidating it. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain fullstack features using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and TypeScript. * Build scalable, performant, highly available services and interfaces on AWS and Vercel. * Own features end to end: data model, API contract, front\-end implementation, tests, rollout, and post\-launch metrics. * Build and maintain reusable front\-end components, APIs, and shared libraries that multiple apps (web and mobile) depend on — and treat other engineers as first\-class consumers of what you build. * Contribute to cross\-surface concerns like shared identity, entitlements, inventory, and navigation between collector experiences. * Ship behind feature flags with instrumentation in place, and use the resulting data to decide what to keep, fix, or cut. * Prototype quickly with Product and Design when a working demo will settle a debate faster than a document. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, LLM\-backed workflows) to raise your own throughput, and share what works with the team. * Write meaningful tests across the stack — unit, integration, and E2E — using Playwright, Jest, React Testing Library, and Pytest, and keep CI/CD pipelines trustworthy. * Maintain component documentation and interaction specs via Storybook. * Participate in sprint planning, retros, and product strategy sessions; raise scope and sequencing concerns early rather than at the end. * Mentor engineers through code review and pairing, and raise the bar on code structure, testing, and documentation. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of professional fullstack development experience, with demonstrated proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Python, plus hands\-on cloud experience (AWS preferred). * Strong grasp of architectural patterns, API design, and application performance tuning — and the judgment to know when a simpler solution is the right one. * Track record of owning features end to end in production, including the parts after launch: monitoring, debugging, and iterating on real user behavior. * Solid front\-end fundamentals: responsive UI development, accessibility (a11y), and front\-end performance practices. * Experience with state management patterns and tools such as React Context, Zustand, Redux, or XState, and a thoughtful approach to complexity in large apps. * Strong testing discipline with tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Pytest. * Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices. * Comfortable working across domains — backend APIs, customer\-facing web, mobile web, and internal tools — and context switching without dropping threads. * Clear written and verbal communication; able to work directly with Product, Design, and other engineering teams and drive alignment on your own work. * Experience using or a genuine appetite for AI developer tooling to improve velocity. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. **Nice to Have** * Experience integrating or consolidating multiple existing products, including data migrations against live users. * Experience with high\-traffic, real\-time, or live\-event product surfaces. * Background in growth engineering or rapid experimentation frameworks. * Experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, or gaming live ops. * Design system or shared component library ownership. * Passion for collecting, trading, sports, or gaming — and an interest in being a user of what you build. If you like owning problems end to end, care about how software feels and not just whether it works, and want your work used daily by millions of collectors — we'd love to talk. *Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. Fanatics never seeks payment from job applicants. Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers* By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Architect
jobs.description: Faro Health aims to improve lives by helping life sciences companies design optimal clinical trials. Our AI\-powered software platform optimizes and orchestrates complex clinical development by providing powerful insights about trial design and outcomes. Faro empowers researchers to design more intelligent trials, reducing development costs and reaching milestones faster with better patient experiences. Faro is a mission\-driven company seeking world\-class people who share our passion for improving drug availability and patient outcomes through better clinical trial design. We pride ourselves on our vibrant, inclusive, and growth mindset oriented culture. Faro offers competitive compensation and benefits, generous vacation and parental leave, and flexible working hours. We are a hybrid workplace where San Diego employees work from their homes as well as in our stunning main headquarters enjoying a gym with classes, outdoor lawn work area, and steeply discounted food hall. Remote employees work from home and visit the main office for group events and in\-person collaboration. In this role you'll design and build the platform capabilities that Faro's product teams build on top of. Your consumers are internal engineering teams and business stakeholders, so the work is measured by adoption as much as delivery. The systems you design succeed when other teams choose them. You'll stay hands\-on — expect to spend a meaningful share of your time in code, prototyping your own designs and building reference implementations of the patterns you're asking teams to adopt. The platform is your domain, and you own its architecture end to end. Beyond it, you'll provide architectural oversight across product development, participating in architecture reviews and partnering with feature leads to guide their technical designs into alignment with the wider system. Working alongside other architects and engineers, you'll own trade\-offs that cross team boundaries and help steer modernization already in flight. It's a role with unusual leverage: a good decision here compounds across every engineering team in the company. Responsibilities:* Own System Design: Lead the design of large\-scale, cross\-team platform capabilities from ideation to release, ensuring business requirements are gathered and met. * Own Non\-Functional Requirements: Ensure that all non\-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, reliability, security, observability, and cost are met across your domain. * Sequence Architecture Into Delivery: Partner with engineering managers and product to break your designs into increments teams can actually ship, so no team is blocked waiting on a design that doesn't exist yet. * Architectural Review: Write, critique, and defend designs (your own and others'), including identifying and validating reversible\-vs\-irreversible decisions. * Build\-vs\-Buy Evaluation: Evaluate and make recommendations on build\-vs\-buy decisions for new or aging features and capabilities. * Hands\-On Innovation: Contribute directly to the architecture and development of high\-complexity features, tackling challenging problems. * Champion Best Practices: Be a driving force in establishing and promoting engineering best practices, partnering with our Principal Architect to turn what works in your domain into standards the whole organization can adopt. * Mentor \& Lead: Mentor engineers across the organization, helping to accelerate the realization of our product roadmap while fostering a collaborative learning environment. * Drive Adoption With Internal Customers: Deliver an exceptional experience for the engineering teams and business stakeholders who build on your systems, understanding their needs deeply enough that they choose your platform rather than route around it. * Represent Architecture Externally: Present our architecture to strategic customers and engage their technical leadership directly — including on limitations and our roadmap. **Requirements** What We're Looking For. We don't expect anyone to bring all of this. If the first group describes you, and you recognize yourself in many of the others, we'd like to talk. Scope and Judgment* You have designed systems used by multiple teams and managed the long\-term consequences * You have led a migration or deprecation to completion including full retirement * You can distinguish reversible from irreversible decisions and calibrate how much process each deserves * You have driven technical alignment among senior engineers who don't report to you and didn't initially agree with you * You have partnered with engineering managers to get architectural work onto a roadmap and delivered incrementally * You have made and defended build\-vs\-buy recommendations * You have prioritized and pitched tech debt: what to accumulate, what to hold, what to pay down, and what to retire * You have owned the security posture of systems you designed, and worked with security teams as a partner * You have made architectural decisions with real cost consequences, both positive and negative, and can explain the outcomes * You have presented an architecture to a customer's technical leadership and held the room through hard questions Technical Depth* Deep expertise in at least one general\-purpose application language and one infrastructure\-as\-code toolchain. We work primarily with containers running TypeScript or Python on Azure, with Terraform as IaC. * Strong understanding of cloud\-native architecture and cloud operations * Experience running containerized workloads. We are migrating to AKS. * Experience designing data models on relational stores (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar), including schema evolution in production * Experience designing real\-time data or event\-driven systems * Experience designing integrations across product boundaries including versioned interfaces, compatibility guarantees, and failure isolation * Experience designing front\-end architecture at scale including component libraries, state management, and design\-system and module boundaries Ways of Working* A track record of mentoring engineers * Excellent written and verbal communication: you move between engineers, executives, and customers in the same day, adopting each audience's vocabulary without diluting the substance * Equally comfortable leading small, short\-lived cross\-team groups and working independently * Comfortable in a fast\-moving, growth\-minded environment where requirements change * You teach what you learn and are comfortable learning from others regardless of seniority Strong Plus* Familiarity with our stack: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, Redis, Agno, Vite, uv, Containers, Terraform, Azure * Integrating AI/LLM capabilities into production systems, including validation of model outputs * Designing systems under regulatory constraint: validation, audit trails, data integrity, traceability, attribution, etc. * Clinical trials or regulated healthcare domain experience **Benefits** Salary Salary range for this position is $188,000 \- $221,000 Salary listed reflects the base salary only and does not include other elements of total compensation. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training Equity In addition to this position's salary (listed above), equity will be a major component of the total compensation for this position. We aim to offer higher\-than\-average equity compensation for a company of our size, and communicate equity amounts at the time of offer issuance. Benefits* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k) * Life Insurance (Basic) * Short Term and Long Term Disability * Paid Time Off (Flexible Vacation Policy; Paid Sick \& Public Holidays Observed) * Training \& Development Reimbursement * Hybrid Work Environment * Peer\-to\-peer bonus program * Company/department outings and events * Stock Option Plan * San Diego Office On\-Premises Amenities; gym, restaurant tenant discount, Padel Nine

jobs.title: Senior IT & Corporate Engineering
jobs.description: Flex is building the **AI\-native private bank for business owners**. We’re re\-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. **Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.** Since launching publicly in **September 2023**, Flex has scaled from **zero to nine\-figure annualized revenue**, with a clear path to **profitability by late 2026**. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are **affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)**—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a **\~$1T\+ revenue market** hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a **$100B\+ company** by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M\+ in equity and $300M\+ in debt.* **Mission\-critical problems**: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. * **High bar, low ego**: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. * **Speed over comfort**: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. * **Enduring impact**: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. **Team \& Locations** We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. **Flex Fuels Ambition.** ### **About The Role** This role owns IT and corporate engineering at Flex, end to end. It reports directly to the CTO. We think IT's job is enablement. The measure of this function is not how many tickets it closes or how many controls it can point at. It is whether everyone else at Flex can do their work faster and more safely than they could last quarter. A new hire productive on day one instead of day four. An engineer who gets exactly the access they need in minutes, without asking twice and without being handed the keys to everything. A team that can adopt a new tool because someone reviewed it properly, not because they routed around IT to buy it on a personal card. So we are not looking for a gatekeeper, or for someone whose default answer is no. The right person makes the safe path the easy path, and removes friction permanently instead of absorbing it repeatedly. Which is why this role also owns Flex's corporate security posture. Identity, access, endpoints, and the SaaS estate are one system, and the person who makes access fast should be the person who decides how much access is reasonable. Split those across two teams and employees route around both. You'll set conditional access and MFA policy, own privileged access and endpoint posture, and run third\-party OAuth and Workspace grant review. Our security engineers own the product and infrastructure side, the money paths and the code, and you'll work with them constantly. Corporate security is yours to decide, not to implement on someone else's behalf. This is the hard part of the job, and we'd rather say so than leave it as a bonus line. The argument between moving fast and holding a line is now an argument you have with yourself. Day to day, what gets tightened, what gets mitigated, and what we knowingly accept is your call; the large ones come to the CTO, and we'd rather see a close call early than find out you decided it quietly. What we'd ask is that a no comes from a real read of the risk and the business context rather than a standard applied by default. The rest of the work has two halves. The IT half is the fleet, identity, access, the SaaS estate, and the joiner/mover/leaver process, delivered with help from a managed IT partner who handles procurement, device logistics, tier\-1 support, and international coverage. You own that relationship, define the SLA, and enforce it. The corporate engineering half is the part we think makes this a good job: writing the automation and internal tooling that means the IT half doesn't scale linearly with headcount. If a process only works because a person runs it by hand every Tuesday, we'd rather you replaced it. You'd be inheriting an estate here, not starting one. The first year is as much untangling what has already accumulated \- stale access, tools nobody reviewed, processes that work because someone remembers them \- as it is building what comes next. Automate that assessment. Nobody should be reading through a SaaS estate by hand in 2026\. Now the shape of this. Flex is around 150 people, and you would be the only person in this function, with vendor capacity underneath you and a direct line to the CTO. That means real autonomy and real scope from week one. It also means this bing it. * You know you can't be in the loop on every request, and you don't want to be. You build the self\-service paths that let people get what they need without going through you. * You can hold a vendor accountable without turning the relationship adversarial. * You can tell a colleague, including a senior one, that what they've built can't keep the access it has, explain why in plain language, and work alongside them to find a way that works. * You're calm when something is broken and several people are watching. * You explain technical constraints clearly to people who don't share your background, in writing, across time zones. ### **What We're Looking For** * Substantial hands\-on experience owning IT or corporate engineering at a growing company, including a stretch where you were the most senior person doing the work. Roughly \[6\+] years is typical, but we care about what you've owned, not the year count. * Deep, hands\-on ownership of an identity provider (Okta, Entra, JumpCloud, or similar) at the design layer: SSO, SCIM, SAML, group and entitlement modeling. Not just the admin console. * Practical experience running Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 as a platform. * Real MDM and endpoint experience across macOS, and ideally Windows, in a remote or hybrid company. * Automation ability in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar), and comfort with APIs and identity plumbing. * Experience designing an access model and running access reviews, not only fulfilling requests. * Real ownership of identity security decisions, not only their execution. You've set MFA or conditional access policy, tightened privileged access, or cleaned up third\-party app grants, and you can talk about what you traded away to do it. * Track record managing an outsourced IT provider or MSP, or a clear\-eyed view of why the ones you've worked with succeeded or failed. * Clear written communication. Much of this job is asynchronous and cross\-team. ### **Strongly Preferred** * Experience in a regulated or audited environment (SOC 2, PCI, or a bank partnership), as the control owner rather than the auditor. * Time as the senior security voice somewhere without a security team, or without a CISO to escalate to. * Experience supporting employees and contractors across multiple countries, including device logistics and local employment platforms. * Experience at a company that grew quickly enough that you had to replace your own early processes. * Experience introducing AI tooling internally in a way that was actually adopted and actually governed. ### **Interested? We'd love to hear from you** At Flex, we value passion, determination, and honesty. Even if you don't fully match the job specifics, we encourage you to apply. Unusual career paths and unique skills can help you stand out. We believe diversity drives our success. Join us at jobs@flex.one Flex is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital or family status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we'll sort it out. **Why Join Us** **Build something generational** — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.**Work on real money, real risk** — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.**Solve hard problems** — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.**True ownership** — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.**Founder\-level exposure** — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.**High bar, high taste** — Move fast without cutting corners.**Elite peers** — People here are builders, not tourists.**Real upside** — Meaningful equity if you help build something big. Flexbase Technologies Inc.

jobs.description: ### **\\u007C About us:** Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition\-driven healthcare at scale. Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer\-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money. Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost\-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low\-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet\-related diseases. At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment: Customer First \- You start with the member and work backwards. Make It Happen \- You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards. One Team \- You collaborate with respect and commit as a group. Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food. ### **\\u007C About the role:** Foodsmart is seeking a Staff AI Engineer who will play a critical leadership role in shaping the architecture and delivery of AI\-powered systems across the organization. You’ll operate at the intersection of backend engineering and applied machine learning—designing resilient infrastructure, deploying cutting\-edge models, and mentoring engineers across teams. This role goes beyond building software: it’s about setting strategy, elevating engineering standards, and turning AI innovation into scalable, real\-world impact. ### **You will** * Own the jobs.description: **FLSA Exemption Status** ------------------------- Exempt **Summary** ----------- **Salary Min** $66,448\.39 **Salary Max** $99,672\.07 This position performs advanced, complex technical and analytical work to support a robust multi\-facility SmartGrid environment. Work is performed on\-site and off\-site in a secure, monitored 24/7/365 environment. This role supports the reliability, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance of the bulk electric system, real\-time operational systems including SCADA, ICCP, virtualization, and secure communication paths necessary to deliver energy services. Work requires a key technical expert supporting design, security, administration and optimization of Operational Technology and systems supporting critical infrastructure. Work in this class is distinguished from other classes by its lack of supervisory and design responsibility, and basic technical and analytical knowledge and skill in communication/data networks, virtual infrastructure and system security monitoring software. **Examples of Work** -------------------- Essential Functions: Monitors and supports server infrastructure, including virtualized environments, cloud systems, Windows/Linux servers, databases, and storage for SCADA and other OT applications within a CIP environment. Supports configuration and maintenance of OT network systems, including LAN, WAN, VLAN, wireless, and VPN connectivity. Assists with firewall updates, segmentation strategies, and troubleshooting to ensure secure and reliable communications. Follows established change\-management, configuration\-control, preventative\-maintenance, and access\-control processes in compliance with GRU Cyber Security Policy and NERC CIP requirements. Assists in setting up and managing server environments such as virtual machines, operating systems, and storage platforms used by OT and SCADA systems. Collaborates with senior OT staff, IT security, SCADA engineers, and vendors to implement secure and scalable OT solutions. Participates in system\-disruption simulations and follows disaster\-recovery, mitigation, and restoration procedures for natural disasters, technical failures, or human interference. Supports risk assessments, Cyber Vulnerability Assessments, and participates in penetration\-testing activities to strengthen OT security. Assists in maintaining security systems including firewalls, VPNs, IDS, encryption, log\-analysis tools, and antivirus technologies in accordance with regulatory standards. Provides responsive technical support for network, hardware, software, and security issues, including after\-hours work and travel to remote facilities. **Examples of Work (continued)** -------------------------------- **Education** ------------- Associate’s degree in a Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field required plus experience as listed in the Experience Section below or Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four\-year college or university in computer science, information systems, network systems, cybersecurity or a related engineering field preferred with experience requirements listed in the Experience Section below. **Experience** -------------- With Associate’s degree: four (4\) years of experience in at least two of the following areas: data communications, computer networks/systems/security, or communication projects. With Bachelor’s degree: Two (2\) years of experience in at least two of the following areas: data communications, computer networks/systems/security, or communication projects. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered if it provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities. **GRU Competencies** -------------------- Adaptability, Flexibility, Fostering Innovation Contributes to Achieving GRU's Mission: GRU will provide safe, reliable, competitive utility services in an environmentally responsible manner and will actively contribute to the enhancement of the quality of life in our community Customer Focus **Role Specific Competencies** ------------------------------ Problem\-solving, Analysis, \& Reasoning Self\-Management Professional Technical Competency **Certifications** ------------------ Valid Florida Class E Driver's License required **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** ------------------------------------ Basic knowledge of communication and data network principles, including fiber optics, voice processing, video processing, and some understanding of radio transmission systems. Foundational knowledge of network administration, physical and electronic security, disaster recovery techniques, and technical problem\-solving. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** We are seeking a high\-impact, technically deep Machine Learning Engineer to develop, optimize, and deploy production ML models across our autonomous vehicle (AV) stack. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building models end\-to\-end \- from data and training through optimization and real\-time deployment on autonomous vehicles. You will work closely with perception, prediction, planning, infrastructure, systems, and hardware teams to ensure models are efficient, scalable, reliable, and production\-ready for both on\-vehicle and cloud workflows. This role is onsite 5 days a week at our Santa Clara, CA office! **What you'll do** * **End\-to\-End Model Development:** Own the full ML lifecycle, including data strategy, preprocessing, training, evaluation, optimization, deployment, and monitoring. * **Autonomous Driving Models:** Develop and improve models supporting perception, prediction, planning, and scene understanding. * **Efficient Neural Network Design:** Optimize models using techniques such as quantization, pruning, sparsification, compression, and efficient architecture design to meet strict latency, compute, memory, and power constraints. * **Real\-Time Deployment:** Integrate trained models into C\+\+\-based autonomy systems and optimize inference for production vehicle hardware. * **Model Optimization:** Profile and optimize neural networks using CUDA, TensorRT, and related technologies. * **Simulation and Evaluation:** Analyze model performance using simulation and real\-world driving data, identify failure modes, and drive improvements. * **Scalable ML Infrastructure:** Build high\-throughput pipelines for training, evaluation, data processing, and large\-scale offline inference. * **Data Workflows and Tooling:** Develop reliable pipelines for dataset curation, annotation, preprocessing, visualization, diagnostics, benchmarking, and continuous feedback from field data. * **Cross\-Functional Integration:** Partner with autonomy, systems, hardware, and infrastructure teams to ensure ML components integrate reliably into the broader vehicle platform. **What we're looking for** * **Education:** MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Optimization, or a related field. * **Experience:** Open to all experience levels. Leveling will be determined based on experience and technical depth. * **Programming \& Frameworks:** * Strong Python skills and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Strong C\+\+ skills and experience integrating ML models into high\-performance production systems. * **Core ML \& Systems Expertise:** * Deep understanding of ML workflows, including data curation, training, evaluation, ablation studies, deployment, and inference optimization. * Experience deploying and optimizing neural networks for real\-time, embedded, robotics, autonomous driving, or other performance\-constrained systems. * Experience with model optimization techniques such as quantization, pruning, compression, and efficient architectures. * Experience with software architecture, profiling, latency optimization, system\-level debugging, and data flow analysis. * **Infrastructure \& Compute Tools:** * Experience with CUDA and TensorRT is highly desirable. * Experience with cloud\-based ML training and evaluation pipelines, preferably Azure. **Bonus Qualifications:** * Experience with transformers, multimodal models, diffusion models, world models, or end\-to\-end driving models is a plus. * Experience in autonomous driving, robotics, or other safety\-critical real\-time ML systems is strongly preferred. * Publications or demonstrated technical contributions in efficient ML, autonomous driving, robotics, or related areas are a plus. * Prior contributions to large\-scale ML systems deployed in production. **Salary Range** $170,000 \- $240,000

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **About the Team** The Compression and Parity team in GM's Autonomous Vehicle organization makes aggressive model optimization safe enough to ship repeatedly. We compress and quantize models headed for the car, and we own the analytical machinery that proves the compressed model still behaves like the original — not by assertion, but with bounded, quantified, auditable evidence. Every deployment decision our organization makes about a compressed model runs through the tooling this team builds. **About the Role** We are looking for a mathematically rigorous engineer to own model numerics: how we measure, bound, and reason about the numerical behavior of the models we ship — and how we turn that analysis into deployment decisions. The central question of this role is deceptively simple: given two numerically different versions of the same model, is the difference safe? Answering it well requires connecting things that are usually studied separately — floating\-point drift and Hessian conditioning on one end, vehicle trajectory error on the other. You will build the tooling that makes that connection quantitative, and you will define the thresholds that turn it into a ship / no\-ship decision. This role is not: running an existing validation harness and reporting the numbers it produces. When a parity check fails, the expectation is that you can say which operation caused the divergence and why — not merely that a difference exceeded a threshold. The tooling exists to make that investigation fast; it does not replace the investigation itself. **What You'll Do** * **Validate Optimized implementations** . Optimized implementations are supposed to be equivalent to their references. Establishing that rigorously, rather than by spot check, means deciding what equivalence should mean for a given operation, and designing the inputs that would expose a violation if one existed. * **Connect tensor differences to behavioral disparity.** Map low\-level numerical differences from quantization, compilation, and precision reduction to downstream driving behavior, using both open\-loop metrics (trajectory displacement error, perception IoU) and closed\-loop outcomes — and identify the mechanism behind the mapping, not just the correlation. * **Build sensitivity and robustness analysis tooling** . Use Jacobian/Hessian\-based methods to characterize how model outputs respond to weight and input perturbation, extend the same machinery to out\-of\-distribution inputs, and turn it into tooling that runs repeatedly across checkpoints — by engineers who are not you. * **Build training dynamics observability** . Design diagnostics that detect and root\-cause training instabilities — gradient vanishing and explosion, loss spikes, silent divergence — including decompositions of gradient and update trajectories into loss\-descent and oscillatory components under modern schedules such as WSD. * **Make it cheap enough to always be on** . Metric computation, gradient decomposition, and diagnostic logging have to run inside real distributed training jobs with negligible throughput cost and no OOM risk. Observability nobody can afford to enable is observability that doesn't exist. **Requirements:** We are deliberately strict on a small number of things and flexible on everything else. * **A working command of numerical analysis and matrix theory.** Jacobian/Hessian estimation, spectral properties, conditioning, and floating\-point error analysis should be tools you reach for by reflex, not topics you once studied. You should be able to say why an estimator's variance blows up, and when that matters. * **A real mental model of neural network training.** Loss landscapes, gradient and error propagation, optimizer dynamics, and the mechanics by which training goes wrong. You should have opinions about what a gradient norm spike does and does not tell you. * **An adversarial instinct for numerical edge cases.** Typical inputs rarely find anything. We are looking for someone who reaches for denormals, extreme dynamic range, catastrophic cancellation, degenerate shapes, and accumulation\-order effects — someone whose first question about a passing test is what that test failed to exercise. * **The engineering to make the math run** . High proficiency in PyTorch and Python, and a track record of building analytical tools that are both mathematically defensible and fast enough to be used in production training and evaluation loops. * **The judgment to make analysis actionable.** Much of this role is turning a numerical result into something an engineer who will not read your derivation can act on: knowing which quantity actually answers the question being asked, tracing an anomalous number back to the operation that produced it, etc * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Applied Mathematics, Control, Physics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a closely related quantitative field. **What You'll Learn Here** You are not expected to arr ing low\-overhead observability over sharded parameter and gradient state. * **Experience in quantization, compiler toolchains, or inference\-time numerical parity.** * Experience building or scaling evaluation pipelines and its metrics formulation for AV or ADAS systems. * **Published or applied work in model robustness, OOD generalization, or adversarial/perturbation analysis.** **Compensation:** The compensation information is a good faith estimate only. jobs.description: **Job Description** **The Role:** General Motors is seeking a highly motivated and qualified candidate for the position of Senior Feature Engineer on our Data \& Feature Engineering team. and reliability at scale * Document feature definitions, lineage, and pipeline architecture for reproducibility and audit purposes * Partner with data engineering and platform teams to ensure features jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Copilot Models Inference
jobs.description: About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot. Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States Overview: As a software engineer at GitHub, you will enhance the collaboration experience at GitHub by working closely with a community of engineers and designers with a distributed, diverse and passionate team delivering the services that millions of developers depend on. In this role you will design, prototype, implement, ship and support highly performant and inspiring user experiences with your team. The GitHub Copilot Models Inference team builds and operates the backend services and APIs that connect Copilot experiences to AI model providers. These systems make models available safely and reliably at global scale while managing the production realities of provider integrations, request routing, service health, latency, capacity, and changing model availability. As a Software Engineer III, you will deliver production features end to end and help operate the services you change. You will participate in design and code reviews, build tests and operational safeguards, prepare changes for rollout, and use production signals to improve reliability and performance. Clear communication matters on this distributed team. You will work with engineers and partners across Models Lifecycle, product, safety, infrastructure, and external model providers through a mix of live conversations and thoughtful written updates. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with opportunities to grow ownership through increasingly independent delivery. Responsibilities: * Design, implement, test, deploy, and maintain backend services and APIs that connect GitHub Copilot experiences to model providers.* Own scoped features end to end, from technical design and implementation through operational readiness, safe rollout, measurement, and follow\-up. * Integrate new models and provider capabilities while accounting for availability, compatibility, capacity, failure modes, and safe fallback behavior. * Improve service latency, throughput, capacity efficiency, and high\-availability behavior using measurable production outcomes.* Add and maintain automated tests, dashboards, alerts, runbooks, and diagnostics that make service and model health understandable and actionable * Keep teammates and partners informed through clear discussions, written updates, and documentation, especially when decisions, risks, or incidents affect others. * Participate in code reviews and design discussions, incorporating feedback and helping teammates ship maintainable changes. * Participate in on\-call and first\-responder rotations, investigate incidents, communicate impact, restore service, and complete appropriate repair and automation work. * Use progressive delivery practices and production evidence to reduce risk when launching models, changing routing behavior, or updating provider integrations. * Collaborate with Models Lifecycle, product, safety, infrastructure, and provider partners to deliver model availability and operational improvements across team boundaries. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications:*** 4\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining and delivering production software languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python. + OR Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 3\+ years experience. + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 2\+ years experience in Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python. + OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. + OR equivalent experience **Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience applying software design principles such as clear interfaces, useful abstractions, and composition to build maintainable and testable systems. * Experience working with both relational databases and NoSQL data stores, including making appropriate data\-modeling and access\-pattern tradeoffs. * Experience building or operating cloud\-native services, including containers, Kubernetes, or managed cloud infrastructure. * Experience with AI or large language model inference systems, model APIs, or model\-provider integrations. * Experience with observability and reliability engineering, including improving latency, capacity, resilience, or incident response for production services. * Experience with canary releases, feature flags, progressive delivery, or other safe rollout practices.
