In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role. jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT GREENBOARD** At Greenboard, we're building the future of financial compliance. Greenboard is the unified, AI\-native compliance operating system for RIAs, fintechs, private funds, hedge funds, and more. It replaces the fragmented mix of legacy tools and automates more than previously possible. By centralizing data and workflows, Greenboard helps firms reduce regulatory risk, simplify their technology stack, modernize how they run compliance, and save money. Our founding team includes engineers who have scaled products at Amazon, Google, and multiple unicorn startups. We're backed by Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Base10, and other top\-tier investors, and have raised over $20M to date. Brand\-name financial institutions already rely on Greenboard, and we're growing fast. **ABOUT THE ROLE** You'll be our first dedicated Automation engineer. Our customers are regulated financial institutions, which means a missed bug is not just a bad user experience. It can mean an incomplete books\-and\-records archive, a marketing review that never routed for approval, or an attestation that quietly failed to send. Quality is part of the product we sell. You'll own how we test: the framework, the automated suites, and the release process, built from scratch and then embedded with the engineers who ship. You'll also help us solve something most automation engineers have never had to solve, which is how to test AI systems whose output is not deterministic. There is no existing playbook here. If you like defining the standard rather than enforcing someone else's, this is the seat. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN** * **The foundation.** Test framework, automated regression suites, and QA practices built from zero, with your call on tooling * **The critical paths.** Message archiving and supervision, marketing review routing, employee attestations, and audit trails, which are the flows that cannot break * **Testing the AI.** How we evaluate AI\-driven detection and review, including golden datasets and quality bars for output that is not deterministic * **Data integrity at scale.** End\-to\-end validation from ingestion of tens of millions of messages a day through to what a compliance officer sees on screen * **The release gate.** Bug triage, release sign\-off, and the definition of deployment\-ready at Greenboard **WHO ARE YOU?** * Love to move fast and build things * Looking for deep ownership over the quality of everything we ship * Obsess over the customers you're building for * An excellent communicator * Value collaboration * Located in NYC **QUALIFICATIONS** * 3\+ years testing software where being wrong has consequences beyond a bad review: fintech, healthtech, payments, or anywhere an audit followed a bug * Able to test a system you cannot fully see from the UI. Comfortable with REST APIs and querying the database directly, because verifying a feature here means checking what landed and what the retention policy did with it, not just what rendered * Write Playwright or Cypress suites that survive a redesign, with opinions about selectors, fixtures, and what belongs in an integration test versus an end\-to\-end one * Can read a feature spec and name the states nobody thought about: the employee who left mid\-attestation, the message that arrives out of order, the marketing piece edited after approval * Have held a release before, explained why to someone who wanted it out, and been right **NICE TO HAVE** * Tested a system where output is not deterministic and had to define correct as a threshold rather than an exact match * Worked in a Node JS and React codebase on AWS, or debugged a queue\-based ingestion pipeline * Been through a SOC 2 audit and know what evidence a test suite can produce for one * Sat with a compliance officer, an advisor, or a back\-office team and watched them work * Interest in the financial industry is a plus, but not necessary **BENEFITS** * 401(k) with 5% company match * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * 15 days PTO \+ 11 company holidays \+ flexible sick time * 2 additional PTO days for each year of service (up to 10 additional days) * 10 remote days per year plus additional around the holidays * Bi\-annual off\-sites and team retreats * Front\-row seat to building the operating backbone of modern finance Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Data & Analytics
jobs.description: **About Us** Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care. We deliver high\-touch, relationship\-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care. We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations. Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors. **About The Role** We're hiring our first dedicated data person. This person will build on our existing data platform, harden it to ensure consistent performance and build upon our metric library to ensure that our operators can monitor performance across all of our levers. Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and visualization in dashboarding tools As Data and Analytics Engineer, you own four things: * **The analytics layer**: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them * **Reporting and BI**: the reporting layer the whole business reads from * **Our production systems**: you take ownership of systems as they come in\-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime \& system integrity * **The partnership with our engineering team**: you are the internal counterpart who knows both the business and the systems well enough to resolve most issues directly This is a build\-and\-own role. Our engineering partner stands up a new capability; you take it on once it is live, harden it, and keep improving it. You work as their peer rather than their coordinator. You also partner closely with the pop health team (who owns our value drivers) in defining metrics and deciding together what the business needs to see. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health. **Location:** New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates. **What You'll Do** Own the Analytics Layer * Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic our metrics and workflows depend on. Work within Google Cloud to iterate on our business logic and transformation infrastructure * Ensure consistency in definitions across all surfaces at Greenbrook * Work with the performance managers on what needs measuring and what good looks like in their areas Take Ownership of What's in Production * Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep them healthy * Be accountable for uptime \& system integrity – catch ingestion and pipeline issues or logic bugs and resolve them within our SLAs. Develop monitoring and uptime reporting. * Ensure a performant system. Optimize workloads and runtime * Keep improving what you take on rather than only maintaining it Partner Across the Business * Be the counterpart our engineering partner can hand production work to, resolving what you can and escalating what needs them * Build dashboards to support organizational decisionmaking * Work closely with the business – sit in the operating meetings where the data gets used, so you know what decisions it feeds **What Success Looks Like** * Data Trust: the business trusts the numbers, and you are ahead of issues rather than behind them * Reliability: systems transitioned to you stay healthy, and when they break they get fixed quickly * Coverage: the metrics our drivers depend on have a certified definition and a single source of truth * Delivery: the work you committed to for the quarter shipped * Metrics you'll own: delivery against committed quarterly work, and counterpart satisfaction among the performance managers and the Head of Population Health **About You** You bring: * Fluency in dbt and Python * Hands on experience with Health care datasets and interoperability frameworks which our business run on, including a deep understanding of claims, eligibility, EHR data, and frameworks such as FHIR and HL7 * A solid grasp of business fundamentals, enough to partner with business and clinical managers on defining metrics rather than only building to spec * Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks * Bachelor's degree required * A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork You'll stand out if you: * **Want to own a system deeply**: you would rather take something into production, harden it, and keep improving it than move on to the next greenfield build * **Get to root cause**: you find out why a number is wrong rather than patching the symptom * **Are AI\-native**: you live in modern AI tools to support your work * **Communicate with clarity**: you are comfortable explaining complex data to business users and communicate proactively * **Own the outcome**: high bias for action, follow through on commitments, platforms, recommending adoption based on customer value, technical fit, risk, and long\-term viability. * Influence executive and cross\-functional stakeholders by clearly communicating technical strategy, architectural trade\-offs, risks, dependencies, technical debt, and recommended investment priorities **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree/ PhD in Computer Science, distributed systems, API design, service\-oriented and event\-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, messaging, caching, fault tolerance, and application state management. * Experience with AI jobs.title: Director, Forward-Deployed AI Solutions
jobs.description: **ROLE OVERVIEW** As a forward\-deployed AI operator within Real\-World Data Solutions (RWDS), you will work at the intersection of people, process, data, and technology to turn messy operational challenges into AI\-enabled systems that perform in daily work. You will embed directly with the teams doing the work: observing how workflows actually operate, identifying the right intervention, building the smallest useful solution, testing it with real users, and improving it until it delivers measurable value. Sometimes that solution will use AI; sometimes deterministic automation, an existing platform, or a process redesign will be the better answer. Your job is to make that judgment and own the outcome. This is a senior, hands\-on builder role for an operations\-minded problem solver—not a traditional software engineering position. You should be comfortable building with modern AI, automation, analytics, and low\-code tools, while partnering with data and engineering teams when a solution requires production\-grade infrastructure. Because this role sits at the center of how RWDS delivers for clients, the work you do here should show up in two core ways: how clients experience working with us, and how profitably we operate **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Discover and document how work actually happens: the people, approvals, exceptions, and informal tools (spreadsheets, Slack threads, workarounds) that fill the gaps in official process * Build and ship AI\-enabled tools, workflows, and automations directly with the analysts and teams who'll use them * Own your tools past the demo stage — make sure the underlying data logic is sound and the tool holds up as usage scales, partnering with engineering to productionize and incorporate into enterprise tooling * Use current AI/LLM tooling (agents, RAG, coding assistants) to build faster, and know when a lightweight tool or application is the right call versus when it needs to be a real engineered solution * Design appropriate human review, exception handling, monitoring, jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.description: **Love building new things—but also get a weird amount of satisfaction from tracking down the one plugin, line of code or integration causing everything to misbehave? Hiebing is looking for a curious and resourceful Web Developer who’s excited to build smart digital experiences, solve unfamiliar problems and keep growing alongside a collaborative team. WordPress will be at the center of the role, but your work—and your opportunity to make an impact—will extend well beyond it.** Hiebing is seeking a curious, motivated and innovative Web Developer who is eager to build intelligent solutions in a fast\-paced, collaborative team environment. Our team values learning, support and innovation, creating a culture where developers can grow, contribute and have fun doing great work. WordPress development and maintenance will be at the center of this role, but we’re looking for someone who is equally energized by troubleshooting an integration, helping implement tagging, debugging an email or figuring out something they haven’t encountered before. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter who is curious, resourceful and motivated to find answers independently. They see unfamiliar challenges as opportunities to learn rather than barriers and are comfortable moving between different types of digital work as client and team needs evolve. This role will initially be divided between new WordPress development and maintenance for existing clients, with the potential to create new capabilities and offerings for our clients and eventually lead the WordPress development practice at Hiebing. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Develop, enhance and maintain WordPress websites, including block editor/Gutenberg development, theme customization, plugin configuration and integrations. * Troubleshoot and resolve website issues, including plugin conflicts, third\-party integrations, browser and device inconsistencies, and performance problems. * Support ongoing website maintenance, landing pages, forms, content migrations and other digital enhancements across multiple client properties. * Assist with analytics and tagging implementations using tools such as Google Tag Manager and GA4, including implementation, troubleshooting and QA. * Support email development and production needs, including building and modifying HTML emails, troubleshooting rendering or template issues, and conducting technical QA. * Implement and troubleshoot marketing technology integrations, including forms, analytics, consent management, email platforms and other third\-party tools. * Work within Git\-based development workflows and follow established practices for commits, branching, pull requests, releases and documentation. * Collaborate with developers, digital strategists, project managers, designers and other team members to solve problems and deliver high\-quality work. * Maintain security, accessibility, performance and quality standards across development work. **Required Skills and Experience** ---------------------------------- * 2–3 years of professional web development experience, with meaningful hands\-on WordPress theme development experience. * Comfort using GitHub Copilot for AI\-assisted development and as part of the problem\-solving process. * Strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript fundamentals. * Working knowledge of PHP and WordPress development. * Experience with WordPress themes, plugins, Gutenberg/block editor and common marketing\-site integrations. * Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills. * Experience working with Git\-based version control. * Ability and willingness to work across different types of technical assignments rather than specializing exclusively in one area. * Resourceful and comfortable researching unfamiliar problems and identifying solutions independently. * Self\-motivated, with the ability to take ownership of work and follow it through to completion. * Curious and eager to learn new technologies, platforms and approaches. * Familiarity with analytics, tagging and marketing integrations, including GA4/GTM, consent tools, A/B testing, email providers and CDPs. * Accessibility awareness, including WCAG fundamentals, and experience implementing accessible UI patterns. * Able to manage multiple priorities and shift between projects in a fast\-paced environment. * Collaborative, dependable and committed to producing high\-quality work. **Nice\-to\-Have Skills and Qualifications** -------------------------------------------- * WooCommerce or Shopify experience, including checkout optimization, payment and shipping plugins, and catalog organization. * Comfort with WP\-CLI, Composer, deployment automation and modern WordPress build pipelines. * Experience implementing WordPress hardening practices, including secure configuration, plugin governance and least\-privilege access. * Familiarity with unit testing or automated regression testing. * Hands\-on experience with Email on Acid or Litmus to create visual and brand consistency across email devices and clients. **You’ll Thrive Here If…** -------------------------- * You enjoy building new digital experiences—and making existing ones work better. * You see an unfamiliar technical problem as something to investigate, not something to avoid. * You’re willing to dig into documentation, test possible solutions and ask thoughtful questions when needed. * You can move comfortably between development, maintenance, troubleshooting, analytics, tagging and email work. * You take ownership of your work and care about seeing it through from initial request to final QA. * You balance speed with thoughtful attention to security, accessibility, performance and quality. * You’re curious about AI and emerging technology while still bringing your own judgment and problem\-solving skills to the work. * You believe the strongest solutions come from developers, strategists, designers and project managers working together. **Where You’ll Work** --------------------- This position is based in Hiebing’s Madison, Wisconsin office. Collaboration is an important part of how we work at Hiebing. This position follows our hybrid work model, which includes working from the Madison office each Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, with the option to work remotely Thursday and Friday. Candidates who do not currently live within commuting distance should be willing to relocate to the Madison area. **Why Hiebing?** ---------------- At Hiebing, you’ll work alongside smart, kind and incredibly talented people who genuinely enjoy making each other’s ideas better. You’ll collaborate across disciplines, support regional and national brands and have the opportunity to build digital experiences that matter—for our clients, their audiences and each other. We’re a place where curiosity is celebrated, craftsmanship is respected and thoughtful judgment is just as valuable as bold ideas. We believe in speaking in data, Dreaming in Color and never settling for the expected. You’ll be challenged to grow, encouraged to explore new technologies and supported by teammates who believe the best work is always built together. We’re insight\-driven ideamakers who give a damn—about the work, our clients and one another. Our We Before Me philosophy reminds us that the strongest work is never about one person; it’s about what we build together. If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, sharing what you learn and using technology to create smarter, more meaningful experiences, you’ll feel right at home here. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Hybrid work environment with the option to work remotely Thursday and Friday * Competitive medical, dental and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match and profit sharing * Paid parental leave * Generous paid time off, including your birthday off * Professional development funding and ongoing learning opportunities * Opportunities to give back through meaningful pro bono work and community involvement * Investment and partnership opportunities * Dog\-friendly office * A culture built around curiosity, collaboration and our We Before Me philosophy **Work Authorization** ---------------------- Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship. jobs.description: **Location:** San Francisco (In\-Person) OR New York (In\-Person, with an initial 3–6 month rotation in SF) **About the Role:** We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who builds like a core systems engineer and communicates like a peer to elite researchers. Platform management firmware is essential to the reliability, serviceability, and manageability of hyperscale AI servers. This Principal\-level role owns BMC firmware architecture and development—built on OpenBMC—for Hyve's next\-generation AI and compute server platforms, spanning manageability, telemetry, power/thermal control, security, and manufacturing enablement in close partnership with hardware and Hyperscaler customers. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- * **BMC firmware architecture.** Define and own the OpenBMC\-based firmware architecture for AI/GPU server platforms, including manageability stack, Redfish interfaces, IPMI, and platform telemetry. * **Platform control and monitoring.** Develop and integrate power, thermal, fan\-control, and sensor monitoring firmware in close collaboration with power delivery and thermal teams. * **Security and reliability.** Implement secure boot, firmware update/recovery, RoT integration, and robust error handling to meet hyperscaler security and reliability requirements. * **Bring\-up and debug.** Lead firmware bring\-up across EVT/DVT/PVT, debug at board and system level, and drive root\-cause analysis and permanent fixes across firmware, hardware, and system\-integration domains. * **Manufacturing and deployment enablement.** Deliver firmware tooling and features for factory provisioning, diagnostics, and fleet deployment, and support field issue resolution at scale. * **Technical leadership.** Set firmware development methodology, review code, and mentor engineers; represent firmware architecture to customers and internal executives. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** ------------------------------------- * **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * **Experience:** 10\+ years of embedded/firmware development experience, including significant BMC/platform management firmware work and hands\-on OpenBMC development. Proven delivery of server\-class firmware into production; hyperscale experience preferred. * **Technical expertise:** Strong C/C\+\+ and embedded Linux skills; deep knowledge of OpenBMC, Redfish, IPMI, I2C/I3C, PMBus, SPI, and platform management interfaces; experience with secure boot, firmware update, and RoT. * **Systems knowledge:** Solid understanding of server hardware, power/thermal control loops, and the interaction of firmware with BIOS, hardware, and manufacturing flows. * **Communication:** Able to lead cross\-functional debug, drive architecture decisions, and communicate effectively with hardware teams, customers, and executives. jobs.title: Senior AI Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior AI Data Engineer** **Location\- Princeton, NJ \& NYC, NY (Hybrid)** **Salary\- 120K USD** **Fulltime** **Need 10\+ years of experience candidates** **Key Responsibilities** * Design and implement specialized data pipelines for AI model metadata, training data lineage, and model performance metrics tracking. * Build data infrastructure on Databricks leveraging Spark for large\-scale distributed dataset processing. * Develop MCP servers and enable AI data distribution via MCP. * Develop feature engineering pipelines and data preprocessing workflows for AI model training and inference. * Implement model versioning, experiment tracking, and model registry integration using MLflow or similar tools. * Create automated workflows for AI agent discovery, classification, and inventory management across the enterprise. * Design and maintain knowledge graph structures for representing AI model relationships, dependencies, and data lineage. * Build real\-time data pipelines for AI model monitoring, drift detection, and performance tracking. * Develop data quality frameworks specific to AI training datasets and validation data. * Collaborate with data scientists to optimize data access patterns and feature store implementations. * Implement security and compliance controls for sensitive AI training data and model artifacts. Create comprehensive documentation for AI data architectures, schemas, and integration patterns. * **Required Skills and Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field. * 5\-7 years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML workloads. * Expert proficiency in Python and experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit\-learn. * Strong experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, and distributed computing for ML workflows. * Deep understanding of the machine learning lifecycle, including model training, deployment, and monitoring processes. * Experience with feature engineering, data preprocessing techniques, and ML data pipelines. * Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and similarity search for AI applications. * Proficiency in SQL for structured and unstructured data management. * Understanding of data governance, model governance, and AI ethics principles. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with attention to data quality. Excellent collaboration skills for working with data scientists, ML engineers, and architects. * **Preferred/Nice\-to\-Have Skills** * Experience with generative AI applications, including RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) and fine\-tuning. * Knowledge of LangChain, HuggingFace, or other GenAI frameworks. * Familiarity with Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI platforms. * Experience with graph databases (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune) for knowledge graph implementation. * Understanding of AI model explainability and interpretability techniques. * Experience with A/B testing frameworks for ML model evaluation. * Certification in Databricks, AWS, Azure, or GCP AI/ML services. * Publications or contributions to open\-source ML projects

jobs.title: Field Engineer II - Data Center Services
jobs.description: Minimum Years of Experience: 2\-4 Job Description: * **Job Summary** --------------- The Field Engineer II \- Data Center Services is responsible for providing onsite technical support, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of data center infrastructure and associated equipment. This role serves as a key technical resource for customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring data center systems operate efficiently, reliably, and in accordance with established service level agreements (SLAs). The Field Engineer II performs moderate to advanced technical tasks, supports critical infrastructure environments, and may provide guidance to junior technicians and engineers.**Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ + Install, configure, test, and support data center hardware including servers, storage systems, networking equipment, racks, and cabling infrastructure. + Perform preventative maintenance and break\-fix repairs on data center equipment and systems. + Troubleshoot hardware, network connectivity, power, and environmental issues within customer facilities and data centers. + Execute equipment deployments, decommissioning activities, hardware upgrades, and technology refresh projects. + Respond to service requests, incidents, and escalations within established SLA requirements. + Conduct site surveys and assessments to validate installation readiness and identify potential operational risks. + Document service activities, technical findings, asset information, and customer interactions accurately within service management systems. + Coordinate with customers, project managers, vendors, and cross\-functional technical teams to resolve complex issues. + Support data center power and cooling infrastructure by performing visual inspections and reporting operational concerns. + Adhere to all safety, security, and compliance requirements while working in customer and data center environments. + Participate in on\-call rotations and provide after\-hours support as required. + Assist with mentoring and training junior field engineers and technicians.**Required Qualifications** --------------------------- + Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. + 3\-5 years of experience supporting data center operations, field services, IT infrastructure, or related technical environments. + Experience installing and troubleshooting servers, storage systems, network devices, and structured cabling. + Working knowledge of Windows and Linux server environments. + Understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals, switching, routing, and connectivity troubleshooting. + Experience using ticketing and service management platforms. + Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and customer service skills. + Ability to lift equipment up to 50 pounds and work in data center environments for extended periods. + Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to customer sites as needed.**Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- + Industry certifications such as: - CompTIA Server\+ - CompTIA Network\+ - Cisco CCNA - Microsoft Certifications - Certified Data Centre Professional (CDCP) + Experience supporting enterprise or hyperscale data center environments. + Knowledge of data center power distribution, UPS systems, and environmental monitoring. + Familiarity with ITIL processes and best practices. + Experience working in mission\-critical or 24x7 operational environments.**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** ---------------------------------- + Strong technical troubleshooting and diagnostic skills. + Ability to interpret technical diagrams, rack elevations, and network documentation. + Excellent verbal and written communication skills. + Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. + Strong customer\-facing and relationship\-building skills. + Capability to work independently with minimal supervision. + Attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.**Working Conditions** ---------------------- + Regular travel to customer and data center locations. + Work may occur in raised\-floor, warehouse, and secure data center environments. + Availability for scheduled maintenance windows, emergency response, and after\-hours support. + Ability to stand, bend, climb ladders, and move equipment throughout the workday. ned. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to help build and maintain web applications involving analytics, dashboards, blockchain data, and wallet\-connected features. The ideal candidate has strong experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern web application development, with a focus on performance, accessibility, reliability, and user experience. Responsibilities * Develop and maintain production web applications using React and Next.js App Router. * Build pages and features for dashboards, analytics, leaderboards, data explorers, and wallet\-connected applications. * Develop reusable UI components using TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. * Improve application performance through code splitting, efficient server/client boundaries, virtualized tables, and optimized data loading. * Build accessible forms, modals, filters, tables, and responsive layouts. * Implement data\-fetching layers using TanStack Query or similar technologies. * Handle loading, error, empty, and delayed\-data states clearly when APIs, RPC services, or data providers are unavailable or slow. * Integrate wallet connection and transaction flows where required, including Polkadot.js, Talisman, and SubWallet. * Work with API and data\-layer requirements and contribute to feature development from technical planning through production release. * Identify and resolve performance issues affecting page load time and user interactions. * Collaborate with the team on UI consistency, data freshness indicators, and clear user\-facing messaging. * Participate in incremental releases and evaluate improvements using measurable performance and usability metrics. Required Qualifications * Several years of professional experience developing React and Next.js applications. * Strong knowledge of TypeScript. * Experience with Next.js App Router in production applications. * Good understanding of Tailwind CSS and responsive web development. * Strong understanding of web accessibility and accessible UI development. * Experience improving performance on dashboards, analytics platforms, data\-heavy applications, or similar products. * Ability to work across API requirements, application logic, UI implementation, testing, and production releases. * Experience working with Git and modern software development workflows. * Strong written communication skills for remote and asynchronous collaboration. * Portfolio, GitHub profile, or examples of deployed production work that can be reviewed. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with TanStack Query. * Experience with Recharts or similar charting libraries. * Experience building virtualized tables or large data\-driven interfaces. * Experience with Web3 wallets, staking applications, or blockchain explorers. * Experience with Polkadot, Substrate, or Bittensor\-related applications. * Experience working with design systems or reusable component libraries. * Experience documenting components and frontend development patterns. * Experience working with AI\-powered applications or AI\-related APIs is a plus. Work Environment * Remote position. * Async\-friendly team environment. * Opportunity to work on production applications and data\-driven user interfaces. * Direct involvement in feature development, performance improvements, and product releases. * Contract opportunities with potential for continued work based on project requirements and performance. Pay: $3,000\.00 \- $5,500\.00 per month Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Hybrid \- Denver **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Technical \- Engineering Ibotta is looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to join our innovative team and contribute to our mission to Make Every Purchase Rewarding by building something great with us. As part of the engineering team, you will work on the technology solutions that power our products that are used by millions of consumers. We're looking for a self\-motivated engineer who has a real passion for building and running large\-scale, fault\-tolerant applications. Success in this role means not only understanding the right solutions and how to build them, but also embracing innovative means of collaborating with and leveraging AI to do so. Every engineer has input into our engineering culture, our products and development processes, and will have a real impact as part of a small, nimble team. This position is located in Denver, Colorado as a hybrid position requiring 3 days in office, (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). Candidates must live in the United States. **What you will be doing:** * Build products and tools, using the right language/tool for the job, that drive valuable impact to Ibotta, our customers, or fellow engineers * Work collaboratively with a highly talented cross\-functional team to design, develop and deliver new products and features that will be used by millions of users * Use Amazon’s AWS infrastructure and advanced services daily, including serverless architectures * Stay abreast of the ever\-changing technology landscape to identify the best tools and technologies to design and build flexible, scalable, reliable and high\-performing applications * Maintain an agile, experimental and iterative approach, with a willingness to learn fast in a constantly evolving and uncertain environment * Decompose complex business problems and requirements into manageable sub\-tasks * Know how to skillfully and judiciously leverage AI to assist with software development * Know when to choose AI as part of the tech stack and how to use it when building products, and operating them in production * Demonstrate leadership by offering guidance to team members, cultivating their technical aptitude, and championing best practices within the development process. * Leverage and contribute to our CI/CD pipeline to deploy code many times daily * Write tests and participate in code reviews to ensure that we're shipping high\-quality, maintainable code, and develop evaluators to verify the quality of non\-deterministic outputs * Own your technical solutions end\-to\-end from contributing your ideas, to first code commit, to operating in production * Embrace and uphold Ibotta’s Core Values: *Integrity, Boldness, Ownership, Teamwork, Transparency, \& A good idea can come from anywhere* **What we are looking for:** * 7\+ years of experience in software development * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics or a related field required * Mastery of relevant technologies such as Typescript, Ruby on Rails, Java, Kotin, Nodejs, Vue, Swift, etc, and data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, Redis, etc. is valuable, but knowing when to use each is far more important * Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, and software architecture. * Deep understanding of building highly scalable, observable, and fault tolerant systems * Mastery of applying core computer science concepts to iterative system design * Highly skilled in using AI tools for prototyping, writing, testing, debugging, and comprehending code, and the ability to critically review and improve AI\-generated code to meet production standards * Proficient in context engineering and AI building blocks such as LLM API calls, prompting techniques, agentic frameworks, RAG, vector databases, and model fine\-tuning * Proven experience with debugging and testing approaches, and frameworks from unit testing to automated testing and evaluation driven development * Proven experience building, deploying and operating automated workflows and agents, using platforms such as n8n, Databricks or similar * Deep understanding of development best practices including observability, alerting and SLOs for services, security, compliance, performance, optimization, reliability, cost efficiency, etc. * Proven experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCloud, or similar and with DevOps best practices and Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g. Terraform) **Some of the traits that we seek in great engineers:** * You…. + love to teach and learn from your co\-workers + look for ways to continually challenge yourself and develop as an engineer + are product\-minded, with a deep capacity to understand your customers, and can determine the right product and design requirements to meet their needs + understand that communication is a huge part of your software engineering responsibility and practice it daily + understand that testing your code is one of the most important aspects of software engineering + respect diverse perspectives and like collaborating with other engineers to solve hard problems + understand that delivering products incrementally helps provide more value to the business + trust your teammates, and embrace healthy conflict and debate. You believe getting it right is more important than being right. **About Ibotta ("I bought a...")** Ibotta (NYSE: IBTA) is a leading performance marketing platform allowing brands to deliver digital promotions to over 200 million consumers through a network of publishers called the Ibotta Performance Network (IPN). The IPN allows marketers to influence what people buy, and where and how often they shop – all while paying only when their campaigns directly result in a sale. American shoppers have earned over $2\.6 billion through the IPN since 2012\. The largest tech IPO in history to come out of Colorado, Ibotta is headquartered in Denver, and is continually listed as a top place to work by The Denver Post and Inc. Magazine. To learn more about what our Tech teams are doing day to day, visit Building Ibotta on Medium.com **Additional Details:** * This position is located in Denver, CO and includes competitive pay, flexible time off, benefits package (including medical, dental, vision), Employee Stock Purchase Program, and 401k match. **Denver office perks include paid parking, snacks, and occasional meals.** * Base compensation range: $160,000 \- $183,000\. Equity is included in overall compensation package. This compensation range is specific to the United States labor market and may be adjusted based on actual experience. * Ibotta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Ibotta’s employment decisions are made without regard of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status. * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. * Applicants are accepted until the position is filled. * For the security of our employees and the business, all employees are responsible for the secure handling of data in accordance with our security policies, identifying and reporting phishing attempts, as well as reporting security incidents to the proper channels. **Recruiting Agency Notice** Ibotta does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to any Ibotta employees.

jobs.title: Staff Security ML Researcher
jobs.description: **Onwards Together!** --------------------- Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi\-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters. Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running. **Location: 4 on\-site days a week in Sunnyvale, CA Headquarters.** ------------------------------------------------------------------- **Our Team's Vision:** ---------------------- The Office of the CTO and Security team sets the strategic technical direction of the company while keeping both Illumio and our customers secure. Those who join us represent the leader in Zero Trust Segmentation and maintain Illumio’s competitive advantage by exploring new technologies while collaborating with Engineering and Product Management. We are looking for people who leverage differences and push the pace of innovation in a time when the world faces its greatest cybersecurity threats in history. **About the Role** We're seeking a Staff Security ML Researcher to develop machine learning\-driven approaches for threat detection, risk assessment, and security analytics. In this role, you'll apply advanced statistical methods, machine learning, and graph\-based analysis to identify threats, model attacker behavior, and quantify cyber risk across complex enterprise environments. Working at the intersection of cybersecurity, machine learning, and product innovation, you'll partner with threat researchers, engineers, and product teams to transform large\-scale security data into intelligent models, actionable insights, and customer\-facing capabilities that help organizations better understand and reduce cyber risk. **Your Impact:** ---------------- **Machine Learning \& Security Intelligence** * Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models that identify anomalous behavior, detect threats, and predict security risk across complex enterprise environments. * Apply statistical techniques and predictive modeling to evaluate breach likelihood, attack exposure, and segmentation effectiveness. * Build behavioral profiling, anomaly detection, clustering, classification, and forecasting models using large\-scale security telemetry. * Evaluate model performance, reduce false positives, and continuously improve detection quality through experimentation and data\-driven analysis. **Threat Research \& Risk Modeling** * Analyze large\-scale security datasets to identify attacker behaviors, emerging threats, and patterns aligned to frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK. * Develop threat scoring and risk assessment models that help customers prioritize remediation and security investments. * Leverage graph\-based analysis techniques to model attack paths, quantify lateral movement risk, and recommend mitigation strategies. * Work closely with threat researchers to transform security intelligence into measurable detection and prediction capabilities. **Data Science \& Analytics Engineering** * Design and maintain scalable data pipelines used for model training, validation, and analytics. * Investigate new features, signals, and telemetry sources to improve detection accuracy and risk predictions. * Partner with engineers to productionize models and analytics systems while ensuring scalability, reliability, and observability. * Conduct experiments and hypothesis\-driven analysis to validate new detection approaches and security insights. **Product Collaboration \& Innovation** * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to embed ML\-driven security insights into customer\-facing experiences. * Influence product strategy through data\-backed recommendations and threat intelligence findings. * Help define security analytics frameworks, data requirements, and detection methodologies for future product capabilities. * Serve as a subject matter expert on the use of machine learning in cybersecurity applications. **Research \& Thought Leadership** * Explore emerging techniques in machine learning, graph analytics, and AI\-driven threat detection. * Investigate applications of graph neural networks, probabilistic modeling, and advanced analytics for cyber defense. * Contribute to patents, technical publications, conference presentations, and thought leadership initiatives. * Stay current on advancements in cybersecurity, machine learning, and adversary tradecraft to continuously evolve Illumio's detection capabilities. **Your Toolkit:** ----------------- **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience in security analytics, threat research, detection engineering or data science, machine learning * Strong Python programming skills, including experience with data science and machine learning frameworks such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. * Experience designing, training, validating, and deploying machine learning or statistical models in production environments. * Proven ability to work with large\-scale telemetry datasets from security, networking, cloud, or infrastructure environments. * Strong understanding of model evaluation, feature engineering, experimentation, and handling imbalanced datasets. * Experience applying analytics or machine learning techniques to cybersecurity problems such as anomaly detection, behavioral analysis, threat hunting, or risk assessment. * Familiarity with security frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK and common security telemetry sources. * Strong SQL and data querying skills. * Excellent communication skills with experience translating technical findings into actionable business and product recommendations. **Preferred Qualifications** * 7\-10\+ years of experience spanning cybersecurity, machine learning, data science, or threat research. * Experience building graph\-based security analytics using Neo4j, graph databases, or graph algorithms. * Knowledge of graph machine learning techniques, including graph neural networks or link prediction methods. * Experience productionizing ML models in cloud environments using AWS, Kubernetes, or similar platforms. * Experience developing risk\-scoring systems, recommendation engines, or predictive analytics solutions. * MS or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, Statistics, or a related field. **Bonus Points:** ----------------- * Background at a cybersecurity company focused on cloud security, network security, endpoint security, or threat intelligence. * Experience integrating external threat intelligence feeds and enrichment data into ML workflows. * Publications, patents, open\-source contributions, or conference presentations related to security or applied machine learning. * Industry certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, or advanced machine learning credentials. \#LI\-PO1 \#LI\-ONSITE **Our Commitment** Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success. *All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E\-Signature document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third\-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.* *For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Illumio will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* Compensation Range: $221K \- $265K

jobs.title: Data Analytics Engineer / Architect
jobs.description: Infopro Digital, the B2B group specialising in information and technology, is currently looking for a Data Analytics Engineer / Architect on a permanent contract to strengthen the Infopro Digital Automotive team in Nashville, TN. Infopro Digital Automotive develops digital tools and software dedicated to the performance of decision\-makers in the various sectors of the automotive aftermarket industry. Services benefit various automotive stakeholders, such as car manufacturers, aftermarket parts producers, distributors, and workshops. Further brands include ETAI, Eucon, HaynesPro, OATS, Inovaxo, Autronica, ETAI Ibérica, IsiCondal, Carooline, Haynes, DriveRightData, GiPA and Aurelis. Join Infopro Digital and become a Key Player in our Team! With exciting job opportunities worldwide, Infopro Digital opens up a vast universe of professional challenges. Joining our group means plunging into the heart of stimulating collaborations within multidisciplinary teams. The challenge awaiting you: As a Data Analytics Engineer / Architect (m/f/d), you will play a key role in shaping scalable data models and transformation pipelines, enabling reliable business insights and advanced analytics through high\-quality, well\-structured data. You'll be contributing to a variety of projects, while developing your skills and reaching new levels of expertise. The tasks awaiting you: You will be responsible for : * Design, build, and optimize scalable data transformation pipelines with a strong focus on SQL performance and efficiency, while maintaining robust dbt projects including models, tests, macros, and structured project setups. * Develop and evolve data models using dimensional modeling principles (e.g., star schemas) as well as Data Vault 2\.0 and Anchor Modeling approaches in a combined modeling environment. * Define, standardize, and maintain business entities, KPIs, and metric logic as reusable assets, and provide semantic layers consumable by BI tools and machine learning use cases. * Work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data models, ensuring alignment, data consistency, and a single\-source\-of\-truth approach. * Leverage modern data platforms such as Snowflake and/or Databricks and contribute to collaborative, Git\-based development workflows including code reviews and best practices. **Our data stack:** * Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Azure * dbt, SQL, Python * Dimensional modeling, Data Vault 2\.0, Anchor Modeling * Semantic layers, Power BI, product\-facing APIs * Git, Azure DevOps, YAML, code reviews * Data testing frameworks, cataloging and lineage, Claude Code **Requirements** * Hands\-on expertise in Snowflake and its data modeling capabilities for defining business entities, KPIs, and building semantic layers for BI and advanced analytics use cases. Additional experience in Databricks is a plus. * Advanced SQL expertise with a strong focus on transformations and query performance, combined with hands\-on experience in dbt (models, tests, macros, and project structure), and a deep understanding of data modeling concepts such as dimensional modeling as well as Data Vault 2\.0 and Anchor Modeling (or a strong willingness to learn both). * You collaborate effectively with business stakeholders and translate requirements into scalable data models, while maintaining high standards for data quality, harmonization, and single\-source\-of\-truth principles within Git\-based development workflows. * You communicate fluently in English with international colleagues and stakeholders in the US and Europe. * You would stand out with additional knowledge in Power BI (from a consumption perspective), experience with data testing frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, DQX, Soda), familiarity with data cataloging and lineage tracking, as well as an understanding of feature engineering concepts for future ML use cases. **Benefits** * 20 vacation days (rising to 25 days) * 5 paid sick days * 11 paid company holidays * Medical, dental \& vision insurance (including life insurance) * 401(k) plan plus match * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Short\-term and long\-term disability * Employee Assistance Program * Flexible working * Office gym membership * Employee referral scheme Our foundations and values: At Infopro Digital, we are driven by core values such as entrepreneurial spirit, constant customer focus, promoting diversity, striving for significant impact, and a collaborative culture. By joining us, you become part of a dynamic community that embraces these values on a daily basis, shaping the future with passion and commitment. Diversity is one of our core values. We are convinced that our teams, drawn from all backgrounds and with different backgrounds and experiences, are one of the key drivers of our success. The Group is committed to a policy of equal opportunities and inclusion, from recruitment to career development, and we strive to provide an equitable working environment to promote the well\-being of our teams. Who are we? Infopro Digital is a B2B group specializing in information and technology. The group is present in 26 countries and employs over 4,000 people. Its innovative solutions are aimed at professional communities in 5 key economic sectors: construction \& public sector, automotive, risk \& insurance, industry and retail. Thanks to the group’s sectorial expertise, Infopro Digital covers all the needs of professionals. jobs.description: **Company Description** At Intelerad, we believe the path to answers in healthcare should be clear\-whether you are waiting for a diagnosis or trying to expedite one. Our medical imaging solutions streamline the flow of information, simplifying complex processes, maximizing efficiencies, and shining a light on the unknown. We empower physicians to get patients the answers they need faster and improve outcomes for everyone. With more accessible imaging, we are getting patients out of the dark. Headquartered in Raleigh, NC and Montreal, Intelerad has nearly 800 employees located in offices across four countries. The company empowers nearly 2,000 healthcare organizations around the world with the speed, scalability, and simplicity needed to increase business performance while, most importantly, improving patient outcomes. Intelerad’s modern enterprise solutions have been acknowledged by a Best in KLAS recognition, ranking \#1 for PACS Europe UK/Ireland in the 2026 Best in KLAS: Global Software (Non\-US) report. **Job Description** We are seeking a Software Developer to join the InteleShare team and contribute to Intelerad's secure, cloud\-based medical image sharing platform. stack (browser, API, database, storage, DICOM/HL7 interfaces) and resolving root causes rather than symptoms. * Contribute to code quality through thorough pull request reviews, unit and integration tests, and clear documentation, supporting team\-wide standards and knowledge sharing. * Support DevOps and operational initiatives including containerized AWS/Kubernetes deployments, CI/CD pipeline maintenance, and participation in production troubleshooting alongside senior engineers. * Work as a full\-stack generalist across languages and codebases as business needs evolve, identifying opportunities for improvement and taking the initiative to implement them within an Agile/Scrum workflow. **Qualifications** **Qualifications \& Experience** * 3\+ years of professional web the ability to read query plans and diagnose slow queries. * Solid JavaScript skills, including direct DOM and jQuery work; experience with React or a comparable component framework. * Proven ability to work independently in a distributed team environment, managing priorities and delivering outcomes with minimal oversight. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex, long\-term goals into well\-scoped, deliverable increments. * Comfort working across multiple languages, frameworks, and problem domains as business needs evolve. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. **Preferred Qualifications \& Special Requirements** * Perl development experience (mod\_perl or other server\-side Perl). * REST API and PostgreSQL database development expertise. * Frontend development experience: JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS/LESS, and React (with Redux, TypeScript, and a component library such as Ant Design in newer areas); familiarity with webpack, Jest, and Playwright or Selenium. * Familiarity with containerized deployment: building Docker images and working with Helm charts in a Kubernetes pod deployment model. * Git/GitHub version control experience and familiarity with unit and integration testing best practices. * AWS cloud services knowledge (S3, EC2, RDS, ECR, CloudWatch). * Experience with Agile/Scrum methodology in fast\-paced development environments. * Background in healthcare technology: DICOM, HL7, FHIR, medical imaging, or radiology workflow understanding. * Exposure to a regulated development environment (HIPAA, FDA, ISO 13485/9001, or similar). *This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.* **Additional Information** The base pay for this position ranges from $86,250/yr \- $115,000/yr USD within any geographic market in the US. Pay may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Intelerad is a total compensation company. Pay is dependent on the position offered. Bonus and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, retirement, PTO, and/or other benefits. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Applicants may be required to complete an online personality assessment as part of your application. \#LI\-REMOTE Intelerad is committed to the principles of equal employment. We are committed to complying with all federal, state and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and all other employment laws and regulations. Applicants, employees and former employees are protected from employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age , disability and genetic information (including family medical history). Intelerad is dedicated to the fulfillment of this policy regarding all aspects of employment, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, placement, transfer, training, promotion, rates of pay, and other compensation, termination, and all other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. Intelerad is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity for qualified individuals with disabilities. jobs.title: Human Factors Design Engineer
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Human Factors * REF24873M ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function of the Position** As part of the Intuitive Human Factors team, the Senior Human Factors Engineer works closely with designers, clinical engineers, system and software engineers, technical product managers, regulatory affairs, and other important functional teams. The Senior Human Factors Engineer is a key contributor in informing and guiding development of new products, and ensuring that those products are feasible, viable and desirable. The Human Factors Design Engineer will serve as the Human Factors (HF) Lead on new and/or sustaining product development teams within Intuitive. Within the project team, the Human Factors Design Engineer (HFDE), works closely with designers, clinical engineers, system and software engineers, product managers, regulatory affairs, and other cross functional teams. They have primary responsibility to conduct research to gain a deep understanding of users, uses and use environments; perform task analysis, analyze and characterize usability considerations and use\-related risks; conduct iterative formative evaluations with end\-users to realize the impact of design concepts on user workflow, behavior and performance; translate user needs into usability requirements to inform design; and be accountable for final usability validation. The Human Factors Design Engineer also works closely with the regulatory, quality and design controls teams to define the submission strategy from HF perspective and be accountable for the usability engineering documentation required for submission to medical device regulatory agencies. The Human Factors Design Engineer position reports to a Manager within the broader Human Factors (HF) organization at Intuitive. **Essential Job Duties** **Research:** * Plan, collect and synthesize data to generate insights on how and why users interact with Intuitive products through various techniques including interviews, simulations, direct observations, workflow labs, human performance research, persona development, usability testing, mixed methods research, discovery from known use problems, etc. * Represent Intuitive during interactions with end\-user clinicians and customers in multiple international markets to gather design insights in a highly professional manner, during formative research activities. * De\-risk design strategies by identifying root causes and conduct root cause analyses that account for human performance influencers underlying the user experience **Design:** * Analyze, define and evaluate workflow and user interface designs. Negotiate design recommendations and improvements to prevent hazardous situations related to use errors and improve usability. * Accountable for establishment, authoring and management of usability design inputs. Translate findings from formative research activities into insights that are used to define evidence\- based user requirements and user interface design requirements to inform user interface design, labeling and training. * Develop conceptual prototypes that reflect performance influencers for showcasing and translating for stakeholders * Advocate strongly and consistently for the clinical caregiver experience for safety and usability, with understanding of the nuance and balance of user/customer needs and business needs. **Test**: * Design, execute, and report on usability evaluations at various stages of product development, from explorative co\-creation of design with end users, to formal usability studies to evaluate usability and risk with prototypes of varying degrees of fidelity. * As HF Lead on projects, accountable for summative usability validation and design validation of usability design inputs. Collaborate closely with internal human factors partners to define and execute validations. **Analyze**: * Write and revise highly accurate, clear, and concise usability engineering document nications. * Ability to work with and across various groups and levels of management within the organization, including other engineering groups, marketing, clinical engineering, and regulatory. * Ability to apply user\-centered design and usability engineering principles to product research, development, and design. * Ability to travel internationally, as well as domestically (up to 25%). **Required Education and Training** * Minimum BS or MS in Human Factors Engineering, Cognitive Psychology, Biomedical Engineering, Human\-Computer Interaction, Human\-Centered Design, or a related field, with emphasis in Interaction Design and User Interface Design. **Working Conditions** * Ability to travel internationally as well as domestically (up to 25%). * Primarily office\-based set schedule working model **Preferred Skills and Experience** * Experience in medical device, or similar regulated industry. * Experience with design engineering in product development. * Ability to empathize with people and to understand the human condition. * Ability to interface with customers in a highly professional manner. ### **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. Details can vary by role. Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. jobs.title: Principal, AI Security
jobs.description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron, Inc. (NASDAQ: ITRI) is a global leader in technology and services dedicated to the resourceful use of energy and water. Through innovative technology, software, and services, we help utilities and cities improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experiences, and build a more resourceful and sustainable future. This highly visible, hands\-on leadership role is responsible for defining and implementing the security architecture, governance controls, engineering standards, and operational practices that enable safe, scalable adoption of artificial intelligence, generative AI, machine learning, and AI agents across the enterprise and product portfolio. The ideal candidate combines deep cybersecurity expertise with practical experience securing modern AI ecosystems, including autonomous and semi\-autonomous agents, large language models, AI platforms, model gateways, non\-human identities, and data access controls. This individual will partner closely with Information Security, Product Security, Legal, Privacy, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, and business leaders to help drive innovative AI capabilities while protecting customers, products, data, and intellectual property.**Duties \& Responsibilities** ------------------------------ * Define and lead Itron's enterprise AI security strategy, architecture, policies, standards, reference architectures, and multi\-year roadmap. * Design and implement security controls across the AI and agent lifecycle, including registration, inventory management, identity governance, credential protection, authorization boundaries, autonomy controls, human oversight checkpoints, memory isolation, and agent decommissioning. * Establish scalable security guardrails for generative AI platforms, model integrations, APIs, plugins, automation workflows, AI assistants, and emerging agentic ecosystems. * Develop and maintain governance controls supporting privacy, confidentiality, data protection, transparency, explainability, accountability, ethical AI use, and bias mitigation. * Lead AI\-focused threat modeling, adversarial testing, security reviews, and risk assessments for enterprise and customer\-facing solutions. * Evaluate and mitigate emerging AI threats, including prompt injection, tool misuse, privilege escalation, AI supply chain compromise, context poisoning, insecure agent interactions, and rogue agent behavior. * Partner with engineering, product, and architecture teams to embed secure\-by\-design principles into the development, deployment, testing, and operation of AI\-enabled systems. * Advance the use of AI within Cybersecurity by designing and piloting AI\-assisted capabilities that improve detection engineering, threat hunting, vulnerability management, alert triage, evidence collection, and operational effectiveness. * Define security logging, telemetry, monitoring, alerting, and reporting requirements that measure AI control effectiveness and detect anomalous or malicious activity. * Develop and operate AI Security Posture Management capabilities, including inventories, risk assessments, third\-party evaluations, incident response processes, compliance readiness, and ongoing monitoring. * Conduct security assessments of AI vendors, platforms, and service providers with emphasis on architecture, data handling, privacy, access controls, resiliency, and operational risk. * Provide technical leadership and guidance for AI\-related incidents, investigations, governance decisions, policy exceptions, and risk acceptance reviews. * Author clear technical standards, reference architectures, implementation guidance, and executive communications that enable responsible and secure AI adoption. * Mentor engineers, architects, and security practitioners while fostering a collaborative, customer\-centric culture that balances innovation with risk jobs.title: Quarterly Planning and Operations Analyst
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **The Role:** JD Power’s Analytics team of over 200 professionals uses a hybrid, customized version of SAFe (scaled agile framework) to coordinate, execute and measure quarterly product development plans through planned cycles (program increments) to deliver value faster and more predictably. This role is responsible for the execution and ongoing optimization of that approach across sets of analytics professionals including data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, data insights analysts, data visualization and QA analysts, and data strategists. You will also interface heavily with partner teams in product and technology organizations as we move towards more consistent approaches across these teams. This is a high\-intensity, high\-visibility execution role involving the creation of net\-new data\-driven, AI\- and ML\-based products with our diverse set of automotive data assets. The role also evaluates, reports and conducts retrospectives on Analytics team operational KPIs for several of our major product areas involving our most complex, real\-time data sets that have high customer expectations and very fast customer response times. These metrics involve product quality, throughput, model accuracy and other identifiers. You will partner with Analytics leaders to identify, root cause and improve business performance, and evaluate and measure the impact of use of AI in our development teams. This role sits within the Transformation Office, the enterprise function responsible for orchestrating the programs and initiatives that underpin our three\-year strategy. In this capacity, you will be a dedicated execution partner to our CDAO, embedded in the work that matters most and positioned to grow alongside it. **The Impact You Will Have in This Role:** Data and analytics are core to what JD Power sells and how we operate, particularly as our data assets and product development roadmaps have grown more complex and connected across multiple data sources. Your involvement in this position will ensure clarity of product development purpose and enable teams to effectively plan and ultimately own their development commitments. The Project Manager in this role is not a coordinator. You are voice of the Analytics organization in relation to what we shipped, what we will ship, how confident we are in doing so, and whether our quality, throughput and accuracy are performing to expectations. **What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:** · Facilitate program increment quarterly planning events to align teams on a shared mission, objectives and delivery commitments each quarter. Lead inspect \& adapt workshops, facilitating quantitative and qualitative retrospectives and executing on improvement ideas · Track and communicate metrics like completion rates, program predictability, to provide transparency and drive continuous improvement · Leading end\-to\-end program delivery by coordinating across multiple teams and functions, adapting to methodologies as needed including Agile, hybrid, and data platform\-specific workflows · Building, maintaining, and owning the committed project plan and schedule, distinct from the product roadmap, and ensuring milestones are met with transparency and rigor · Drive adoption and maturity of product planning practices across the organization · Applying a hybrid toolkit – technical project management, agile delivery, and business analysis to address the specific needs of each workstream · Bring technical project management expertise to address engineering and AI challenges, working closely with technical leads and data scientists to monitor development progress and ensure alignment between business objectives and technical execution. · Partner with Analytics leaders to set annual KPI objectives for year\-on\-year improvements. Proactively measure and report out on those KPIs and partner with technical teams to uncover root causes, implement retrospective actions and identify risks and countermeasures **What You Bring** · 5\-8 years of project management experience · Highly accountable, you own your commitments, follow through without being chased, and hold others to the same standard · A self\-starter who can operate with limited direction, identify what needs to happen next, and move without waiting to be told · Strong communication skills, able to distill complex program status into clear, concise updates for leadership audiences, both written and verbal · Experience in technology\-centric environments (software development, IT, or data) with a history of bridging business objectives and technical execution · Proficiency in SAFe a plus. Proficiency in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, generally speaking; experience with Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar SDLC and PM tools · Demonstrated experience applying AI tools to program and project management workflows, and a track record of proactively exploring and adopting emer ams concurrently in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment · Bachelor's degree preferred; PMP certification a plus · North American based, with availability to work across a distributed global team.
