jobs.title: Software Engineer, Operations
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Interplanetary Sciences Program was established to expand access to scientific exploration across our solar system. Its mission is to make planetary research faster, more affordable, and more capable than ever before by rethinking how science missions are designed, built, and operated. The program aims to enable scientists to send instruments to distant worlds without decades of development or prohibitive costs. By creating a sustainable model for interplanetary exploration, we are transforming space science from an occasional event into a continuous process of discovery that accelerates knowledge, broadens participation, and inspires the next generation of explorers. **About the Role:** The Interplanetary Sciences Program is building the operations software that will optimize the mission science and innovate in how we operate the spacecraft. The software will command, monitor, and coordinate the spacecraft, its science instruments, and its communications systems across the Mars 2028 mission. At Relativity Space, we set audacious goals. The Mars 2028 mission is designed to transform how we conduct interplanetary science missions bringing AI models to run on the spacecraft in Mars orbit. The instrument suite will sense the atmosphere to inform weather models and probe the surface with Radar to understand the location of ice. The mission operations for the Mars 2028 mission will also be ground\-breaking with automation across the whole stack to enable autonomous science collection meaning the spacecraft can be re\-tasked to acquire follow\-up observations based on analysis and inference of recent data on the flight hardware. As a Software Engineer – Operations, you will design and build the tools that mission operators, instrument teams, and external partners rely on every day from command generation and validation, to telemetry and data dissemination, to the interfaces that let outside teams safely and reliably interact with our systems. This is a high ownership and hands\-on engineering role at the intersection of software, spacecraft operations, and cross\-team collaboration, with real influence over how the mission is run. Operations software is the layer between a spacecraft hundreds of millions of kilometers away and the humans, instruments, and partner organizations that depend on it working correctly, every time. The tools you build will directly shape how safely and efficiently this mission commands its spacecraft, ingests its science data, and supports the instrument teams counting on us to get it right. **What You'll Do:** * **Design and implement operations software:** Build, test, and operate spacecraft commanding tools — including command generation, validation, sequencing, and constraint\-checking software — using modern engineering practices and AI\-assisted / agentic development tools to accelerate implementation without compromising rigor. * **Work cross\-functionally:** partner with mission operations, GN\&C, flight software, instrument, and ground systems teams inside Relativity Space, as well as external partners and instrument providers, to translate operational needs into working software. * **Build test suites:** build automated test suites and validation frameworks covering spacecraft commanding, telemetry processing, and data dissemination — including regression tests, simulation/flatsat\-based validation, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test support — so that changes to operations software can be verified quickly and safely before they touch the mission. * **Define external interfaces:** define and document the interfaces (ICDs, APIs, data formats) that instrument teams and other external stakeholders use to interact with operations tools, ensuring those interfaces are clear, stable, and well\-supported across the life of the mission. * **Automate tooling** for commanding, telemetry visualization, anomaly investigation, and data pipelines as mission needs change over time. **About You:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * 3\+ years of software engineering experience, ideally including some exposure to mission operations, ground systems, command and control, or other safety\- or mission\-critical software * Strong software fundamentals and hands\-on proficiency with Python or a comparable language * Experience designing and writing automated test suites (unit, integration, and/or regression tests) for complex or safety\-critical systems * Experience defining or working against external\-facing interfaces or APIs (ICDs, schemas, protocol definitions) shared with other teams or organizations * Comfort working cross\-functionally with engineers, operators, and external partners who may have very different technical backgrounds and priorities * Experience with agentic development tools (e.g., AI coding agents/assistants) as part of a professional software engineering workflow, including knowing when and how to verify their output in a mission\-critical context *During critical mission phases including launch, commissioning, cruise* *maneuvers* *and early operations this position will require shift work and on\-call availability. Schedule flexibility will be needed as operational needs evolve. Occasional travel (\<10%) to partner institutions and mission integration sites may be* *required* **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.** ***If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at*** ***accommodations@relativityspace.com******.*** ***Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission \- via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee \- will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.***

jobs.title: IT Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth\-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books – all in one connected platform backed by real human support. **About the Role** ------------------ Rho is hiring an IT Engineer to own the technology backbone that keeps our New York City office and distributed team running. You'll be the go\-to person for employee IT support, device and identity management, and the systems and tooling that help Rho move fast. This is a hands\-on, in\-office role based in our NYC office — ideal for someone who loves solving problems for their colleagues and building scalable IT operations at a high\-growth fintech. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Serve as the primary point of contact for all employee IT support — hardware, software, access, and troubleshooting — with a focus on fast, friendly resolution. * Own device lifecycle management across macOS and Windows, including procurement, provisioning, MDM, and secure offboarding. * Administer core identity and SaaS systems (SSO, Google Workspace, Slack, and related tools), including access onboarding and offboarding. * Manage the NYC office's IT infrastructure — networking, AV, conference rooms, and on\-site hardware. * Build and document IT processes, runbooks, and self\-service resources that scale as Rho grows. * Partner with Security, People, and Finance on access controls, compliance, and asset management. * Lead IT onboarding for new hires and ensure a seamless day\-one experience. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years of IT support or IT operations experience, ideally in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. * Hands\-on expertise administering macOS and Windows, MDM tools, and identity/SSO platforms. * Strong working knowledge of Google Workspace, Slack, and common SaaS administration. * Experience managing office IT infrastructure, including networking, AV, and conference room technology. * Excellent troubleshooting skills and a customer\-service mindset — you make IT feel easy for your colleagues. * A clear communicator who can document processes and support non\-technical teammates. * Willing and able to work on\-site 5 days per week in our NYC office. Our people are our most valuable asset. The salary range for this role is $90,000 \- $180,000\. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, healthcare benefits and paid time off.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Cloud
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the Data Cloud Team** ----------------------------- Rippling Data Cloud is a new suite of products that aggregates data from across your company into Rippling, connects it to worker identity, and makes it available for analysis, visualization and action. It preserves and enriches data context to enable precise and accurate answers to your most important and nuanced business questions. It's a complete data stack including data connectors, transformations, visualizations, AI\-powered analytics, and even inbound Zero\-Copy. It understands how all of that data relates to employees, managers, departments, locations, cost centers, permissions, and historical changes in your ever\-changing business. That makes it possible to ask questions that traditional BI systems struggle to answer correctly. **Data Cloud as the foundation for Rippling AI** ------------------------------------------------ Data Cloud and AI are deeply connected in Rippling. Data Cloud is the data infrastructure layer that powers Rippling AI. Here's how they relate: **Data Cloud provides the unified data that AI reasons over:** Rippling AI leverages the Employee Graph and all platform data (payroll rules, earnings types, deduction logic, permissions, etc.) as its source of truthBecause Rippling is a unified platform rather than stitched\-together acquisitions, the data is clean, consistent, and complete which makes AI answers accurate and context\-awareAI respects the same permissions model as the rest of the platform, so it only surfaces data the user is authorized to see **The Rippling AI unlocks advanced Data Cloud capabilities:** * AI Dashboards: build dashboards from scratch using natural language prompts * Transformations: full publish access * Pipelines: ingest data via managed connectors * Lineage \& Catalog: explore data lineage for reports * Advanced features: parameters, SQL queries, and the ability to incorporate third\-party data **Why this matters** Most HR/Finance systems weren't built for AI. Their data is messy and fragmented. Rippling AI is described as the first "context\-aware, senior analyst" for HR and Finance teams because it sits on top of a unified data model (Data Cloud \+ Employee Graph) that actually understands your business logic end\-to\-end. **What We Build** ----------------- The team is focused on the following core domains: * **Analytics** – Focuses on the reporting and dashboarding products that enable users to visualize and analyze data within Rippling. * **Data Access** – Owns the query engine (RQL, Rippling Query Language) that powers data retrieval across the platform. This area includes sub\-teams responsible for query execution, data ingestion, and query history. * **Data Management** – Owns the metadata and data catalog layer, including how data assets are discovered, governed, and documented. * **Ingest \& Prep** – Responsible for bringing external data into Rippling. This area includes Managed Connectors (pre\-built integrations with third\-party systems) and Transformations (data shaping and preparation). * **Insights** – A newer area within Data Cloud focused on surfacing actionable insights from data. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Work on distributed processing engines and distributed databases * Develop high\-quality software with attention to detail using tech stacks like Python, MongoDB, CDC, and Kafka * Leverage big data technologies like Aurora, Trino, Presto, Pinot, Iceberg, Flink and more. * Build custom programming languages within the Rippling Platform * Create data platforms, data lakes, and data ingestion systems that work at scale * Design, develop, code, and test software systems, improvements, products, and user\-facing experiences * Work alongside software architects and senior developers doing state\-of\-the\-art development work * Contribute to product design and implementation discussions * Find and build unique solutions to implement projects from the idea phase to production **What You'll Need** -------------------- * 6\+ years experience in backend engineering roles * Experience writing testable and performant backend code * Experience working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment * Experience mentoring less\-experienced developers * Ability to thrive in an environment that grants you a lot of autonomy to explore creative solutions **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US San Francisco Bay Area) 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

This is a highly hands\-on technical role focused on operationalizing AI governance. Rather than creating policy, the individual interprets existing requirements and implements them directly through platform configuration, policy enforcement, APIs, automation, and administrative tooling across Microsoft and Anthropic environments. The goal is to ensure AI controls are embedded, measurable, and enforceable while supporting the firm's continued innovation and growth. Implement guardrails directly across Microsoft and Anthropic services — tenant and admin center settings, Copilot and Copilot Studio policies, Azure AI Foundry configuration, Anthropic enterprise administration, Entra access policies, and Purview data protection controls. * Automate governance at scale. Build scripts and automation (PowerShell, Graph API, Python, KQL) to inventory agents and skills, enforce policy, detect drift, monitor usage, and produce audit and compliance evidence. * Own agents and skills end to end. Maintain the inventory, ownership model, and lifecycle — from intake and review through deployment, monitoring, recertification, and retirement. * Run capability review assessments. Evaluate new AI features and use cases against firm\-defined risk, security, and compliance criteria — covering business value, security exposure, data access and entitlement impact, supervisory obligations, operational readiness, and fit with enterprise * architecture standards — and escalate to the appropriate governance body where a policy decision is required. * Assess LLMs and model changes. Test and compare models across providers, track model and version updates, evaluate capability shifts and failure modes, and provide the technical evidence governance bodies need to decide where each model may be used. * Stay ahead of AI evolution. Systematically track roadmaps, release notes, and previews across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Anthropic, and emerging platforms, and translate each change into a clear enable, pilot, restrict, or defer recommendation. * Implement controls for safe sharing and reuse. Configure how agents and skills are scoped, shared, and permissioned in line with approved requirements, including departmental boundaries, intent review, and guardrails against unintended data exposure. * Partner across the firm. Work closely with Risk, Compliance, the CISO organization, AI Risk Governance, platform engineering, product, and business teams to confirm intent, close gaps, and ensure capabilities launch with the required controls already in place. * Report clearly to leadership and governance forums. Produce decision records, review summaries, control evidence, and executive\-ready briefings on AI capability posture, risks, and adoption Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field. * 5\+ years in enterprise technology, with at least 2 years working directly with generative AI, LLMs, copilots, or agent platforms. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience configuring tenants, platform, or security controls — not just specifying them. * Proficiency in scripting and automation with  pts, grounding, connectors, and retrieval behave — including where they can leak data or produce unreliable results. * Strong grasp of identity, access, and data protection fundamentals, ideally in an Entra and Purview environment. * Proven ability to read a policy or control standard and determine what it means in practice for a platform configuration. * Clear, concise writing and the confidence to present recommendations to senior stakeholders. Skills: * Familiarity with AI cost and consumption management — token metering, prompt\-caching economics, spending limits, and chargeback or show back models. * Exposure to responsible AI or AI risk frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO/IEC 42001\. * Familiarity with AI supply\-chain risk — untrusted skills, plugins, and MCP servers as an attack vector — and with registry, scanning, and gating approaches to control them. * Practical experience with model evaluation, benchmarking, red\-teaming, or prompt\-injection and jailbreak testing. * Experience ingesting AI platform telemetry into Microsoft Sentinel or Defender XDR and extending incident\-response playbooks to AI\-specific alerts. * Experience with network\- and proxy\-layer enforcement of AI traffic, including application\-identity or URL\-category policy, TLS inspection, and egress control for cloud\-resident agents that bypass the corporate firewall. * Familiarity with Microsoft Purview DLP, sensitivity labels, Entra External ID, and data entitlement enforcement. * Hands\-on experience deploying client and endpoint policy through Intune or Group Policy — for example, pinning an AI desktop application to the enterprise tenant and forcing SSO. * Familiarity with agent and non\-human identity models, including on\-behalf\-of execution, admin\-assigned agent permissions, and central agent registration in Entra, Agent 365, or Azure AI Foundry. * Experience administering the agent and skill lifecycle in Copilot Studio, Agent 365, or Anthropic enterprise administration — inventory, ownership, sharing controls, and inactivity review. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code or configuration management (Terraform, Bicep, ARM) applied to platform governance. * Experience supporting technology intake, control testing, or audit and evidence process. * Experience in financial services or another regulated industry, including familiarity with supervisory and recordkeeping obligations. * Experience validating audit, e\-discovery, and records\-retention coverage for a new platform, including provider compliance or audit APIs and OpenTelemetry\-based log export. jobs.title: IV&V Lead and Governance/Risk Assessor
jobs.description: Remote role Sabot Consulting is assembling an independent assessment team to conduct a one\-time retrospective assessment **lasting four months** of a large, multi\-year public\-sector enterprise modernization program. This is an assessment engagement, not an implementation. You will not build, configure, integrate, remediate, or operate anything. You will examine what has already been built, review the evidence, interview the people who built it, and reach independent, defensible conclusions for executive leadership. Independence from the program's implementation vendors is a contractual requirement of the engagement. The scope covers nine assessment domains and 65 discrete assessment requirements: program governance and risk, business process alignment, architecture and design, integration and data management, mainframe and legacy modernization, security and privacy compliance, software development lifecycle and configuration management, testing and quality assurance, and operational readiness. The technology environment includes a major cloud customer relationship management platform, a public cloud infrastructure estate, an enterprise integration platform, a content management platform, intelligent document processing, and a mainframe lift\-and\-refactor migration. Deliverables include an assessment management plan, an initial assessment report, recurring status briefings, per\-domain assessment reports, readiness assessments, an executive briefing, and a final assessment report. You will work full time for four months in a small paired\-team structure alongside senior peers. Findings go directly to executive leadership and to a legislative oversight body. **Required** * 12 or more years of experience, including demonstrated leadership of an IV\&V engagement or a major independent program assessment. **Must have personally led one, not merely participated.** * Has authored assessment methodologies, IV\&V plans, or independent assessment frameworks * Governance assessment depth — evaluating decision rights, escalation paths, program controls, executive reporting, and **RAID** management (RAID stands for Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies) * Has designed a risk severity classification and remediation prioritization method * Vendor contract compliance assessment — evaluating a vendor's performance against deliverable timelines, **service level agreements (SLAs)**, and contractual staffing commitments * Executive\-grade communication. Motor vehicle agency or transportation modernization benchmarking is a significant plus. * Familiarity with **IEEE 1012**, the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers standard for system, software, and hardware verification and validation * Prior expert testimony or formal oversight\-body briefing experience **About Us:** Sabot Consulting is a management consulting company focused on providing technical and management consulting to IT executives and managers in strategic, operational, and project\-based practice areas. jobs.description: **Company Description** Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape. Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry\-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality. Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. **Job Description** In this AI/ML ASIC Performance Engineer position, you will develop AI Storage Solutions based advanced system architectures and AI/ML Accelerator ASIC architecture specifications for Sandisk’s next generation products. As an AI/ML ASIC Architect you will help drive new architecture initiatives that leverage the state\-of\-the\-art frontend interfaces like UCIe, PCIe, CXL, etc that integrates AI Storage Solutions with xPU in a 3D package system. You will drive the AI Storage Solutions based architecture. You will exercise your technical expertise and excellent communication skills to collaborate with design and product planning with an eye towards delivering innovative and highly competitive adaptive accelerators solutions. Typical activities include writing architecture spec, working with other architects in the team, work with RTL/DV/Simulation/Emulation/FW teams to evaluate these changes and assess the performance, power, area, and endurance of the product. You will work closely with excellent colleague engineers, cope with complex challenges, innovate, and develop products that will change the data centric architecture paradigm. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Responsible for driving the AI/ML ASIC architecture that integrates the AI Storage with GPU/TPU/xPU accelerators, with a particular focus on I/O subsystems connected over UCIe/ PCIe/CXL * Author architecture specifications in clear and concise language for AI/ML xPU based Accelerator using AI Storage Solutions. * Define I/O subsystem and PCIe DMA architectures, including their interactions with internal embedded processor\-subsystems, Network on Chip, Memory controllers, and FPGA fabric. * Create flexible and modular I/O subsystem architectures that can be deployed in either Chiplet, monolithic or 3D form factors. * Work with customers, and cross\-functional teams to scope SoC requirements, analyze PPA tradeoffs, and then define architectural requirements that meet the PPA and schedule targets. * Define SoC subsystem and DMA hardware, software, and firmware interactions with embedded processing subsystems and SoC CPUs on the device side and Host CPUs. * Author architecture specifications in clear and concise language. Guide and assist pre\-silicon design/verification and post\-silicon validation during the execution phase. * Responsible for improving the AI/ML ASIC Architecture performance through hardware \& software co\-optimization, post\-silicon performance analysis, and influencing the strategic product roadmap. * Work with customers, and cross\-functional teams to scope SoC requirements, analyze PPA tradeoffs, and then define architectural requirements that meet the PPA and schedule targets. * Guide and assist pre\-silicon design/verification and post\-silicon validation during the execution phase. * LLM Workload analysis and characterization of ASIC and competitive datacenter and AI solutions to identify opportunities for performance improvement in our products. * Experience architecting one or some components of AI/ML accelerator ASICs such as HBM, PCIe/UCIe/CXL, NoC, DMA, Firmware Interactions, NAND, xPU, fabrics, etc * Drive the AI Storage Solutions frontend system architecture with GPU/TPU/NPU/xPU to match or exceed the nextgen HBM bandwidth * Architect memory\-efficient inference/training systems utilizing techniques like pruning, quantization with MX format , continuous batching/chunked prefill, and speculative decoding * Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders/ML researchers to disseminate results and iterate at rapid pace **Qualifications** **REQUIRED:** * Bachelors or Masters in Computer/Electrical Engineering with 1\-3 years of hands\-on Architecture experience authoring specifications * Strong technical   all aspects of employment. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** GibbsCAM is one of the most established CAM platforms in the manufacturing industry, with a history spanning more than 40 years. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team of engineers who take genuine pride in craft, reliability, and building software that real machinists depend on every day. This is a strong growth opportunity for an engineer with a solid foundation in C\+\+ and a curiosity about complex, domain\-rich software. You will work alongside experienced senior engineers who are invested in mentorship and knowledge transfer, and you will have the opportunity to take on meaningful, challenging work from day one. The role suits someone who is eager to learn a specialized domain, comfortable reading and reasoning about code they did not write, and excited to grow their skills within a stable, long\-lived product. This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates authorized to work and residing in the United States. **Primary Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain software features for a large\-scale Windows desktop CAM application, working from specifications provided by Product Management and senior engineers. * Diagnose and resolve defects in existing code, with guidance from senior team members on complex issues spanning large or unfamiliar subsystems. * Perform repair, enhancement, and maintenance of software components, writing clean and well\-tested code that meets the team’s quality standards. * Participate actively in code reviews — both as an author and a reviewer — contributing to a culture of shared ownership and continuous improvement. * Learn and apply relevant domain concepts in CAM and manufacturing as needed to contribute effectively to the product. * Maintain currency with modern C\+\+ and software development best practices, applying them appropriately within the constraints of a mature codebase. * Contribute to technical documentation and assist in keeping internal knowledge bases current. * Consult with senior engineers and management on project status, technical questions, and implementation approaches. **Required Qualifications** * 3–5 years of professional software development experience in a production environment. * Solid proficiency in C and C\+\+; exposure to modern standards (C\+\+11/14/17\) preferred. * Experience reading, debugging, and extending existing codebases — not just writing code from scratch. * Familiarity with Windows desktop application development. * Working knowledge of debugging tools and the ability to systematically isolate and resolve software defects. * Understanding of core data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design principles. * Experience with version control in a team setting. * Solid math fundamentals and willingness to engage with technical or geometric concepts as needed by the domain. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Win32, MFC, COM, or other Windows application frameworks. * Exposure to C\# in a mixed\-language (C\+\+/managed) application context. * Any experience or academic background in CAD, CAM, CNC machining, or manufacturing. * Familiarity with 3D graphics concepts or APIs (OpenGL, DirectX, or similar). * Background or coursework in applied mathematics, linear algebra, or computational geometry. * Experience with Perforce or other enterprise version control systems. * Exposure to large\-project build systems. **Education** * Bachelor’s degree required , with preferred focus in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering. * Equivalent practical experience demonstrating the required technical foundation will be considered. **What to Expect** We understand that a specialized product like GibbsCAM takes time to learn. New team members work with our experienced engineers who provide direction and mentorship during onboarding, and we set realistic expectations for ramp\-up time. We are more interested in hiring someone with strong fundamentals and genuine curiosity than someone who already checks every domain\-specific box. Our team values steady, high\-quality work over heroics. You’ll have the opportunity to grow into greater ownership and technical leadership over time as you build familiarity with the product and codebase. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - NY
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Scope Labs provides a full\-service startup ecosystem focused on design and development of digital platforms and experiences. We are a team of founders consisting of experienced product managers, designers, and developers. Our expertise lies in challenging fundamental assumptions, dissecting legacy behaviors, simplifying intricate processes, and delivering experiences that leave a lasting impact. We are a small, but driven team and are looking to expand! **Our Team** We're currently a small team passionate about developing the next generation of digital products. Our founding team has spent time building, designing, and scaling products at places like Google, Tesla, Palantir, Peloton, Scale AI, MIT, Yale, Columbia, Y Combinator, and more. We're currently hiring for an in person role working from warm and sunny New York City. **What We're Looking For** As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Scope Labs, you won't just be implementing solutions. You'll be embedded directly with our startup customers, owning the entire technical relationship from day one. We're looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering, product instinct, and customer partnership; someone who can walk into a startup's codebase on Monday and ship something meaningful by Friday. This role is for a builder who is equally comfortable digging into a customer's production environment and white boarding a new AI workflow with their engineering lead. You'll be deploying cutting\-edge AI tooling into real startup workflows at the frontier of what's possible, and you'll be the reason those deployments succeed. The specifics of what we're building are still under wraps, but if you're excited by the idea of being one of the first people to bring genuinely new technology into the hands of fast\-moving teams, this is that role. You will represent Scope Labs in the field. That means operating with autonomy, exercising strong judgment under ambiguity, and holding yourself accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. **Responsibilities** You'll own the full technical customer lifecycle. From initial deployment through activation and ongoing utilization, you are the person who makes sure our customers are actually getting value, not just access. You'll identify and champion high\-impact use cases. You'll work closely with startup engineering teams to understand their workflows, identify where AI can meaningfully accelerate them, and get those integrations shipped. You'll be the voice of the customer internally. You'll bring patterns, friction points, and product insights back to our Product and Engineering teams, helping shape the roadmap based on what you're seeing in the field. **Preferred Qualifications** * 3\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Software Engineer with consulting or startup experience. Former technical founders are strongly encouraged to apply. * Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript with a track record of shipping production software. * Hands\-on experience deploying or integrating AI tooling, including LLMs, AI agents, or AI\-native developer tools, into real workflows. * High agency with comfort operating in ambiguous environments and limited direction. * Strong communication skills across audiences, from senior engineers to non\-technical founders. * Team\-first attitude with the ability to juggle multiple customer engagements simultaneously. **Bonus Points** * Experience with AI agent frameworks, MCP servers, or autonomous coding tools in production. * Background in a specific startup or enterprise vertical such as fintech, developer tools, or healthcare. * Direct UX/UI experience or strong product sense. * A portfolio of passion projects or initiatives you've directly built or majority\-contributed to. *If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!* **Salary and Benefits** The expected salary range for this role is based on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Salary Range: $135,000\-$175,000 or monthly contract equivalent. This position is based in New York, NY, and requires candidates to reside in or be willing to relocate to the area. **Equal Opportunity Employer** At Scope we take pride in our best asset, our people! We focus on ensuring that our culture makes life better for the team! Scope Labs is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to diversity in its workforce. We actively encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters innovation and creativity, and we welcome candidates who share our values of respect, collaboration, and excellence. To perform this job successfully, the employee(s) will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an at will relationship. Compensation Range: $135K \- $175K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Front End (Customer Experience)
jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! #### **Overview** As a Senior Frontend Engineer on the Customer Experience team, you will be a core contributor to the customer\-facing experiences that define how people buy a vehicle with us. You will build and maintain high\-quality frontend features across the purchase journey, working across trade\-in, vehicle configuration, finance and leasing, and delivery. You will work closely with product, design, and backend engineers to ship experiences that customers trust with high\-stakes decisions. You will take real ownership of features from design through delivery, contribute meaningfully to technical decisions within the team, and help raise the bar on frontend craft across the codebase. This role is ideal for an engineer who writes thoughtful, production\-quality frontend code, cares deeply about the customer experience, and wants to grow their skills in a complex, design\-rich, transactional product. #### **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Build and maintain polished, performant customer\-facing frontend features, writing clean, well\-tested code that your teammates can rely on and extend. * Implement UI components and application logic that are correct, accessible, and consistent with our design system, translating design intent into high\-fidelity, maintainable code. * Take end\-to\-end ownership of features from scoping and technical design through implementation, testing, and monitoring in production. * Integrate frontend experiences with backend APIs and third\-party services, handling loading states, error conditions, and edge cases thoughtfully. * Contribute to frontend performance work: improving Core Web Vitals, reducing bundle size, and ensuring the UI holds up under real\-world network and device conditions. * Participate actively in code and design reviews, sharing knowledge and helping maintain a high quality bar across the team. * Contribute to the shared component library and design system, helping keep it consistent, accessible, and easy for others to use. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to understand requirements and ship solutions that genuinely serve customers. * Treat accessibility as a core part of the job, building inclusive experiences by default rather than as a retrofit. * Use AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully to increase velocity and share effective practices with the team. **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in **Fremont, California.** * This role requires 1 day per week in the office, with regular in\-person meetings and events. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. * Driver's License required for domestic travel. #### **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: * Education/Certifications: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field * 5\+ years of frontend engineering experience, with a track record of shipping production features end\-to\-end. * Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript, with a solid understanding of component patterns, state management, and application architecture. * Familiarity with modern frontend technologies including WebGL, GSAP, Framer Motion, and Astro is a strong plus. * Good eye for design and attention to detail, able to implement UIs that match design intent accurately and consistently. * Working knowledge of frontend performance fundamentals: Core Web Vitals, rendering strategies, and bundle optimization. * Practical understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG) and experience building accessible components. * Experience integrating frontend applications with REST or GraphQL APIs, including handling errors, loading states, and edge cases. * Collaborative and communicative, comfortable asking questions, flagging blockers, and contributing to team discussions. #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: * Competitive insurance including: + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans * 401(k) program with: + An employer match and immediate vesting * Generous Paid Time Off including: + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave #### **Pay Transparency** This is a full\-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range \= $140,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 Initial California base salary range\= $154,000 \- $187,000 Internal leveling code: IC9 **Notice to applicants:** * To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. * Residing in **San Francisco**: *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* * Residing in **Los Angeles**: *Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.* * Residing in **New York City**: *This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.* **Equal Opportunity** Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre\-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, AI Agents & Automation
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** We're looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability \& Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it — designing the signals that tell us when something's wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale. We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us. **What You'll Do** * Participate in an on\-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load). * Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). * Operate and improve our Kubernetes\-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure. * Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems. * Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root\-cause analysis and follow\-up remediation work. * Build and operate AI agents and automation that take on manual, repetitive SRE work directly — not just tools that assist a human doing the work. * Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship. * Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on\-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person. * Help define non\-functional requirements — scalability, availability, performance — for new systems as they're designed. * Collaborate across engineering teams to adopt best practices in reliability and observability. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly. **What You'll Bring** * Kubernetes (must\-have): strong, hands\-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system. * AI\-native SRE practice (must\-have): hands\-on, personal experience using AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace, Cursor, or custom agents built on Claude/MCP servers) to diagnose, automate, and resolve infrastructure and reliability work. + ***Agentic depth:*** You've built or operated agents that autonomously monitor infrastructure and take action (e.g., an agent that watches system load and scales, remediates, or escalates without a human in the loop) — not just general AI coding assistance. You can speak concretely to how these agents are actually built and operated (MCP protocol, what a harness is, how to differentiate agent\-design strategies rather than just naming tools), to context management (e.g., progressive\-disclosure strategies for surfacing the right information without dumping everything into context), and to securing agent actions (scoping authorization, guardrails, what's available in the AI infra ecosystem to enforce it). + ***SRE application:***That agentic work is pointed at infrastructure and reliability problems specifically — you use AI to move at a materially faster pace in the SRE domain, not as a general\-purpose coding aid. * SRE principles: practical experience with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets — able to speak to how you've defined and monitored these on real systems, not just definitions. * Cloud engineering \& networking: solid grounding in AWS or Azure, including networking fundamentals (subnetting, IP addressing). * Observability: deep experience with at least one modern observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Elasticsearch) and the ability to translate that understanding across tools. * CI/CD: strong understanding of a CI/CD system — GitHub Actions preferred, but TeamCity, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI experience is acceptable. * Programming: strong programming skills with the ability to build web applications — ideally with solid working knowledge of .NET and ASP.NET. We're also open to strong Python (Flask, FastAPI) or Java (Spring) backgrounds. The coding assessment will be tailored to whichever language/framework you're most comfortable in. * Experience with distributed systems and their common failure modes (retries, timeouts, cascading failures). * Strong production troubleshooting skills — comfortable diagnosing issues under pressure. * 8\-10\+ years of relevant hands\-on experience. * Nice\-to\-have: database experience (not mandatory — databases are monitored by the same team, not owned individually). **About You** You're someone who enjoys being directly accountable for the reliability of a business\-critical, large\-scale enterprise system. You're comfortable guiding and making decisions with limited information, and capable of operating within the trade\-offs between solving for immediate needs versus bigger\-scale solutions. You feel rewarded by developing an operability culture in a quickly growing and changing environment, and you're comfortable owning a wide and diverse set of problem areas. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: AI/ML Engineer **Location:** Atlanta, Georgia **Employment Type:** Full\-time About Sobo Sobo is building an AI\-powered business operator intelligence platform designed to help small and midsized businesses identify operational challenges, uncover opportunities, and connect insights to action. Our platform combines proprietary AI systems, business diagnostics, connected data, and expert support to help business leaders make better decisions across operations, finance, growth, technology, and organizational performance. We are looking for an experienced Senior AI/ML Engineer to work directly with our Head of AI Product \& Development and help build the full Sobo platform. About the Role This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who can take AI capabilities from concept and experimentation through production deployment. You will help architect, develop, test, and scale the intelligence layer behind Sobo. Your work will include model development, data pipelines, AI agents and workflows, platform integrations, evaluation systems, production APIs, and the infrastructure required to deliver reliable AI\-powered experiences to customers. This position is well suited for an experienced builder who is comfortable operating in an early\-stage environment, solving ambiguous problems, and taking meaningful ownership of technical outcomes. What You’ll Do * Work directly with the Head of AI Product \& Development to define and execute Sobo’s technical roadmap. * Design, develop, and improve Sobo’s AI and machine\-learning capabilities. * Build production\-ready AI workflows, agents, recommendation systems, and decision\-support tools. * Develop systems that transform business and operational data into relevant, actionable insights. * Build and maintain retrieval, inference, evaluation, and model\-monitoring pipelines. * Integrate AI capabilities with Sobo’s application, databases, APIs, and third\-party business platforms. * Improve the quality, accuracy, explainability, reliability, and security of AI\-generated outputs. * Create scalable data pipelines for structured and unstructured business information. * Evaluate models, frameworks, and infrastructure based on performance, cost, reliability, and customer requirements. * Translate product and business requirements into practical technical solutions. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-documented production code. * Help establish engineering standards, testing practices, documentation, and deployment processes. * Participate in architecture decisions and help shape the long\-term technical foundation of the Sobo platform. * Assist with the growth and development of Sobo’s future engineering team. What We’re Looking For * Demonstrated professional experience building and deploying AI or machine\-learning systems in production. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML development frameworks. * Experience with large language models, natural\-language processing, generative AI, or related technologies. * Experience developing APIs, backend services, data pipelines, and cloud\-based applications. * Understanding of retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI\-agent workflows. * Experience working with structured and unstructured data from multiple sources. * Familiarity with model deployment, monitoring, versioning, testing, and MLOps practices. * Strong understanding of software engineering principles, system architecture, databases, and secure development. * Ability to balance experimentation with the discipline required to ship reliable production software. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively while independently owning major technical initiatives. * Comfort working in a fast\-moving startup where priorities may evolve as the product and customer base grow. Preferred Experience * Experience building AI\-powered B2B SaaS products. * Experience developing multi\-agent or workflow\-based AI systems. * Familiarity with financial, operational, CRM, ERP, payroll, or other business\-platform data. * Experience integrating platforms such as QuickBooks, Xero, Gusto, HubSpot, or similar systems. * Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure. * Experience supporting AI systems involving sensitive business or customer data. * Previous experience in an early\-stage startup or building a product from its foundational stages. * Experience mentoring engineers or helping establish an engineering function. What Success Looks Like In this role, you will help turn Sobo’s product vision into a secure, scalable, and commercially viable platform. Success means shipping dependable AI capabilities, improving the quality of Sobo’s business insights, building systems that can scale with customer adoption, and creating a strong technical foundation for future product and engineering growth. Why Join Sobo? * Help build an ambitious AI platform from an early and influential stage. * Work directly with Sobo’s Head of AI Product \& Development and company leadership. * Take meaningful ownership of architecture, product capabilities, and technical execution. * Solve real operational problems for small and midsized businesses. * Help shape the engineering culture and future technical team. * Join an Atlanta\-based company operating at the intersection of artificial intelligence, business intelligence, and expert\-led execution. Compensation and Work Arrangement This is a paid, full\-time position based in Atlanta, Georgia. Compensation will be determined based on experience, technical background, and the scope of responsibility. How to Apply Please submit your résumé or LinkedIn profile, along with a brief description of an AI/ML product or production system you have helped build. If available, include links to relevant projects, technical portfolios, GitHub repositories, or other examples of your work. Sobo is an equal\-opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants from all backgrounds and evaluate candidates based on their skills, experience, and ability to contribute to the team. Pay: $69,026\.02 \- $83,128\.11 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Design Lead, Design Systems
jobs.description: **About Softline Solutions** Softline Solutions is a full\-service digital marketing agency based in Southern California that helps businesses grow online by increasing visibility, generating leads, and boosting sales. They build tailored, data\-driven campaigns across key digital channels and manage everything from strategy to execution and reporting. The goal is measurable growth, not buzzwords. **About the role** You'll own the design system and produce the work that proves what it's capable of. As our Design Lead, Design Systems, you're responsible for the design system infrastructure across Closet by Design, Closet World, and Brio Water, and for the executional design work that sets the quality benchmark every team can see, build from, and ship. This isn't a role where systems thinking exists in isolation from craft, or where craft stops at the Figma file. You'll think in systems, execute at a high level, and work closely with engineering to make sure quality follows the design all the way out the door.### **Own and Evolve the Design System** * Build, maintain, and evolve a unified but brand\-flexible design system, components, tokens, guidelines, and documentation, that serves all three UX product teams * Audit the current design state across brands, identify system gaps and inconsistencies, and create a roadmap to close them * Define component architecture, versioning, contribution workflows, and governance processes so the system scales as the team and products grow * Establish system architecture that supports speed without sacrificing consistency, so teams can move quickly without drifting from the standards ### **Execute High\-Quality Visual Design Work** * Produce polished, high\-fidelity visual work across all three brands, both production\-ready assets and forward\-looking concept work that shows the team where the bar is * Lead the visual design execution for Closet World, bringing the craft and vision to elevate the brand's digital experience and build the foundation the rest of the team can reference and grow from * Create the kind of work that sets the benchmark, not to keep it to yourself, but to show the team what excellent looks like and make it the new normal ### **Think Forward and Push the Quality Bar** * Develop future\-state design concepts and explorations that show what each brand experience can become, not just what it is today * Challenge assumptions in the current experience; bring fresh eyes, strong conviction, and the craft to back it up * Keep the team and leadership aligned on where design is headed, not just where it currently stands ### **Partner with Engineering to Ship Quality** * Work closely with engineering to ensure that what gets designed gets built right, own the design\-to\-dev handoff with care, precision, and a clear quality standard * Maintain spec fidelity through implementation; be the design voice in the build, not just the file, review shipped work and close quality gaps directly * Build and refine token pipelines and handoff documentation that make it easy for engineers to implement components correctly the first time * Foster a strong design\-engineering relationship, the kind where both sides understand each other's constraints and the shipped product reflects the intended design ### **Support and Elevate the UX Teams** * Partner closely with UX designers embedded across each brand to ensure system adoption is real and the work is strong, not just documented * Provide design direction, feedback, and executional support to elevate the output of the broader team * Make it easy for designers to use the system well, through clear documentation, reusable templates, and regular hands\-on collaboration ### **Move Fast Without Losing Quality** * Work in Figma and across the best available tooling to iterate at the speed the business requires * Balance fast\-turn requests from brand teams with long\-term system integrity, know when to move and when to hold the standard * Operate with ownership and autonomy, you don't wait to be told what needs improving **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- ### **Experience** * 8\+ years of design experience, with at least 3 years in a lead or senior IC role with direct design system ownership * A portfolio that demonstrates both strong design system work *and* strong visual design execution, you need to show us you can do both, not just one * Experience working across multiple brands or products simultaneously, with a track record of maintaining system coherence across varied contexts * E\-commerce, consumer products, or DTC background strongly preferred * Deep proficiency in Figma, variables, tokens, auto\-layout, component architecture, and prototyping, and fluency with the broader tooling ecosystem * Demonstrated track record of close engineering collaboration, you've done the full cycle: designed it, handed it off, reviewed the build, and driven it to the right quality ### **Skills** * Exceptional visual design craft, you have a strong point of view on what looks and feels right, and you can execute it at the highest level * Systems thinker who can architect a design system from principles to production and communicate it clearly to developers and non\-designers alike * Comfortable producing a wide range of output: component documentation, high\-fidelity UX flows, brand\-level concept work, and future\-state visions * Strong design\-to\-engineering collaboration, comfortable reviewing live implementations, giving precise feedback in build contexts, and working directly with developers to close the gap between design intent and shipped product * Craft\-driven brand thinking, the ability to use design not just to solve UX problems, but to push a brand forward: elevate how it looks, how it feels, and how it's experienced across every touchpoint * Able to give and receive direct design feedback with confidence and clarity * Self\-directed and organized, you can manage work across three active brands and multiple system tracks without losing threads ### **Mindset** * Driven by craft, you genuinely care about the quality of the output, very detailed oriented, not just the process; quality means what's shipped, not just what's in the file * Ownership\-oriented, you see a gap and close it; you see a problem and fix it; you don't wait for someone to tell you where to look * Energized by raising the bar, making the team better, making the work better, and building something that outlasts your individual contributions * Collaborative without losing your point of view, you'll give direct design feedback, push back when the work isn't there yet, and advocate strongly for what good looks like * Partnership\-minded with engineering, you understand that great design only matters when it ships right, and you take ownership of the handoff as seriously as the design itself * Comfortable working at speed without sacrificing quality, you know how to make smart trade\-offs and you move accordingly **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building a design system from near\-zero (greenfield) state * Familiarity with design token pipelines and design\-to\-dev handoff tooling *(Style Dictionary, Theo, etc.)* * Background in brand identity or brand systems work across multiple consumer brands * Experience working across retail \+ DTC simultaneously * Exposure to front\-end implementation concepts, enough to speak engineering's language fluently and catch implementation issues on sight **Why This Role** ----------------- * **You'll own something that matters.** The design system is the infrastructure that every brand experience runs on, getting it right has real, visible business impact across three growing consumer brands * **There's a significant opportunity to make your mark.** Closet World has the audience, the business momentum, and the investment to support a real step\-change in design quality, and this role is the engine that drives that forward * **Direct visibility to leadership.** What you build here goes to the Creative Director and brand leadership, not into a backlog * **You'll have the tools and the latitude.** We're investing in the right tooling and giving this person the autonomy to set direction, not just execute against someone else's spec * **Path to grow.** As design systems scale and the brand design bar rises, this role grows with it **The pay range for this role is:** 155,000 \- 180,000 USD per year(Headquarters)

jobs.title: Scrum Master
jobs.description: Collectivus Holdings is a dynamic business group encompassing brands many of the most prestigious brands in the Collecting, Trading Card Game, and Hobby industries. With a century's worth of collective experience in driving product and service innovation, high\-end quality standards, and elevated customer experience, Collectivus brands are among the most recognized and loved throughout the world by the communities they serve. **Website:** https://www.collectivusholdings.com **Locations:** Nashville – Garland – Aarhus – Lisbon – Worldwide **Job Title:** Scrum Master **Job Location:** US \- Remote The Scrum Master owns delivery cadence, team flow, capacity visibility, and blocker removal for a cross\-functional digital product team spanning engineering, data, enterprise systems, and design. This role is accountable for how the team works: whether ceremonies drive real decisions, whether capacity and commitments are visible, and whether blockers get cleared before they cost a sprint. The Scrum Master owns the process, rhythm, and health of how the team executes, working directly with functional leads to keep the team unblocked, the cadence predictable, and delivery performance improving over time. This role ensures the team can do its best work, consistently. **Key Responsibilities** * Own delivery cadence: sprint rhythm, ceremony effectiveness, and team operating norms. * Own capacity visibility, ensuring leadership and the Product Owner always have an accurate read on what the team can realistically take on. * Own blocker removal, proactively identifying and resolving impediments — technical, organizational, or interpersonal — before they slow delivery down. * Own team flow, monitoring work\-in\-progress, cycle time, and throughput to keep work moving smoothly through the pipeline. * Own the health of the delivery process, changing it when it stops working rather than defending it out of habit. * Accountable for: Throughput, delivery predictability, cycle time, and team flow health. *Ceremonies \& Cadence* * Facilitate sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives so each ceremony drives a real decision or improvement, not a status recital. * Partner with the Product Owner to bring triaged, ready work into the sprint. * Keep sprint scope protected once committed, surfacing and pushing back on mid\-sprint scope change. * Run retrospectives that produce concrete process changes, and track that those changes actually stick. *Flow \& Capacity* * Track and report team capacity, velocity, and commitment reliability on a consistent cadence. * Monitor work\-in\-progress limits, cycle time, and throughput; identify bottlenecks in the delivery pipeline and drive changes to resolve them. * Maintain clear, accurate forecasts so the Product Owner and engineering leadership can plan with confidence. * Flag capacity risks early, each with a likely impact and a path to resolution. *Delivery Health \& Process* * Track delivery health — flow, throughput, and predictability trends — and report status on a weekly cadence to the Head of Product Engineering. * Continuously improve team process and tooling; remove ceremonies or steps that no longer earn their place. * Coach the team and functional leads on Agile/Scrum principles, fostering self\-organization and continuous improvement. * Partner with the Product Owner to keep delivery process aligned with sprint commitments and release scope. * Establish and track flow metrics, including cycle time, throughput, capacity utilization, and blocker resolution time, to identify opportunities and drive improvements in delivery performance. *Communications \& Collaboration* * Serve as the team's primary point of contact for questions on process, capacity, and impediments. * Communicate team flow health, risks, and blockers clearly to the Product Owner and cross\-functional stakeholders. * Work directly with the Product Owner, UX designer, developers, business systems analysts, and engineers day\-to\-day. * Facilitate cross\-team coordination with other Scrum Masters and Product Owners to manage dependencies across teams. **Profile** * Take ownership without being asked; makes decisions under ambiguity and stands behind them. * Direct and decisive in protecting team focus; able to push back on scope creep and hold the team to its commitments. * Precise and structured in tracking capacity, flow, and delivery health data. * Runs multiple concurrent workstreams without dropping threads; steady under pressure. * Improves systems rather than maintaining them. * Builds trust and alignment across functional leads and the Product Owner; influences without relying on formal authority. * 3\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or in an equivalent agile delivery role, with demonstrated ownership of team flow and delivery predictability. * Experience facilitating delivery for multi\-platform or cross\-functional teams. * Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Kanban methodologies. * Comfortable using flow, capacity, and delivery data to identify bottlenecks and drive process improvement. * Experience with agile tooling (e.g., Jira, Linear, Azure DevOps) for tracking capacity, velocity, and flow metrics. **Preferred Qualifications** * Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification. * Experience in enterprise software environments. * Familiarity with SAFe or other scaled agile frameworks. * Background coaching multiple teams simultaneously. * Experience working with digital products at scale and within data\-driven product teams. \#LI\-Remote
