jobs.description: The Software Systems Engineering team is responsible for defining SW development processes and ensuring that all safety\-critical software meets a high safety bar for production vehicles. In this role, you will design and implement methodologies, tools, and processes for safety\-critical software that will revolutionize transportation in the 21st century. Borrowing principles from avionics, automotive, and other safety\-critical industries, you will work with software engineers throughout the Zoox software org, ranging from state\-of\-the\-art AI Autonomy software, all the way to highly\-critical RTOS and middleware components. You will develop and maintain tools that help cross\-functional teams build software adhering to a High Assurance Process, working closely with CI tools and infrastructure to meet the team's business goals. Partnering with team leads, you will define delivery milestones, automate necessary tooling, and report on relevant business metrics — while contributing to code reviews and incident postmortems to ensure the long\-term stability and reliability of the software system. ### **In this role, you will:** * Be the go\-to owner for the entire SSE pipeline ecosystem — from ClangTidy, ASAN/TSAN/Harden, and FBInfer — keeping every pipeline running smoothly across weekly, nightly, and CI so the rest of the org can trust the results. * Take pipelines from prototypes to fully deployed, CI\-enforced systems across branches, shaping how "production\-grade" looks for stability tooling at Zoox. * Turn raw issue data into dashboards and KPIs that tell a story — giving leadership and engineering teams a clear, real\-time pulse on pipeline health and software quality trends. * Play detective when things break — root\-causing gnarly cross\-platform and determinism, building the instrumentation and tooling to crack them. * Help shape what's next for the pipeline suite — pitching in on new checker rollouts, testing strategy, and define how SSE scales its infrastructure ### **Qualifications:** * Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in computer science, electrical engineering, robotics, aerospace, or related fields and 3\+ years of experience working on large code bases * Experience developing in Bazel/Python, setting up backend infrastructure (databases, web servers, shell scripts, etc.), and interfacing with software written in C\+\+ and Python. * Experienced in drafting system design diagrams and documentation for customer communication and long\-term maintenance * Comfortable to whip up quick scripts to automate tasks, such as generating metrics, establishing traceability, etc, when necessary. * Deep experience in enterprise\-scale deployment practices and issues ### **Bonus Qualifications:** * Experience working with PipeDream, Airflow and Looker * Proficiency in ReactJS, TypeScript and C\+\+ (C\+\+11, C\+\+14, C\+\+17\) including memory management, threading, and common debugging pattern There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Summary:** The Senior Full Stack Developer owns the core application end\-to\-end — leading hands\-on development of new features and integrations while balancing performance, maintainability, and security across the monolithic codebase. This role establishes application monitoring, analyzes data flows across systems and vendor integrations, and proactively resolves performance issues. A key responsibility is safeguarding production data integrity, executing database changes with proper transaction handling, rollback capability, and audit logging. As a senior contributor, this person also gatekeeps code quality by reviewing and approving team contributions, partners with product and engineering teams to shape the technical roadmap, and evaluates emerging technologies for platform fit. Working with QA and DevOps, they help define testing and deployment practices that strengthen system reliability and scalability. **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **Application Ownership \& Codebase Management** Own and maintain the core application, including hands\-on management and cleanup of its monolithic architecture. Evaluate new features, enhancements, and integrations, balancing performance, maintainability, and security. Provide direct technical implementation — not just guidance — during discovery, design, development, and deployment phases. Translate business and counseling workflows into scalable, secure technical solutions. * **Performance and Optimization** Establish application monitoring and data integration health checks to ensure uninterrupted workflows. Analyze end\-to\-end data flows between systems, the SaaS platform, and vendor integrations. Proactively identify performance bottlenecks and implement fixes directly. * **Database Integrity \& Risk Management** Safely perform and oversee direct production database changes — writing and executing queries and scripts using transactions, rollback capability, and audit logging so that no operation leaves data in a corrupted or unrecoverable state. Map current and future data flows, identifying risks to data integrity, privacy, and availability. Ensure compliance with privacy and security regulations and recommend best practices for secure data exchange and storage. * **Code Review \& Repository Gatekeeping** Review and approve code changes from contributing team members before they are merged into the repository, ensuring quality, security, and consistency standards are met. Act as the primary gatekeeper for repository access and contributions. * **Technology Strategy and Solutions** Collaborate with product, engineering, and customer teams to define the technical roadmap. Evaluate emerging technologies (automation, cloud services, analytics, AI) for their applicability in advancing the platform. Provide hands\-on implementation and oversight for vendor integrations, APIs, and third\-party services. * **Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement** Partner with QA and DevOps teams to ensure robust testing frameworks and deployment practices. Define guardrails to reduce production issues. Advocate for practices that improve system reliability, scalability, and maintainability. **QUALIFICATIONS \& EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:** **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. **Qualifications:** * Experience: **5–7 years** in hands\-on software development, with direct experience managing, refactoring, and cleaning up monolithic application architectures. * Technical Expertise: Strong background in SaaS platforms and cloud\-native architecture, with **required, non\-negotiable hands\-on AWS experience** — this team must fully own and understand its own infrastructure internally, so **AWS proficiency** cannot be substituted with Azure/GCP experience alone. Microservices familiarity is a plus. Experience using Claude Code is essential. * Team leadership experience is preferred. * Database: Strong SQL experience, specifically including safe, hands\-on production database work — writing and running queries/scripts with transaction control, rollback procedures, and logging to prevent and recover from data corruption. * Code Review: Demonstrated experience reviewing code and gatekeeping contributions from other developers before changes are merged into a shared repository. * Data \& Integration: Experience designing and managing secure data flows, API integrations, and monitoring frameworks. * Regulatory Awareness: Familiarity with EHR systems, healthcare data standards, and regulatory frameworks (HIPAA).

In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. **Applying to Render** ---------------------- We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for Render's first Forward Deployed Engineer to work hands\-on with our most strategic customers. Our largest contracts and fastest\-growing AI startups are scaling on Render, and this role provides them with a dedicated, concierge\-level technical partnership. You will balance two motions: white\-glove engagement with our top accounts, where you work closely with the customer's engineering team as a trusted technical partner, and scoped onboarding intensives that get high\-growth startups confidently building on the platform. As the first FDE in our Field Engineering organization, you will define the playbook for this function, prove the model, and shape how it scales. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Work closely with Render's top accounts as their dedicated technical partner, providing concierge service across architecture reviews, migration planning, and hands\-on delivery. * Run scoped onboarding intensives for high\-growth startups, from intake and success criteria through hands\-on\-keyboard execution. * Lead the database side of customer engagements, including Postgres architecture, performance tuning, and complex data migrations from Heroku, AWS, and other cloud providers. * Drive activation and expansion in strategic accounts: turn major credit grants into durable production adoption, surface expansion signals from your technical work, and partner with the account team to convert them into revenue. * Own the ongoing technical relationship for your accounts: proactive architecture and health reviews, collaborative roadmap sessions, incident follow\-up and RCA, and escalation point for hard technical problems, working closely with the account team. * Build the FDE playbook: qualification criteria, engagement templates, success metrics, and reference architectures that make the program repeatable. * Act as a high\-signal feedback channel to product and engineering, translating customer friction into prioritized product input. * Partner with Account Managers and Customer Engineers to ensure smooth handoffs after each engagement and durable long\-term coverage. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 8\+ years in a hands\-on, customer\-facing engineering role: forward deployed, solutions, customer, or professional services engineering. * Strong software engineering fundamentals; you can write production\-quality code and work hands\-on\-keyboard inside a customer's codebase. * Deep experience with cloud infrastructure: containers, CI/CD, networking, autoscaling, and running real workloads in production. * Deep Postgres and database expertise: schema design, performance tuning, replication, and production data migrations. Our largest engagements consistently turn on this skill set. * AI fluency: you work with AI tools daily to accelerate your own delivery, and you understand LLM application architectures well enough to guide the teams building them. * Excellent communication with everyone from startup founders to enterprise platform teams, including executive\-level conversations. * Self\-directed and comfortable with ambiguity; you can stand up a new function without an existing playbook. * Commercial instincts: you understand how technical wins connect to expansion, renewal, and revenue. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Migration experience from Heroku, AWS, or other clouds onto modern platforms. * Hands\-on experience shipping AI and LLM applications (RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, inference workloads); many of our fastest\-growing accounts are AI\-native. * Prior experience as the first hire in a role or a founding member of a new program. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need. **Benefits** ------------ * 4 weeks of paid vacation. * 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. We will also work with you to create a supportive plan of return. * Long\-term disability, life insurance, and 401K plans. * 100% employer\-paid medical coverage and 99% employer\-paid dental and vision coverage for you and a dependent. FSAs and HSAs are available as well. * Monthly lifestyle stipend for wellness, mental health and therapy, hobbies, etc. * Monthly cell phone and internet subsidy. * Commuter benefits for Renders in the Bay Area, and home office stipends for remote Renders. * Continuous learning benefits \& related support. *This position is generally not eligible for new visa**sponsorship. Please contact us to request accommodation.* *We encourage all who are interested to apply.
